worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-1.english: * Looks like the backside of a polaroid.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-4.english: * Yeah,[wait:5] I made it to remind me of what's most important.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-4.ptbr: * Sim,[wait:5] fiz para me lembrar do que é mais importante.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-5.english: * Holding onto hope that tomorrow will be a better day.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-5.ptbr: * Manter a esperança de que amanhã será um dia melhor.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-6.english: * And to never stop striving for my dreams.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-6.ptbr: * E nunca parar de lutar pelos meus sonhos.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-7.english: * It's just a little doodle,[wait:5] but...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-8.english: * Seeing those stars... [wait:5]\nReminds me that all my hope...[wait:5] All my work...
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-8.ptbr: * Ver aquelas estrelas... [wait:5]\nMe lembra que toda a minha esperança...[wait:5] Todo o meu esforço...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-9.english: * It's building up to something![wait:5]\n* Something real!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-9.ptbr: * Está levando a alguma coisa![wait:5]\n* Algo real!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-11.english: * So never give up![wait:5]\n* Never stop hoping or dreaming.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-11.ptbr: * Então não desista![wait:5]\n* Nunca deixe de ter esperança nem de sonhar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-photo-12.ptbr: * Esse é o meu lema,[wait:5] pelo menos.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-1.english: * In my professional opinion,[wait:5] this is clearly the lesser lamp.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-1.ptbr: * Na minha opinião profissional,[wait:5] esta é claramente a lâmpada inferior.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-2.english: * Inside the drawer is a book.[wait:5]\n* The cover reads \"Mapping Out \nthe Night Sky.\"
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-2.ptbr: * Dentro da gaveta há um livro.[wait:5]\n* A capa diz \"Mapeando \no Céu Noturno.\"

worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-3.english: * It seems like it's been used\na lot,[wait:5] and a few of the pages \nseem to be missing.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-drawer-3.ptbr: * Parece ter sido usado\nmuitas vezes,[wait:5] e algumas páginas \nparecem estar faltando.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-bed-6.english: * It's pretty comfortable,[wait:5] you \nmay even go so far as to call \nit stellar.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-bed-6.ptbr: * É bem confortável,[wait:5] você \npoderia até dizer que é \nestelar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-2.english: * I mean...[wait:5] There's no reason to turn the light off yet,[wait:5] you know?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-2.ptbr: * Quero dizer...[wait:5] Não tem motivo para apagar a luz ainda,[wait:5] sabe?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-3.english: * I'll turn it off myself when it's time to go to sleep.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-lamp-3.ptbr: * Eu mesmo vou apagá-la quando chegar a hora de dormir.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-1.english: * That's my hammock.[wait:5]\n* It's where I sleep at night.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-1.ptbr: * Essa é a minha rede.[wait:5]\n* É onde durmo à noite.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-2.english: * Huh?\n* Why don't I just sleep on my bed?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-2.ptbr: * Hã?\n* Por que eu não durmo simplesmente na cama?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-3.ptbr: * Ah, sabe como é.\n* Motivos normais.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-5.english: * Seems fun to swing on,[wait:5] but it's slightly too high to reach.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-hammock-5.ptbr: * Parece divertido balançar nela,[wait:5] mas está um pouco alta demais.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-2.english: * Don't worry, I've got loads of stuff to eat.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-2.ptbr: * Não se preocupe, tenho um monte de coisa para comer.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-3.english: * I can even cook something up for you,[wait:5] \nif you want.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-3.ptbr: * Posso até preparar alguma coisa para você,[wait:5] \nse quiser.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-6.english: * You don't want to take anything.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-7.english: * The fridge is full of neatly organized COOKing ingredients.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-7.ptbr: * A geladeira está cheia de ingredientes de COZINHA bem organizados.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-8.ptbr: * E está ligada na tomada,[wait:5] também.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-9.english: * The fridge is filled to the \nbrim with dozens of different \nCOOKing ingredients.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-9.ptbr: * A geladeira está cheia até a \nborda com dezenas de diferentes \ningredientes de COZINHA.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-10.english: * However,[wait:5] it isn't even plugged in...
worldcutscene-apartment-text-fridge-10.ptbr: * Porém,[wait:5] ela nem está ligada na tomada...

worldcutscene-apartment-text-pancakes-1.english: * .[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]You need to take care of this later.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-2.english: * It's small,[wait:5] but I find it quite cozy.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-2.ptbr: * É pequeno,[wait:5] mas acho bem aconchegante.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-3.english: * It's nothing impressive,[wait:5] but it has the essentials.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-3.ptbr: * Não é nada impressionante,[wait:5] mas tem o essencial.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-4.english: * We have a kitchenette,[wait:5] a bed,[wait:5] a hammock and,[wait:5] most importantly,[wait:5] a lamp.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-4.ptbr: * Temos uma cozinha pequena,[wait:5] uma cama,[wait:5] uma rede e,[wait:5] o mais importante,[wait:5] uma lâmpada.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-5.english: * You can take the bed.[wait:5]\n* I've been sleeping on that hammock for months.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-5.ptbr: * Pode ficar com a cama.[wait:5]\n* Tenho dormido naquela rede há meses.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-6.english: * Feel free to rest up,[wait:5] you probably need it after everything.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-spawn-6.ptbr: * Pode descansar à vontade,[wait:5] você provavelmente precisa depois de tudo isso.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-1.english: * What do you think?[wait:5]\n* Pretty nice place,[wait:5] \nisn't it?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-1.ptbr: * O que acha?[wait:5]\n* Lugar bem legal,[wait:5] \nnão é?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-2.english: * You don't get places like this in Snowdin.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-2.ptbr: * Não se encontram lugares assim em Snowdin.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-4.english: * I've been living here for a while now,[wait:5] and I really love it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-4.ptbr: * Já moro aqui há um tempo,[wait:5] e gosto muito daqui.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-5.english: * Who knew such a cramped space could make you feel so free?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-5.ptbr: * Quem diria que um espaço apertado faria você se sentir tão livre?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-6.english: * You're probably wondering where I got the G to afford this.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-6.ptbr: * Você deve estar se perguntando de onde tirei os G para pagar isto.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-10.english: * You see,[wait:5] this used to be a place my dad lived in for work.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-10.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] este lugar era onde meu pai morava por causa do trabalho.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-11.english: * Once he retired,[wait:5] he still had access to it,[wait:5] so he let me use it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-11.ptbr: * Quando ele se aposentou,[wait:5] ainda tinha acesso ao lugar,[wait:5] então me deixou usá-lo.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-12.english: * That means I'm not the one paying for it.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-12.ptbr: * Isso quer dizer que não sou eu quem paga por isto.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-14.english: * Huh?[wait:5]\n* Are you worried about him paying for this?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-14.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5]\n* Isso de ele pagar por tudo preocupa você?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-15.english: * Don't worry, Sunny![wait:5]\n* He'll be fine.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-15.ptbr: * Não se preocupe, Sunny![wait:5]\n* Ele vai ficar bem.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-16.english: * Besides,[wait:5] once our restaurant becomes a big hit,[wait:5] we'll pay him back.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-16.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] quando nosso restaurante fizer sucesso,[wait:5] vamos pagar tudo de volta.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-17.english: * I'm sure he'll be delighted.[wait:5]\n* Proud, even.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-17.ptbr: * Tenho certeza de que ele vai adorar.[wait:5]\n* Vai até ficar orgulhoso.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-18.english: * Do you need something before you're comfortable sleeping?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-18.ptbr: * Precisa de alguma coisa para conseguir dormir bem?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-19.english: * Oh, I get it![wait:5]\n* You must be afraid of the dark!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-19.ptbr: * Ah, entendi![wait:5]\n* Você deve ter medo do escuro!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-20.english: * Don't worry, Sunny.[wait:5] I get what that's like.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-20.ptbr: * Não se preocupe, Sunny.[wait:5] Eu sei como é.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-22.english: * Used to be! [wait:5]\n* Afraid of the dark![wait:5]\n* When I was a larva!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-22.ptbr: * Já tive! [wait:5]\n* Medo do escuro![wait:5]\n* Quando eu era uma larva!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-23.english: * And I'm not anymore![wait:5]\n* Because I'm a self-sufficient adult!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-23.ptbr: * E não tenho mais![wait:5]\n* Porque já consigo me virar por conta própria!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-24.english: * ...[wait:5]Anyway, don't worry![wait:5]\n* There are night lights on the wall.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-24.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Enfim, não se preocupe![wait:5]\n* Tem luzes noturnas na parede.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-26.english: * I am a very brave adult.[wait:5]\n* Who does not need to be patronized.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-luna1-26.ptbr: * Tenho muita coragem.[wait:5]\n* E não preciso que me tratem como criança.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You smell something delectable in the air.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Você sente um aroma delicioso no ar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Rise and shine,[wait:5] Sunny!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Hora de acordar,[wait:5] Sunny!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Get up,[wait:5] I'm making breakfast!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Levante,[wait:5] estou fazendo o café da manhã!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Here you go.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Aqui está.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Pancakes with some nice syrup,[wait:5] hot and ready to be eaten.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Panquecas com uma boa calda,[wait:5] quentinhas e prontas para comer.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Dig in,[wait:5] Sunny!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Pode comer,[wait:5] Sunny!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Today's the day! I can hardly believe it!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Hoje é o dia! Mal consigo acreditar!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Can you believe it,[wait:5] Sunny?[wait:5] We're a real,[wait:5] ranked restaurant now!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Dá para acreditar,[wait:5] Sunny?[wait:5] Agora somos um restaurante[wait:5] classificado de verdade!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * When I woke up and remembered,[wait:5] I couldn't contain my excitement!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Quando acordei e lembrei,[wait:5] não consegui conter a empolgação!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * After everything that's happened[wait:2].[wait:2].[wait:2].
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Depois de tudo que aconteceu[wait:2].[wait:2].[wait:2].

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * So,[wait:5] what happened yesterday?[wait:5]\n* How well did we do?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Então,[wait:5] o que aconteceu ontem?[wait:5]\n* Como nos saímos?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh,[wait:5] have we ranked up yet?\n[wait:5]* Did the King show up?!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] já subimos de classificação?\n[wait:5]* O Rei apareceu?!

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * ...No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] what am I saying...[wait:5]\n* Obviously not.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * ...Não,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] o que estou dizendo...[wait:5]\n* É claro que não.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * We still need quite a bit of [color:yellow]PRESTIGE[color:white] to make it to Rank 2.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ainda precisamos de bastante [color:yellow]PRESTÍGIO[color:white] para chegar à Classificação 2.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Huh?[wait:5] Is someone at the door?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5] Tem alguém na porta?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * That's unusual.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Isso é estranho.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Who is it?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Quem é?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: [voice:courier][font:courier]* Who I am doesn't matter.[wait:5] I have a message for a[wait:5] Luna.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: [voice:courier][font:courier]* Quem eu sou não importa.[wait:5] Tenho uma mensagem para uma tal de[wait:5] Luna.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh![wait:5]\n* That's me![wait:5]
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ah![wait:5]\n* Sou eu![wait:5]

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Come on in.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Pode entrar.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Hmph.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Hmph.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I'm not here for chit-chat.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz sent me here and-[wait:15]
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Não vim aqui para conversar.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz me mandou aqui e-[wait:15]

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Uh.[wait:5]\n* Why'd you do that?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ahn.[wait:5]\n* Por que fez isso?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * What.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * O quê.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You just walked in and leaned against the wall.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Você simplesmente entrou e se encostou na parede.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * And what's the wind magic for?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * E para que serve essa magia de vento?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Uh.[wait:5] I was just...[wait:5] Uh.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ahn.[wait:5] Eu só estava...[wait:5] Ahn.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I mean.[wait:5]\n* Heh.[wait:5]\n* You wouldn't understand.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Quero dizer.[wait:5]\n* Heh.[wait:5]\n* Você não entenderia.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * I see...[wait:5]\n* So,[wait:5] what was the message?
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Entendo...[wait:5]\n* Então,[wait:5] qual era a mensagem?

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * Oh,[wait:5] right.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz is raising the price since you ranked up.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] certo.[wait:5]\n* Mawzz subiu o preço porque vocês subiram de nível.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * You may have noticed.[wait:5] It's up to 100 G per day now.
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * Talvez tenham percebido.[wait:5] Agora são 100 G por dia.

worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.english: * What?![wait:5]\n* Why?!
worldcutscene-apartment-text-dayThreeMor.ptbr: * O quê?![wait:5]\n* Por quê?!

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-3.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] que ele não vá gostar de mim,[wait:5] suponho.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-4.english: * Why do I come here,[wait:5] then? Well,[wait:5] the truth is...
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-4.ptbr: * Então por que venho aqui?[wait:5] Bem,[wait:5] a verdade é...

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-5.english: * I find myself quite entranced by Draculatte's music.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-5.ptbr: * Fico bastante encantado com a música de Draculatte.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-6.english: * I can't help but sit and listen to it when he prepares the coffee.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-6.ptbr: * Não consigo evitar sentar e ouvir quando ele prepara o café.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-7.english: * It almost makes me want to...[wait:5]\n* ...Nevermind.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-garlic-7.ptbr: * Quase me dá vontade de...[wait:5]\n* ...Deixa para lá.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-1.english: * Hrmmm,[wait:5] yes.[wait:5] \n* This coffee is stupendous.[wait:5] \n* Draculatte outdid himself.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-1.ptbr: * Hrmmm,[wait:5] sim.[wait:5] \n* Este café é estupendo.[wait:5] \n* Draculatte se superou.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-2.english: * A shame a little riffraff like you can't have some.\n[wait:5]* Hyoo ho ho!
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-2.ptbr: * Uma pena que ralé como você não possa provar.\n[wait:5]* Hyoo ho ho!

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-3.english: * Because the coffee machine \nis broken at the moment.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-3.ptbr: * Porque a máquina de café \nestá quebrada no momento.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-4.english: * How come I got coffee if the machine is broken?[wait:5]\n* Oh,[wait:5] that's simple.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-4.ptbr: * Como consegui café se a máquina está quebrada?[wait:5]\n* Ah,[wait:5] isso é simples.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-5.english: * You see,[wait:5] every type of coffee made here is associated with \na different song.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-5.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] cada tipo de café feito aqui está associado a \numa música diferente.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-6.english: * Well,[wait:5] whenever I come here,[wait:5] I always ask for the same coffee.[wait:5]\n* A simple order,[wait:5] you know.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-6.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] sempre que venho aqui,[wait:5] peço o mesmo café.[wait:5]\n* Um pedido simples,[wait:5] sabe.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-7.english: * A Nosferacciato,[wait:5] without \ngluten,[wait:5] with vanilla creme,[wait:5] \nblood cherry and no ice.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-7.ptbr: * Um Nosferacciato,[wait:5] sem \nglúten,[wait:5] com creme de baunilha,[wait:5] \ncereja-sangue e sem gelo.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-9.english: * You should have seen Draculatte going wild on the organ!\n[wait:5]* The BPM on that thing...
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-9.ptbr: * Você precisava ter visto Draculatte enlouquecendo no órgão!\n[wait:5]* O BPM daquela coisa...

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-10.english: * I wasn't certain whether the smoke was coming out of the coffee,[wait:5] the organ,[wait:5] or his ears.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-noble-10.ptbr: * Eu não sabia se a fumaça estava saindo do café,[wait:5] do órgão,[wait:5] ou das orelhas dele.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-1.english: * A little guy like me needs a little pick-me-up for this \nscary world.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-1.ptbr: * Um baixinho como eu precisa de um estimulante para este \nmundo assustador.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-2.english: * That's why I love Coffee-In.[wait:5]\n* It's really the perfect place for someone like me.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-2.ptbr: * É por isso que adoro o Coffee-In.[wait:5]\n* É realmente o lugar perfeito para alguém como eu.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-3.english: * Also,[wait:5] I like to curse anyone\nthat opens the door.[wait:5] \n* As a bit.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-3.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] gosto de amaldiçoar quem\nabre a porta.[wait:5] \n* Só de brincadeira.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-4.english: * Huh?\n[wait:5] * How do I curse people?\n[wait:5]* Is it magic?
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-4.ptbr: * Hã?\n[wait:5] * Como amaldiçoo as pessoas?\n[wait:5]* É magia?

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-5.english: * No,[wait:5] I just throw sand at \ntheir shoes.
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-5.ptbr: * Não,[wait:5] eu só jogo areia \nnos sapatos delas.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-mummy-6.english: * ...[wait:5]Maybe I should get a new hobby...

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-coffee-3.english: * It was added to your ITEMs.

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-ritual-4.english: * It's alive!\n[wait:5]* Now we can really start living it up!
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-ritual-4.ptbr: * Está viva!\n[wait:5]* Agora podemos animar isto de verdade!

worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-ritual-5.english: * Groovy!\n[wait:5]* You're the life of the party,[wait:5] DJ!
worldcutscene-coffee_in-text-ritual-5.ptbr: * Groovy!\n[wait:5]* Você é a alma da festa,[wait:5] DJ!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-downstair.english: * You just came out of that apartment there,[wait:5] didn't you?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-downstair.ptbr: * Você acabou de sair daquele apartamento ali,[wait:5] não foi?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-downstair.english: * Well,[wait:5] I happen to have a letter to that address.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-downstair.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] por acaso tenho uma carta para aquele endereço.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-enter_sns.english: * The door is locked.\n[wait:5]* There's a note on it.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-enter_sns.ptbr: * A porta está trancada.\n[wait:5]* Tem um bilhete nela.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-enter_sns.english: * \"Closed...\n[wait:5]* But we'll be open again very soon![wait:5]Most certainly!\"

worldcutscene-core_square-text-fountain-.english: * It's a shame you can't see the statue,[wait:5] it's quite stunning!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-1.english: * (This is a lot to take in...\n[wait:5]But still you stay determined!)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-1.ptbr: * (É muita coisa para absorver...\n[wait:5]Mesmo assim, você continua determinado!)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-2.english: * (Luna hovers close behind you, [wait:5]eyes shining with hope.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-3.english: * (The opportunity of helping a new friend fills you with determination!)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-3.ptbr: * (A oportunidade de ajudar uma nova amizade enche você de determinação!)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-4.english: * (The CORE Square is bustling with life and warmth.)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-4.ptbr: * (A Praça do NÚCLEO está cheia de vida e calor.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-5.english: * (The start of a bright new day fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-save-5.ptbr: * (O começo de um novo dia radiante enche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-1.english: * Hm?[wait:5] Did you get that coffee for me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-1.ptbr: * Hm?[wait:5] Conseguiu aquele café para mim?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-2.english: * That's very thoughtful,[wait:5] but I'm afraid I must decline.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-2.ptbr: * É muita gentileza,[wait:5] mas receio que eu tenha que recusar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-3.english: * I'm already sufficiently caffeinated.[wait:5] Wouldn't want to crash out.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-3.ptbr: * Já estou suficientemente cafeinado.[wait:5] Não quero acabar desabando.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-4.english: * The fellow that dropped off that letter,[wait:5] he was quite a character!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-4.ptbr: * O sujeito que deixou aquela carta,[wait:5] ele era uma figura e tanto!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-5.english: * It's strange,[wait:5] though.\n[wait:5]* He could have dropped off the letter himself.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-5.ptbr: * É estranho,[wait:5] porém.\n[wait:5]* Ele podia ter entregado a carta sozinho.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-6.english: * Maybe he just felt he had something better to do?[wait:5]\n* He seemed like a big deal.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-6.ptbr: * Talvez só achasse que tinha algo melhor para fazer?[wait:5]\n* Parecia alguém importante.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-7.english: * Well,[wait:5] back to work for me! [wait:5]I've got lots of letters to deliver![wait:5] A snailman's job is never done!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-7.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] de volta ao trabalho! [wait:5]Tenho muitas cartas para entregar![wait:5] O trabalho de um carteiro-caracol nunca acaba!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-8.english: * ...Gee...[wait:5]\n* As much as I love it,[wait:5] this job can be real dangerous sometimes.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-8.ptbr: * ...Nossa...[wait:5]\n* Por mais que eu ame isto,[wait:5] este trabalho pode ser bem perigoso às vezes.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-9.english: * This fellow behind me has been threatening me for a good while now for blocking the road.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-9.ptbr: * Este sujeito atrás de mim está me ameaçando há um bom tempo por eu estar bloqueando a estrada.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-10.english: * Now,[wait:5] that's no way to treat an essential worker like me,[wait:5] don't you think?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-10.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] não é assim que se trata um trabalhador essencial como eu,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-11.english: * Sigh...[wait:5]\n* The life of a snailman is a \nreal struggle.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-11.ptbr: * Suspiro...[wait:5]\n* A vida de um carteiro-caracol é \numa luta de verdade.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-12.english: * Hey there![wait:5] I heard that Coffee-In's coffee machine is up and running again!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-12.ptbr: * Ei![wait:5] Ouvi dizer que a máquina de café do Coffee-In voltou a funcionar!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-13.english: * The coffee's really helpful in ecouraging productivity,[wait:5] take it from me,[wait:5] kid!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-13.ptbr: * O café ajuda muito a estimular a produtividade,[wait:5] acredite em mim,[wait:5] criança!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-14.english: * I have it every so often,[wait:5] and it really speeds up my work.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-14.ptbr: * Tomo de vez em quando,[wait:5] e realmente acelera meu trabalho.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-15.english: * You hear a lot of news and gossip doing this job.[wait:5] It's part of why I love it.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-15.ptbr: * Este trabalho traz notícias e fofocas.[wait:5] É por isso que adoro.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-16.english: * Hello kid![wait:5]\n* That's right,[wait:5] I'm still hard at work on deliveries.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-16.ptbr: * Olá, criança![wait:5]\n* Isso mesmo,[wait:5] ainda estou trabalhando duro nas entregas.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-17.english: * Very important deliveries which need to be delivered as fast as possible!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-17.ptbr: * Entregas muito importantes que precisam chegar o mais rápido possível!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-18.english: * Whoa,[wait:5] hey![wait:5]\n* Watch out,[wait:5] kid,[wait:5] coming through!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-18.ptbr: * Uau,[wait:5] ei![wait:5]\n* Cuidado,[wait:5] criança,[wait:5] saindo da frente!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-19.english: * I'm Sned,[wait:5] the Underground's premiere Snail Mailman![wait:5] I'm delivering important letters.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-19.ptbr: * Sou Sned,[wait:5] o principal Carteiro-Caracol do Subsolo![wait:5] Estou entregando cartas importantes.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-21.english: * Don't worry about me,[wait:5] kid.[wait:5]\n* I'm just taking life one day at a time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-sned-21.ptbr: * Não se preocupe comigo,[wait:5] criança.[wait:5]\n* Só estou vivendo um dia de cada vez.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * Sorry,[wait:5] we're already friends![wait:5] \n* I only talk to people I've \nnever met.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Desculpe,[wait:5] já somos amigos![wait:5] \n* Só falo com pessoas que \nnunca conheci.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.english: * Come back when you're someone I've never met before!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.ptbr: * Volte quando for alguém que eu nunca conheci!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-3.english: * Ah,[wait:5] have you been enjoying the CORE Square?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-3.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] está gostando da Praça do NÚCLEO?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-4.english: * Why,[wait:5] yes!\n[wait:5]* In fact,[wait:5] as a new business in.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-4.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] sim!\n[wait:5]* Na verdade,[wait:5] como um novo negócio em.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-7.english: * Yeah![wait:5]\n* You're the white monster.[wait:5] We're already friends!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-7.ptbr: * Sim![wait:5]\n* Você é o monstro branco.[wait:5] Já somos amigos!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * I only talk to people I've \nnever met.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Volte quando for alguém que eu nunca conheci!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * Oh,[wait:5] hello there![wait:5] You look \nnew here!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] olá![wait:5] Você parece \nser novo por aqui!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * Welcome![wait:5] To![wait:5] \n* CORE Square![wait:5]\n* The social hub of Hotland!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Bem-vindo![wait:5] À![wait:5] \n* Praça do NÚCLEO![wait:5]\n* O centro social de Hotland!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * I don't know where you came from,[wait:5] stranger,[wait:5] but I hope you enjoy your stay!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Não sei de onde você veio,[wait:5] estranho,[wait:5] mas espero que aproveite a estadia!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * Oh?[wait:5] A white monster?[wait:5]\n* Yes,[wait:5] I've seen them!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Oh?[wait:5] Um monstro branco?[wait:5]\n* Sim,[wait:5] eu vi!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * They were flying westwards in quite a hurry.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Estava voando para o oeste com muita pressa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.english: * They're a local though,[wait:5] so I didn't talk to them.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-1.ptbr: * Mas é daqui,[wait:5] então não conversei.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.english: * I only talk to people I've never seen before!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.ptbr: * Eu só converso com quem nunca vi antes!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.english: * This means my friends list is always growing!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-origami-2.ptbr: * Assim minha lista de amigos sempre cresce!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-1.english: * Oh woe is me![wait:5]\n* My favourite restaurant,[wait:5] The Hive,[wait:5] is closed!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-1.ptbr: * Ai de mim![wait:5]\n* Meu restaurante favorito,[wait:5] A Colmeia,[wait:5] está fechado!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-4.ptbr: * Suspiro...[wait:5] Onde uma larva \ncomo eu acha uma comida boa \npor aqui?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-8.ptbr: * O futuro maior restaurante que o Subsolo já teve-

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-9.english: * I guess I'll just have to wait until they reopen... Sigh!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-9.ptbr: * Acho que só resta esperar até reabrirem... Suspiro!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-1.ptbr: * SUSPIRO! \n* De fato,[wait:5] não há nada a fazer além de esperar...[wait:5] e[shake][speed:0.2] morrer de fome...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-1.english: *[wait:20] ...You know,[wait:5] Sunny,[wait:5] maybe we can try again another time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-grubguy-1.ptbr: *[wait:20] ...Sabe,[wait:5] Sunny,[wait:5] talvez possamos tentar de novo outra hora.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-wormworm-.english: * Hm?[wait:5]\n* Would you like me to move?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-wormworm-.ptbr: * Hm?[wait:5]\n* Quer que eu saia do caminho?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-wormworm-.english: * What was that?[wait:5]\n* Blocking your way?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-wormworm-.ptbr: * O que foi?[wait:5]\n* Estou bloqueando o caminho?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-wormworm-.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] mil desculpas.\n[wait:5]* Vou sair do caminho.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-floppyfis.english: * I'm a floppy fish.\n[wait:5]* Watch me flop.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-floppyfis.ptbr: * Sou um peixe molenga.\n[wait:5]* Veja como eu me debato.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-floppyfis.english: * Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop Flop.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-floppyfis.ptbr: * Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof Plof.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-1.english: * Urgh...[wait:5] Can you believe this?[wait:5]\n* Using my likeness like this...[wait:5]\n* And no royalties,[wait:5] no less!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-1.ptbr: * Argh...[wait:5] Dá para acreditar?[wait:5]\n* Usando minha imagem assim...[wait:5]\n* E sem direitos autorais,[wait:5] ainda por cima!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-2.english: * \"Human-Style apartments\"?[wait:5]\n* That's what they want you to think!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-2.ptbr: * \"Apartamentos Estilo Humano\"?[wait:5]\n* É nisso que querem que você acredite!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-3.english: * Just you wait.[wait:5]\n* My lawyers will be in contact...\n
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-3.ptbr: * Espere só.[wait:5]\n* Meus advogados entrarão em contato...\n

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-4.english: * Huh?\n[wait:5]* Who am I suing exactly?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-4.ptbr: * Hã?\n[wait:5]* Quem exatamente eu estou processando?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-5.english: * Isn't it obvious,[wait:5] you blockhead?!\n[wait:5]* The buildings!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mason-5.ptbr: * Não é óbvio,[wait:5] cabeça de bloco?!\n[wait:5]* Os prédios!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-1.english: * So are you gonna help me win this case or not?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-1.ptbr: * Então vai me ajudar a ganhar este caso ou não?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-2.english: * Sir,[wait:5] I'm a criminal defense lawyer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-3.ptbr: * Responda à pergunta,[wait:5] cabeça de bloco!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-5.english: * (Sigh...[wait:5] This guy is gonna be the death of me.)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-5.ptbr: * (Suspiro...[wait:5] Esse sujeito ainda vai acabar comigo.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-6.english: * (And I can't afford the reincarnation or I'll miss my niece's wedding.)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-6.ptbr: * (E não posso pagar a reencarnação ou perderei o casamento da minha sobrinha.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-7.english: * Now,[wait:5] I completely understand your grievances,[wait:5] but...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-8.english: * No buts![wait:5] It's entirely unacceptable![wait:5] Clear infringement!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-8.ptbr: * Nada de mas![wait:5] É totalmente inaceitável![wait:5] Violação evidente!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-9.english: * Have you considered it may just be a...[wait:5]\n* Coincidence?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-9.ptbr: * Já considerou que talvez seja só uma...[wait:5]\n* Coincidência?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-10.english: * Coincidence?[wait:5]\n* How could that be possible?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-11.english: * Perhaps you just have one of those faces,[wait:5] you know?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-11.ptbr: * Talvez você só tenha um desses rostos,[wait:5] sabe?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-12.english: * Urgh![wait:5] If it isn't me,[wait:5] then it's my mother![wait:5] Meaning we sue anyway!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lawyer-12.ptbr: * Urgh![wait:5] Se não sou eu,[wait:5] é minha mãe![wait:5] Então processamos do mesmo jeito!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-2.english: * I was challenging this lamp to a staring contest.\n[wait:5]* And I was winning,[wait:5] too!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-2.ptbr: * Eu estava desafiando esta lâmpada para um duelo de olhares.\n[wait:5]* E eu estava ganhando,[wait:5] também!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-3.english: * The staring at lamps club is going to be so ashamed of me...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-3.ptbr: * O clube de encarar lâmpadas vai ter tanta vergonha de mim...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-4.english: * Maybe I should look on the bright side.\n[wait:5]* And not blink this time.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-5.english: * Oh,[wait:5] this guy looks like they have great taste. [wait:5]\n* Let me try...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-7.english: * DAMN IT ALL!!\n[wait:5]* YOU'VE RUINED EVERYTHING!!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-8.english: * Wh-[wait:5]Wha-?[wait:5]\n* I didn't...[wait:5] It wasn't my-
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-8.ptbr: * O-[wait:5]O quê-?[wait:5]\n* Eu não...[wait:5] Não foi minha-

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-9.english: * Don't give me that![wait:5]\n* Because of you,[wait:5] I lost my staring contest.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-9.ptbr: * Nem venha com essa![wait:5]\n* Por sua causa,[wait:5] perdi meu duelo de olhares.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-11.english: * YES,[wait:5] with a LAMP.\n[wait:5]* How else am I supposed to prove I have the strongest eye?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-11.ptbr: * SIM,[wait:5] com uma LÂMPADA.\n[wait:5]* De que outra forma provo que tenho o olho mais forte?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-12.english: * I'm going to tell the whole staring at lamps club about what you did here today!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-12.ptbr: * Vou contar ao clube inteiro de encarar lâmpadas o que você fez hoje!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-13.english: * N-NO![wait:5]\n* I was just getting some renown there!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-13.ptbr: * N-NÃO![wait:5]\n* Eu estava começando a ganhar fama lá!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-15.english: * I run the soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the underground now!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-15.ptbr: * Agora eu comando o futuro maior restaurante do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-16.english: * I don't need to worry about what the lamp staring club thinks.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-16.ptbr: * Não preciso me preocupar com o que o clube de encarar lâmpadas pensa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-17.english: * I'm headed for bigger and better.\n[wait:5]* AND brighter!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-17.ptbr: * Estou indo para coisas maiores e melhores.\n[wait:5]* E mais BRILHANTES!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-18.english: * You wouldn't um...[wait:5]\n* Want to check out our restaurant,[wait:5] would you?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-18.ptbr: * Você não gostaria de...[wait:5]\n* Conhecer nosso restaurante,[wait:5] gostaria?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-21.english: * Maybe I should look on the bright side.\n[wait:5]* And not blink this time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-eyeguy-21.ptbr: * Talvez eu devesse ver o lado iluminado.\n[wait:5]* E não piscar desta vez.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-4.english: * To go or not to go...\n[wait:5]* Which would be more fun...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-4.ptbr: * Ir ou não ir...\n[wait:5]* O que seria mais divertido...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-6.english: * Well, [wait:5]if you're looking for fun,[wait:5] then might I interest you in
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-6.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] se procura diversão,[wait:5] talvez eu possa oferecer

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-7.english: * The soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the Underground!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-7.ptbr: * O futuro maior restaurante do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-8.english: * Restaurant?[wait:5]\n* But I don't have a mouth.[wait:5]\n* I photosynthesize.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-8.ptbr: * Restaurante?[wait:5]\n* Mas eu não tenho boca.[wait:5]\n* Faço fotossíntese.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Unless you serve the Sun,[wait:5] I'm afraid it's a no-go.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * A menos que sirvam o Sol,[wait:5] receio que não dê.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Sir,[wait:5] have I got news for you!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * Senhor,[wait:5] tenho uma novidade para você!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * We might not have the Sun,[wait:5] but we have something...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * Talvez não tenhamos o Sol,[wait:5] mas temos algo...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * We have Sunny here![wait:5]\n* That's close enough,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * Temos Sunny aqui![wait:5]\n* É parecido o bastante,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Sunny,[wait:5] eh?[wait:5] \n* Do you emit electromagnetic radiation?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * Sunny,[wait:5] é?[wait:5] \n* Você emite radiação eletromagnética?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.english: * Well then you're useless to me.[wait:5]\n* I'll find fun elsewhere!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-1.ptbr: * Então você não me serve.[wait:5]\n* Vou procurar diversão em outro lugar!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Come back when you emit UV rays,[wait:5] kid.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Volte quando emitir raios UV,[wait:5] jovem.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Oh dear,[wait:5] it appears the park is closed.[wait:5] A tree fell or something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Oh céus,[wait:5] parece que o parque está fechado.[wait:5] Uma árvore caiu ou algo assim.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * A pity.[wait:5]\n* I was going to visit my grandmother.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Que pena.[wait:5]\n* Eu ia visitar minha avó.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * But I suppose that will have to wait.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Mas acho que isso terá que esperar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * Or I could go home and not \nvisit her.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Ou posso ir para casa e não \nvisitá-la.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * And play Tree Games.\n[wait:5]* Games for Trees.\n[wait:5]* Tree Games.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * E jogar Jogos de Árvore.\n[wait:5]* Jogos para Árvores.\n[wait:5]* Jogos de Árvore.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.english: * That sounds a lot more fun \nthan visiting my grandma.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-treeguy-2.ptbr: * Isso parece muito mais divertido \ndo que visitar minha avó.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-2.english: * The last one was scrambling towards the elevator like a chicken with its head cut off!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-2.ptbr: * O último corria para o elevador como galinha sem cabeça!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-4.english: * This square used to be for engineers doing the hard work building the CORE.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-4.ptbr: * Esta praça era dos engenheiros que trabalhavam duro construindo o NÚCLEO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-5.english: * But now,[wait:5] it's being overtaken \nby young spuds like you.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-5.ptbr: * Mas agora,[wait:5] está sendo tomada \npor jovens batatas como você.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-6.english: * Every day I used to come home with calloused hands after setting up the pipes.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-6.ptbr: * Todo dia eu voltava para casa com as mãos calejadas depois de instalar os canos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-7.english: * There's just no drive in \ntoday's youth![wait:5]\n* Bah!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-7.ptbr: * A juventude de hoje não tem \ndisposição![wait:5]\n* Bah!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-8.english: * I'd like to see this generation make something as great as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-8.ptbr: * Queria ver esta geração fazer algo tão grandioso quanto o NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-10.english: * Bah![wait:5] \n* Now all the youngins are congregating!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-10.ptbr: * Bah![wait:5] \n* Agora todos os jovens estão se reunindo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-12.english: * These kids...[wait:5] \n* Always running around like the world was made for you!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-12.ptbr: * Essas crianças...[wait:5] \n* Sempre correndo como se o mundo fosse de vocês!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-13.english: * Bah! Stop being so lazy![wait:5] \n* No work ethic![wait:5] \n* No drive!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-13.ptbr: * Bah! Parem de ser preguiçosos![wait:5] \n* Sem ética de trabalho![wait:5] \n* Sem iniciativa!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-14.english: * I bet you whippersnappers don't even know how lucky you are to have the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-14.ptbr: * Aposto que vocês nem sabem a sorte que têm por ter o NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-15.english: * Or how to operate a T-2850 Pipe Cleaning Royal Certified Precision Forklift!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-15.ptbr: * Ou como operar uma Empilhadeira de Precisão Real Certificada T-2850 para Limpeza de Canos!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-16.english: * You youngins could never create something as beautiful and wonderous as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-16.ptbr: * Vocês jovens jamais criariam algo tão belo e maravilhoso quanto o NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-18.english: * We've got work ethic! [wait:5]\n * We've got drive!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-18.ptbr: * Nós temos ética de trabalho! [wait:5]\n * Temos disposição!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-19.english: * We know how to operate a T-27...[wait:5] uh...[wait:5] Pipe Cleaning...[wait:5] Thing!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-19.ptbr: * Sabemos operar uma T-27...[wait:5] hã...[wait:5] Limpa-Canos...[wait:5] Coisa!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-20.english: * Maybe,[wait:5] we could end up making something that's never been done before!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-20.ptbr: * Talvez,[wait:5] a gente acabe criando algo nunca feito antes!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-21.ptbr: * Bah![wait:5] \n* É mesmo?! \n* Como o quê?!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-22.english: * Like the greatest restaurant in the underground!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-22.ptbr: * Como o maior restaurante do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-24.english: * What's a restaurant gonna do?![wait:5] \n* Feed people?[wait:5] Who work?[wait:5] \nOn what—[wait:5] The CORE!?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-24.ptbr: * O que um restaurante vai fazer?![wait:5] \n* Alimentar gente?[wait:5] Que trabalha?[wait:5] \nEm quê—[wait:5] No NÚCLEO!?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-25.english: * Could barely compare to the greatness of a Polybutylene Bend-45! Much less the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-25.ptbr: * Mal se compara à grandeza de uma Curva de Polibutileno-45! Muito menos ao NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-26.english: * Whatever you youngings try, \nit's still in its shadow!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-26.ptbr: * O que quer que vocês jovens tentem, \nainda ficará à sombra dele!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-30.english: * I'd like to see this generation make something as great as the CORE!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-oldguy-30.ptbr: * Queria ver esta geração fazer algo tão grandioso quanto o NÚCLEO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.english: * [wait:5]...Before standing back up and continuing on.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-ittybitty.ptbr: * Boa sorte,[wait:5] bravos peregrinos.[wait:5]\n* Boa sorte.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * [speed:1.2]Um![wait:5] We're not allowed in the CORE![wait:5] Authorised personnel only.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Hum![wait:5] Não podemos entrar no NÚCLEO![wait:5] Só pessoal autorizado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * Besides,[wait:5] the CORE is really dangerous.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] o NÚCLEO é muito perigoso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * You wouldn't want to trip and fall in!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-coreexit-.english: * You've already had one close call,[wait:5] no need for more!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hiveenter.english: * Aren't they closed?[wait:5] \n* Maybe it's best if you[wait:5], uh,[wait:10] don't go in there.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * Sorry!\n[wait:5]* The lower area is still under construction at the moment.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.ptbr: * Desculpe!\n[wait:5]* A área de baixo ainda está em construção.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * We're installing some newfangled electrical wiring and doodads for a new business to run.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.ptbr: * Estamos instalando fiação elétrica moderna e umas engenhocas para um novo negócio funcionar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * It's supposed to be something truly revolutionary.\n[wait:5]* Some crazy new surface tech.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-construct.english: * I don't get the hype...[wait:5]\n* But I also live under a rock.[wait:5]\n* Literally.

* Isso![wait:5] Continuamos trabalhando quase nada quase!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-2.english: * The ittybitty migration is crossing this path.[wait:5] This happens only once a generation.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-4.english: * How long is the migration going to take?[wait:5]\n* That's hard to gauge...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-4.ptbr: * Quanto tempo a migração vai levar?[wait:5]\n* Difícil estimar...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-5.english: * What?[wait:5] You want to pass?[wait:5]\n* Well,[wait:5] that sucks for you.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stop-5.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5] Quer passar?[wait:5]\n* Bem,[wait:5] azar o seu.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * This is outrageous!\n[wait:5]* OUTRAGEOUS,[wait:5] you hear me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Isto é um absurdo!\n[wait:5]* UM ABSURDO,[wait:5] ouviu?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Blocking the road for these...[wait:5] Weird little guys!\n[wait:5]* Absolutely absurd!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Bloquear a rua por causa desses...[wait:5] Carinhas estranhos!\n[wait:5]* Um completo absurdo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * How am I supposed to stand around in a single spot \nwithout moving now??

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * The audacity of this guy![wait:5]\n* Getting in the way of everyone for these little blorbos.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Que audácia desse sujeito![wait:5]\n* Atrapalhando todo mundo por esses blorbinhos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Although...[wait:5] They are pretty cute...[wait:5]\n* Argh![wait:5] Snap out of it!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Embora...[wait:5] Eles sejam bem fofinhos...[wait:5]\n* Argh![wait:5] Reaja!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * This is outrageous!\n[wait:5]* OUTRAGEOUS,[wait:5] you hear me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Isto é um absurdo!\n[wait:5]* UM ABSURDO,[wait:5] ouviu?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Blocking the road for these...[wait:5] Weird little guys!\n[wait:5]* Absolutely absurd!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Bloquear a rua por causa desses...[wait:5] Carinhas estranhos!\n[wait:5]* Um completo absurdo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * This wormular paradox hurts my brain and my ability to stand in one place.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Este paradoxo vermicular dói na minha cabeça e na minha capacidade de ficar parado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * Blocking the alleyway...\n[wait:5]* And for what?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Bloqueando o beco...\n[wait:5]* E para quê?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.english: * I was really looking forward to getting mugged,[wait:5] you know.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-angry_bun.ptbr: * Eu estava ansioso para ser assaltado,[wait:5] sabe.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Can you believe this hogwash?[wait:5]\n* Always with construction in \nthis goshdarn square...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.ptbr: * Dá para acreditar nessa bobagem?[wait:5]\n* Sempre tem construção nessa \npraça dos infernos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Back in my day, we used magic to light our homes![wait:5] None of this tacky lamp nonsense!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.ptbr: * Na minha época, usávamos magia para iluminar nossas casas![wait:5] Nada dessas lâmpadas cafonas!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Grumble grumble...\n[wait:5]* This square,[wait:5] I tell ya!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.ptbr: * Resmungo resmungo...\n[wait:5]* Essa praça,[wait:5] eu lhe digo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * What?[wait:5]\n* If I hate this place so much,[wait:5] why don't I leave?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5]\n* Se odeio tanto este lugar,[wait:5] por que não vou embora?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.english: * Grumble grumble...\n[wait:5]* Grumble grumble,[wait:5] I say!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-old_diamo.ptbr: * Resmungo resmungo...\n[wait:5]* Resmungo resmungo,[wait:5] eu digo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-1.english: * Sup dude.[wait:5]\n* Always nice to meet the new neighbours.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-1.ptbr: * E aí, cara.[wait:5]\n* Sempre bom conhecer os novos vizinhos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-2.english: * What's that expression for?\n[wait:5]* Is something wrong?[wait:5]\n* Was it something I said?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-2.ptbr: * Por que essa expressão?\n[wait:5]* Algum problema?[wait:5]\n* Eu disse alguma coisa?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-3.english: * Alright,[wait:5] if you need anything just let me know,[wait:5] dude.\n[wait:5]* I live under these stairs.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-3.ptbr: * Certo,[wait:5] se precisar de algo é só avisar,[wait:5] cara.\n[wait:5]* Moro embaixo destas escadas.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-4.english: * I see you got a letter.[wait:5]\n* That's pretty cool,[wait:5] dude.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-4.ptbr: * Vejo que recebeu uma carta.[wait:5]\n* Bem legal,[wait:5] cara.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-5.english: * One time a mailman tried to shove a letter into my mouth.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-5.ptbr: * Uma vez um carteiro tentou enfiar uma carta na minha boca.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-6.english: * It was pretty tasty but that's besides the point.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-6.ptbr: * Era bem gostosa, mas isso não vem ao caso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-7.english: * Dude,[wait:5] I saw a bunch of people fly out of your apartment.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-7.ptbr: * Cara,[wait:5] vi um monte de gente saindo voando do seu apartamento.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-8.english: * Were you guys having a party in there or something?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-8.ptbr: * Vocês estavam fazendo uma festa ou algo assim?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-9.english: * Not judging,[wait:5] but...[wait:5] Maybe you could have invited me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-9.ptbr: * Sem julgar,[wait:5] mas...[wait:5] Talvez pudessem ter me convidado?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-10.english: * I'm never invited to any neighbour parties...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-10.ptbr: * Nunca me convidam para festas de vizinhos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-11.english: * Dancing has gotten pretty popular in the Square it seems...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-11.ptbr: * Parece que dançar ficou bem popular na Praça...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-12.english: * They used to call me the dance king back in college.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-12.ptbr: * Na faculdade me chamavam de rei da dança.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-13.english: * I could tear up the dancefloor like nobody's business!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-13.ptbr: * Eu acabava com a pista de dança como ninguém!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-14.english: * All the ladies loved my dancing.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-14.ptbr: * Todas as garotas adoravam minha dança.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-15.english: * I'm thinking of investing into the stock market.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-15.ptbr: * Estou pensando em investir na bolsa de valores.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-16.english: * By which I mean imagining a line going up.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-vendm-16.ptbr: * Ou seja, imaginar uma linha subindo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-1.english: * You'd best be careful around \nthe backstreets of the CORE Square,[wait:5] kiddo.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-1.ptbr: * É melhor ter cuidado nos \nbecos da Praça do NÚCLEO,[wait:5] jovem.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-2.english: * The square's got a squeaky\nclean veneer out here,[wait:5] but there's some real shady nooks.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-2.ptbr: * A praça parece impecável\npor aqui,[wait:5] mas tem uns cantos bem suspeitos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-3.english: * Keep an eye out,[wait:5] kiddo.\n[wait:5]* If you see something untoward,[wait:5] you should tell a royal guard.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-3.ptbr: * Fique de olho,[wait:5] jovem.\n[wait:5]* Se vir algo suspeito,[wait:5] avise um guarda real.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-4.english: * One time,[wait:5] a guy in a trenchcoat came up to me and tried to sell me something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-4.ptbr: * Uma vez,[wait:5] um sujeito de sobretudo veio até mim e tentou me vender uma coisa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-5.english: * Told me it was the good stuff.\n[wait:5]* That I'd get completely hooked.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-5.ptbr: * Disse que era da boa.\n[wait:5]* Que eu ficaria totalmente viciado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-6.english: * He was right![wait:5]\n* I haven't had a meal without mayonnaise since!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-6.ptbr: * Ele tinha razão![wait:5]\n* Desde então não faço uma refeição sem maionese!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-7.english: * Would you be interested in our restaurant-

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-8.english: * Can it,[wait:5] kiddo.\n[wait:5]* I already got a dealer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-10.english: * You heard me.[wait:5]\n* Not interested in your business.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-10.ptbr: * Você ouviu.[wait:5]\n* Não tenho interesse no seu negócio.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-12.english: * Anyway,[wait:5] yeah.[wait:5]\n* Be careful out there.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-drag-12.ptbr: * Enfim,[wait:5] é isso.[wait:5]\n* Tome cuidado por aí.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * WE ARE STACK.\n[wait:5]* TOGETHER,[wait:5] WE ARE STRONG.\n[wait:5]* ANY CHALLENGE WE CAN OVERCOME!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.ptbr: * NÓS SOMOS PILHA.\n[wait:5]* JUNTOS,[wait:5] SOMOS FORTES.\n[wait:5]* QUALQUER DESAFIO VENCEMOS!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * THIS WILL BE OUR STRONGEST.[wait:5]\n* STAIRS.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.ptbr: * ESTE SERÁ NOSSO MAIS FORTE.[wait:5]\n* ESCADAS.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * IF WE FAIL,[wait:5] THE STACK WILL \nFALL,[wait:5] SO WE MUST THINK HARD \nABOUT PLAN.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.ptbr: * SE FALHARMOS,[wait:5] A PILHA \nCAIRÁ,[wait:5] ENTÃO PRECISAMOS PENSAR \nMUITO NO PLANO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.english: * HMMMM...[wait:5]\n* WE KNOW! [wait:5]\n* WHAT IF WE HIT IT?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-stackdude.ptbr: * HMMMM...[wait:5]\n* JÁ SABEMOS! [wait:5]\n* E SE BATERMOS NISSO?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.english: * The ladies call me BIG HORNY.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.ptbr: * As garotas me chamam de GRANDÃO CHIFRUDO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.english: * There is no other reason the ladies call me that.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bighorny-.ptbr: * Não existe nenhum outro motivo para as garotas me chamarem assim.
