worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-1.english: * I'm so happy to finally be an adult!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-1.ptbr: * Estou tão feliz por finalmente ser adulto!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-2.english: * Real job![wait:5]\n* Real money!\n[wait:5]* Real hat!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-2.ptbr: * Emprego real![wait:5]\n* Dinheiro real!\n[wait:5]* Chapéu real!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-3.english: * Now I can live life fully irresponsibly!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-3.ptbr: * Agora posso viver de forma totalmente irresponsável!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-4.english: * Smoking!\n[wait:5]* Bungie jumping![wait:5]\n* Excessive energy drinks!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-4.ptbr: * Fumar!\n[wait:5]* Bungee jumping![wait:5]\n* Energéticos em excesso!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-5.english: * No more parents,[wait:5] I'm my own worm![wait:5]\n* No more strings on me!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-5.ptbr: * Chega de pais,[wait:5] sou meu próprio verme![wait:5]\n* Não tenho mais amarras!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-6.english: * No more parents,[wait:5] I'm my own worm![wait:5]\n* No more strings on me!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-worm-6.ptbr: * Chega de pais,[wait:5] sou meu próprio verme![wait:5]\n* Não tenho mais amarras!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-1.english: * I'm Billy![wait:5] I love ingredients![wait:5]\n* Everyone has ingredients they enjoy.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-1.ptbr: * Sou Billy![wait:5] Adoro ingredientes![wait:5]\n* Todo mundo tem seus favoritos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-2.english: * If you want to be the best at COOKing,[wait:5] you'll need to use ingredients whenever possible.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-2.ptbr: * Se quiser ser excelente em COZINHar,[wait:5] terá que usar ingredientes sempre que puder.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-3.english: * Even if people don't reveal their preferences,[wait:5] they still have them!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-3.ptbr: * Mesmo quando as pessoas não revelam suas preferências,[wait:5] elas ainda existem!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-4.english: * Try to experiment with ingredients,[wait:5] you never know what might happen!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-4.ptbr: * Experimente ingredientes diferentes,[wait:5] nunca se sabe o que pode acontecer!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-5.english: * That's your Billy tip!\n[wait:5]* And I'm Billy![wait:5]\n* Yay!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-billy-5.ptbr: * Essa é a dica do Billy!\n[wait:5]* E eu sou Billy![wait:5]\n* Viva!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-1.english: * Ah,[wait:5] the worm has finally moved![wait:5] I can finally get back home!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-1.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] o verme finalmente saiu![wait:5] Finalmente posso voltar para casa!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-2.english: * ...Though,[wait:5] to be frank...[wait:5] I got kind of accustomed to sleeping under that bench.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-2.ptbr: * ...Embora,[wait:5] para falar a verdade...[wait:5] Eu me acostumei a dormir debaixo daquele banco.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-3.english: * Do you think they'll let me take that bench home with me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-3.ptbr: * Acha que vão deixar eu levar aquele banco para casa?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-4.english: * My favourite thing about the CORE Square is how lively it is.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-4.ptbr: * Minha coisa favorita na Praça do NÚCLEO é como ela é animada.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-5.ptbr: * Tem gente nova por aqui \ntodos os dias!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-6.english: * And even the old ones might \nhave something new to say.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-6.ptbr: * E até os antigos podem \nter algo novo para dizer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-7.english: * You'll always find something \nnew if you explore a little \nbit every day!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-7.ptbr: * Sempre vai encontrar algo \nnovo se explorar um pouco \ntodos os dias!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-8.english: * A shame that so much of the square is blocked off at the moment,[wait:5] though...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-8.ptbr: * Pena que tanta coisa da praça esteja bloqueada no momento,[wait:5] mas...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-9.english: * Maybe as time goes on,[wait:5] those areas'll open up again.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-9.ptbr: * Talvez com o tempo,[wait:5] essas áreas abram de novo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-10.english: * ...At least I hope so. \n[wait:5]* My house is kinda blocked by a weird worm right now.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-10.ptbr: * ...Pelo menos espero. \n[wait:5]* Minha casa está meio bloqueada por um verme estranho agora.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-11.english: * Maybe I'll sleep under a \nbench tonight...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-mouse-11.ptbr: * Talvez eu durma debaixo de um \nbanco esta noite...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * It's ever so wonderful to see this Square so lively.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * É tão maravilhoso ver esta Praça tão animada.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Seeing this place bustle and prosper makes it more bearable...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Ver este lugar movimentado e próspero torna mais suportável...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Knowing we're probably going to be stuck down here forever.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Saber que provavelmente ficaremos presos aqui para sempre.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Hey,[wait:5] don't say that!\n[wait:5]* That's not true!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Ei,[wait:5] não diga isso!\n[wait:5]* Isso não é verdade!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * We gotta hold onto hope that we'll see the surface.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Precisamos manter a esperança de que veremos a superfície.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * And we will![wait:5]\n* You remember the prophecy,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * E vamos ver![wait:5]\n* Você se lembra da profecia,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Oh,[wait:5] how I wish I could still have that naive,[wait:5] youthful faith in fate.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] como eu queria ainda ter essa fé ingênua,[wait:5] juvenil no destino.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * You've heard the murmurings,[wait:5] haven't you?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Você ouviu os rumores,[wait:5] não ouviu?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Not even the fate promised in the prophecy grants much hope anymore.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Nem mesmo o destino prometido na profecia traz muita esperança agora.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * You mean the whole \"Angel of Death\" thing?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Está falando de toda essa coisa do \"Anjo da Morte\"?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Listen,[wait:5] I believe that as long as we hold onto hope,
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Escute,[wait:5] acredito que enquanto mantivermos a esperança,

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * We can accomplish anything.[wait:5]\n * We will see the sky!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Podemos conseguir qualquer coisa.[wait:5]\n * Vamos ver o céu!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * ...[wait:5]I'm glad you can hold onto hope.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Fico feliz que você ainda tenha esperança.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * Maybe if that hope makes the underground more bearable,[wait:5] it's better to believe than despair.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Talvez, se essa esperança tornar o Subsolo mais suportável,[wait:5] seja melhor acreditar do que se desesperar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * ...[wait:5]Though,[wait:5] I'm afraid that hope is not one I can justify for myself.[wait:5] C'est la vie,[wait:5] non?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Embora,[wait:5] receio que essa esperança não seja uma que eu consiga justificar para mim.[wait:5] C'est la vie,[wait:5] non?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * If we're able to have places like this in the Underground...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Se conseguimos ter lugares assim no Subsolo...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.english: * It makes me feel better about the fact I won't live to see the Sun.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hippomole.ptbr: * Isso me faz sentir melhor sobre não viver para ver o Sol.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-1.english: * Father.[wait:5] I desire the healthy ingredients from this fine vegetarian establishment.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-1.ptbr: * Pai.[wait:5] Desejo os ingredientes saudáveis deste refinado estabelecimento vegetariano.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-2.english: * They will fill my tummy with fibers,[wait:5] iron and vitamins and I will be very glad.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-2.ptbr: * Eles encherão minha barriga de fibras,[wait:5] ferro e vitaminas, e ficarei muito contente.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-3.english: * Perchance I will nibble on a carrot,[wait:5] like the rabbit in those charming cartoons.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-3.ptbr: * Quiçá eu mordisque uma cenoura,[wait:5] como o coelho daqueles encantadores desenhos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-4.english: * Afterwards,[wait:5] let us head to the tax office,[wait:5] oh Father of mine.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-4.ptbr: * Depois,[wait:5] vamos ao escritório de impostos,[wait:5] ó meu Pai.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-5.english: * There,[wait:5] I shall entertain my mind with the most childish folly.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-5.ptbr: * Lá,[wait:5] entreterei minha mente com a mais infantil das travessuras.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-6.english: * I shall suckle on this excessive sweet as I add 0s to every number on the form.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-6.ptbr: * Chuparei este doce excessivo enquanto acrescento zeros a cada número do formulário.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-7.english: * Hmm?\n[wait:5]* Oh,[wait:5] my apologies.[wait:5]\n* Goo goo ga ga.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-babird-7.ptbr: * Hmm?\n[wait:5]* Oh,[wait:5] minhas desculpas.[wait:5]\n* Gu gu da da.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-bibird-1.english: * Couldn't you just want dino nuggies or something?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-bibird-1.ptbr: * Não podia querer nuggets de dinossauro ou algo assim?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-1.english: * HONK HONK!\n[wait:5]* GET OUT OF THE ROAD!!![wait:5]\n* HONK HONK!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-1.ptbr: * BIBI BIBI!\n[wait:5]* SAIA DA RUA!!![wait:5]\n* BIBI BIBI!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-2.english: * IT'S BECAUSE OF RECKLESS PEDESTRIANS LIKE YOU THAT THE ROADS ARE SO UNSAFE!![wait:5] HONK!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-2.ptbr: * É POR CAUSA DE PEDESTRES IMPRUDENTES COMO VOCÊ QUE AS RUAS SÃO TÃO PERIGOSAS!![wait:5] BIBI!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-3.english: * HONK HONK!\n[wait:5]* THE ONE THING I HATE MORE THAN PEDESTRIANS IS STAIRS!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-3.ptbr: * BIBI BIBI!\n[wait:5]* A ÚNICA COISA QUE ODEIO MAIS QUE PEDESTRES SÃO ESCADAS!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-4.english: * YOU CAN'T DRIVE ON THEM![wait:5] WHEN\nI TRIED, MY CAR GOT ALL DENTED\nIN AN ASCENDING PATTERN!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-4.ptbr: * NÃO DÁ PARA DIRIGIR NELAS![wait:5] QUANDO\nTENTEI, MEU CARRO FICOU TODO AMASSADO\nNUM PADRÃO ASCENDENTE!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-5.english: * I SHOULD BE RUNNING THIS PLACE!\n[wait:5]* OR BETTER YET,[wait:5] DRIVING IT.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-5.ptbr: * EU DEVERIA COMANDAR ESTE LUGAR!\n[wait:5]* OU MELHOR AINDA,[wait:5] DIRIGI-LO.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-6.english: * WHAT DID YOU SAY?![wait:5]\n* I'M A GOOSE,[wait:5] NOT A CAR?!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-6.ptbr: * O QUE VOCÊ DISSE?![wait:5]\n* EU SOU UM GANSO,[wait:5] NÃO UM CARRO?!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-goose-7.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Por favor, só me deixa ter isso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.english: * Hmmm,[wait:5] yes.\n[wait:5]* The News.\n[wait:5]* And The Politics.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.ptbr: * Hmmm,[wait:5] sim.\n[wait:5]* As Notícias.\n[wait:5]* E A Política.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.english: * I love looking at them.\n[wait:5]* As any resposible adult does.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.ptbr: * Adoro olhar para elas.\n[wait:5]* Como todo adulto responsável.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.english: * (Ok,[wait:5] I admit it.[wait:5] I don't really like the news.[wait:5] I just read the newspaper to look smart.)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.ptbr: * (Certo,[wait:5] eu admito.[wait:5] Não gosto muito de notícias.[wait:5] Só leio o jornal para parecer inteligente.)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.english: * (I just wish the newspaper had something a little more fun or exciting for me...)
worldcutscene-core_square-text-left_news.ptbr: * (Eu só queria que o jornal tivesse algo um pouco mais divertido ou empolgante para mim...)

worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.english: * Hmmm...[wait:5] The paper says...[wait:5]\n* Today is going to be hot!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.ptbr: * Hmmm...[wait:5] O jornal diz...[wait:5]\n* Hoje vai fazer calor!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.english: * ...[wait:5]And tomorrow will also be hot![wait:5]\n* And yesterday was also hot!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]E amanhã também vai fazer calor![wait:5]\n* E ontem também fez calor!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.english: * ...[wait:5]Maybe they should fire the weather guy.
* Wait...[wait:5]\n* We're underground.[wait:5]\n* There isn't weather.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.ptbr: * Espere...[wait:5]\n* Estamos no Subsolo.[wait:5]\n* Não existe clima.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.english: * Why do they even have a weather guy?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-right_new.ptbr: * Por que eles têm um meteorologista?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.english: * Oh,[wait:5] sweet maiden of the depths,[wait:5] I can hear thy entrancing song calling from below.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] doce donzela das profundezas,[wait:5] ouço tua canção encantadora me chamando de baixo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-2.english: * I beg of thee,[wait:5] make me a blessed knight by allowing me to gaze \nat your illustrious visage!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-2.ptbr: * Rogo-te,[wait:5] faze de mim um cavaleiro abençoado permitindo-me contemplar \nteu ilustre semblante!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-3.english: * ...[wait:5]Oh![wait:5] Fair tidings,[wait:5] young squire.[wait:5] Do not mind my weary sonnet of desire.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-3.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Oh![wait:5] Bons ventos,[wait:5] jovem escudeiro.[wait:5] Não ligue para meu cansado soneto de desejo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-4.english: * As you can see,[wait:5] I am on a holey quest![wait:5] The holeyiest of all quests!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-4.ptbr: * Como pode ver,[wait:5] estou numa missão sagrada![wait:5] A mais sagrada de todas!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-5.english: * To meet the fair princess whose voice travels amidst the \ntunnels beneath this hamlet.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-5.ptbr: * Encontrar a bela princesa cuja voz viaja pelos \ntúneis sob esta aldeia.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-6.english: * I shall descend into the depths,[wait:5] show her my dashing countenence and we will be wed!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-6.ptbr: * Descerei às profundezas,[wait:5] mostrarei meu garboso semblante e nos casaremos!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-7.english: * But avast![wait:5] My daring quest is impeded by this unholey blockade.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-7.ptbr: * Mas cuidado![wait:5] Minha ousada missão é impedida por esta barreira profana.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-8.english: * Fret not,[wait:5] my love!\n* If my voice reaches thine ears, [wait:5]calm thy weary heart!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-8.ptbr: * Não temas,[wait:5] meu amor!\n* Se minha voz alcançar teus ouvidos,[wait:5] acalma teu coração cansado!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-9.english: * With my most holey implement,[wait:5] I shall tear the earth asunder \nand free thee!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-9.ptbr: * Com meu mais sagrado instrumento,[wait:5] rasgarei a terra \ne te libertarei!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.english: * Fellow knight...[wait:5] Begone!\n[wait:5]* I should not receive thine assistance.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.ptbr: * Companheiro cavaleiro...[wait:5] Vá embora!\n[wait:5]* Não devo receber tua ajuda.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.english: * Do not concern thyself with my struggle.[wait:5] You know the old commandment,[wait:5] surely.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.ptbr: * Não te preocupes com minha luta.[wait:5] Conheces o velho mandamento,[wait:5] certamente.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.english: * Where there lies a hole lies also a goal!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-penguin-1.ptbr: * Onde há um buraco também há um objetivo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hatstack-.english: * i dressed up to visit the hive.......
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hatstack-.ptbr: * eu me arrumei para visitar o hive.......

worldcutscene-core_square-text-hatstack-.english: * maybe being dapper is its own reward.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-hatstack-.ptbr: * talvez ser elegante já seja sua própria recompensa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-1.english: * Me and my friend,[wait:5] we don't really see eye to eye,[wait:5] \nyou know?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-1.ptbr: * Eu e meu amigo,[wait:5] não vemos as coisas do mesmo jeito,[wait:5] \nsabe?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-2.english: * If only there was some way to get on the same page.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-2.ptbr: * Se ao menos houvesse um jeito de ficarmos na mesma página.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-3.english: * Or same level,[wait:5] as it were.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-3.ptbr: * Ou no mesmo nível,[wait:5] por assim dizer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-4.english: * Huh?[wait:5]\n* How did we become friends?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-6.english: * We were both waiting to get \non a roller coaster.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-6.ptbr: * Nós dois estávamos esperando para \nentrar numa montanha-russa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-7.english: * But we both failed to meet the height requirements.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-7.ptbr: * Mas nenhum dos dois atingia a altura mínima.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-8.english: * At our lowest,[wait:5] we were there \nfor each other.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-8.ptbr: * No nosso ponto mais baixo,[wait:5] estávamos \nlá um para o outro.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-9.english: * ...Or I guess for me,[wait:5] it'd \nbe my highest?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-9.ptbr: * ...Ou no meu caso,[wait:5] seria \no mais alto?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-10.english: * I'm a little anxious about it...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-10.ptbr: * Estou um pouco ansioso com isso...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-geoff-11.english: * I hope I'm growing on him...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-1.english: * My buddy and I,[wait:5] we're friends,[wait:5] but it's tough.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-1.ptbr: * Meu parceiro e eu,[wait:5] somos amigos,[wait:5] mas é complicado.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-2.english: * I try to talk to him,[wait:5] but his head's always up in the \nclouds!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-2.ptbr: * Tento falar com ele,[wait:5] mas a cabeça dele está sempre \nnas nuvens!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-3.english: * I wish he could be a little \nmore down to earth.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-3.ptbr: * Queria que ele fosse um pouco \nmais pé no chão.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-4.english: * ...Or maybe I could be more \nup to sky?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-4.ptbr: * ...Ou talvez eu possa ficar mais \ncom a cabeça no céu?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-5.english: * Huh?[wait:5]\n* Why are we friends,[wait:5] then?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-5.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5]\n* Por que somos amigos,[wait:5] então?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-6.english: * Well...[wait:5] Sometimes,[wait:5] when the king gives one of his big addresses...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-6.ptbr: * Bem...[wait:5] Às vezes,[wait:5] quando o rei faz um daqueles grandes discursos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-7.english: * You need someone who can \nsupport you.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-7.ptbr: * Você precisa de alguém que possa \ndar apoio.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-8.english: * So you can climb up on them and see past the crowd,[wait:5] you know?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-8.ptbr: * Para subir nessa pessoa e enxergar por cima da multidão,[wait:5] sabe?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-9.english: * Friendship can really move \nyou up in the world.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-keith-9.ptbr: * A amizade realmente pode fazer \nvocê subir na vida.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-6.english: * Oh salutations,[wait:5] young squire![wait:5]\n* Do not mind me,[wait:5] I am simply doing some research.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-6.ptbr: * Oh, saudações,[wait:5] jovem escudeiro![wait:5]\n* Não se preocupe comigo,[wait:5] estou apenas pesquisando.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-7.english: * I'm Professor Shirley of \nHotland University,[wait:5] you see.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-7.ptbr: * Sou a Professora Shirley da \nUniversidade de Hotland,[wait:5] veja bem.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-8.english: * I study and teach history with \na focus on Human-Monster relations.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-8.ptbr: * Estudo e ensino história com \nfoco nas relações entre Humanos e Monstros.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-9.english: * I just came here to this fine square to see the historic \nRoyal Memorial Fountain.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-9.ptbr: * Vim a esta bela praça para ver a histórica \nFonte Memorial Real.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * The fountain was built before Asgore declared war on humanity.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * A fonte foi construída antes de Asgore declarar guerra à humanidade.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * Apparently,[wait:5] it was erected to celebrate a period of amity towards humans before...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Aparentemente,[wait:5] foi erguida para celebrar um período de amizade com os humanos antes...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * You see,[wait:5] I'm researching the lives of the humans that have fallen into the Underground.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] estou pesquisando a vida dos humanos que caíram no Subsolo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * This statue could serve an invaluable primary source,[wait:5] \nbut alas...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Esta estátua poderia ser uma fonte primária inestimável,[wait:5] \nmas, infelizmente...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * I can always save research \ninto that particular human \nfor later.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Sempre posso deixar a pesquisa \nsobre esse humano \npara depois.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * Would you happen to be interested in the history of Humans and Monsters?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Por acaso teria interesse na história de Humanos e Monstros?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.english: * Oh,[wait:5] that's brilliant![wait:5] A young,[wait:5] studious mind like yourself taking an interest in history.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-1.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] que maravilha![wait:5] Uma mente jovem,[wait:5] estudiosa como a sua interessada em história.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Well,[wait:5] if you truly are interested,[wait:5] I hope you attend one of my lectures at HU.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] se realmente tiver interesse,[wait:5] espero que assista a uma das minhas aulas na UH.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Look for the history department when you're there,[wait:5] you'll likely find me in my office.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Procure o departamento de história quando estiver lá,[wait:5] provavelmente estarei no meu escritório.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Anyhow,[wait:5] I ought to get going.[wait:5]\n* Young squire,[wait:5] I hope to meet\nyou again!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Enfim,[wait:5] preciso ir.[wait:5]\n* Jovem escudeiro,[wait:5] espero\nencontrar você novamente!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Favor Accepted! \n[color:yellow]The History of Humans and Monsters.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Favor Aceito! \n[color:yellow]A História dos Humanos e Monstros.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Hmm?[wait:5]\n* Have you changed your mind?
* Oh,[wait:5] that's brilliant![wait:5] A young,[wait:5] studious mind like yourself taking an interest in history.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] que maravilha![wait:5] Uma mente jovem,[wait:5] estudiosa como a sua interessada em história.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Well,[wait:5] if you truly are interested,[wait:5] I hope you attend one of my lectures at HU.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] se realmente tiver interesse,[wait:5] espero que assista a uma das minhas aulas na UH.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.english: * Look for the history department when you're there,[wait:5] you'll \nlikely find me in my office.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-2.ptbr: * Procure o departamento de história quando estiver lá,[wait:5] você \nprovavelmente me encontrará no escritório.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-3.english: * Anyhow,[wait:5] I ought to get going.[wait:5]\n* Young squire,[wait:5] I hope to meet \nyou again!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-3.ptbr: * Enfim,[wait:5] preciso ir.[wait:5]\n* Jovem escudeiro,[wait:5] espero encontrar \nvocê de novo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-3.english: * Favor Accepted! \n[color:yellow]The History of Humans and Monsters.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-shirley-3.ptbr: * Favor Aceito! \n[color:yellow]A História dos Humanos e Monstros.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Hotland has a lot of magma in its stone,[wait:5] which is pretty dangerous if you live on it.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Hotland tem muito magma nas rochas,[wait:5] o que é bem perigoso para quem mora aqui.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * So the excess lava needs to get diverted through pipes...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Por isso o excesso de lava precisa ser desviado por canos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Which flow down into the lava pools at the bottom of the cavern.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Que descem até os lagos de lava no fundo da caverna.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * And I think that's pretty swell[wait:15]tering.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * E acho isso bem derre[wait:15]tador.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * For the record,[wait:5] the difference between lava and magma is location.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Só para constar,[wait:5] a diferença entre lava e magma é a localização.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * The molten rock that flows like a liquid on the surface is lava...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Rocha derretida que flui como líquido na superfície é lava...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * While the molten rock trapped underground is magma.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Já a rocha derretida presa no subsolo é magma.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * ...Which I suppose means it's all magma here,[wait:5] huh.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * ...Então acho que aqui é tudo magma,[wait:5] não é.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * ...If you think about it,[wait:5] we're all kind of like magma,[wait:5] aren't we?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * ...Pensando bem,[wait:5] todos nós somos meio que magma,[wait:5] não somos?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * This mountain is technically a volcano,[wait:5] no?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Esta montanha é tecnicamente um vulcão,[wait:5] não é?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Maybe the Angel was a metaphor for a volcanic eruption all along.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Talvez o Anjo sempre tenha sido uma metáfora para uma erupção vulcânica.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Sometimes,[wait:5] people will just \nlie to your face and act as \nif everything is fine.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Às vezes,[wait:5] as pessoas simplesmente \nmentem na sua cara e fingem \nque está tudo bem.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * People are always telling me that I'm \"cool\" or \"chill\".[wait:5]\n* Do they think I'm stupid?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Sempre dizem que sou \"descolado\" ou \"frio\".[wait:5]\n* Acham que sou idiota?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * See?\n[wait:5]* This is exactly what I mean!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Viu?\n[wait:5]* É exatamente disso que estou falando!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Maybe I should just accept it.\n[wait:5]* I'll move to Snowdin and start eating ice cubes.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Talvez eu deva aceitar.\n[wait:5]* Vou para Snowdin e começo a comer cubos de gelo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Whoa,[wait:5] tone it down a bit,[wait:5] hotshot.\n[wait:5]* You're like two.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Ei,[wait:5] pegue leve,[wait:5] esquentadinho.\n[wait:5]* Você tem tipo dois anos.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * But you're not wrong.[wait:5] I AM hot.[wait:5]\n* Glad someone is finally noticing.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Mas você não está errado.[wait:5] Eu SOU quente.[wait:5]\n* Que bom que alguém finalmente percebeu.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * That'll fix my insecurities.[wait:5]\n* Maybe then I can chill out.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Isso vai resolver minhas inseguranças.[wait:5]\n* Talvez eu consiga esfriar a cabeça.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * ...[wait:5]Wait...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * ...[wait:5]Espere...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * I work really hard to maintain this hot body,[wait:5] too.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Eu também trabalho duro para manter este corpo quente,[wait:5] viu.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * I eat coal for breakfast \nevery morning.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Como carvão no café da manhã \ntodos os dias.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * What,[wait:5] do you want my skincare routine too,[wait:5] or something?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * O quê,[wait:5] quer minha rotina de cuidados com a pele também,[wait:5] ou algo assim?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.english: * Nothing too complicated,[wait:5] you know.\n[wait:15]* Oil.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-smokestac.ptbr: * Nada muito complicado,[wait:5] sabe.\n[wait:15]* Óleo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-3.english: * Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] well.[wait:5]\n* If it isn't my ARCHNEMESIS!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-3.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] ora,[wait:5] ora.[wait:5]\n* Se não é meu ARQUI-INIMIGO!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-4.english: * Huh?[wait:5] Who am I?[wait:5]\n* Come on,[wait:5] don't tell me you forgot your MORTAL RIVAL!!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-4.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5] Quem sou eu?[wait:5]\n* Qual é,[wait:5] não diga que esqueceu seu RIVAL MORTAL!!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-5.english: * Well,[wait:5] sorry to rain on your parade,[wait:5] but Rainy's not so easily defeated!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-5.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] desculpe acabar com sua festa,[wait:5] mas Rainy não é derrotado tão fácil!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-6.english: * You see,[wait:5] while you've been making a name for yourself,[wait:5] \nI've been plotting...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-6.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] enquanto você fazia seu nome,[wait:5] \neu estava tramando...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-7.english: * Right now,[wait:5] you're living in the \ncalm before the storm!\n[wait:5]* Cherish it!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-7.ptbr: * Agora mesmo,[wait:5] você vive a \ncalmaria antes da tempestade!\n[wait:5]* Aproveite!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-8.english: * When I'm done with you,[wait:5] no one will even remember...!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-8.ptbr: * Quando eu acabar com você,[wait:5] ninguém sequer vai se lembrar...!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-10.english: * Of course![wait:5]\n* Sunny![wait:5]\n* I knew that!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-11.english: * I was just testing your \nMENTAL ACUITY.\n[wait:5]* As any good rival should.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-11.ptbr: * Eu só estava testando sua \nACUIDADE MENTAL.\n[wait:5]* Como todo bom rival deve fazer.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-12.english: * A storm is brewing in your future!\n[wait:5]* And that storm is me!!!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rainy-12.ptbr: * Uma tempestade se forma no seu futuro!\n[wait:5]* E essa tempestade sou eu!!!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-1.english: * I was just gazing at the CORE\nto try and get some inspiration for my next story.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-1.ptbr: * Eu estava olhando o NÚCLEO\npara buscar inspiração para minha próxima história.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-3.english: * A story of a monster weaponizing the CORE,[wait:5] to stop a human from reaching the capital!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-3.ptbr: * Uma história de um monstro usando o NÚCLEO como arma,[wait:5] para impedir um humano de chegar à capital!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-4.english: * And in order to pass,[wait:5] the human must beat the monster.[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3]
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-4.ptbr: * E para passar,[wait:5] o humano precisa derrotar o monstro.[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3]

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-8.english: * A human falls into the Underground,[wait:5] and befriends an ambitious monster.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-8.ptbr: * Um humano cai no Subsolo,[wait:5] e faz amizade com um monstro ambicioso.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-9.english: * And despite only having a short time here until the King finds them...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-9.ptbr: * E apesar de ter pouco tempo aqui até o Rei encontrar essa pessoa...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-10.english: * The human decides to help the monster achieve their dream of running a restaurant!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-10.ptbr: * O humano decide ajudar o monstro a realizar o sonho de administrar um restaurante!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-11.english: * No,[wait:5] that would make a terrible story...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-11.ptbr: * Não,[wait:5] isso daria uma história péssima...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-12.english: * Well,[wait:5] I'm sure inspiration will strike me someday.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-12.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] tenho certeza de que a inspiração virá algum dia.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-13.english: * For now,[wait:5] I'll just go back to sleep in these bushes for a while.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-13.ptbr: * Por enquanto,[wait:5] vou voltar a dormir nesses arbustos um pouco.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-14.english: * Maybe I'll have a finished\nstory in a few years...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-rose-14.ptbr: * Talvez eu tenha uma história\npronta daqui a alguns anos...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-5.english: * Oh,[wait:5] the tragedy!\n[wait:5]* It seems fate truly IS cruel!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-5.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] que tragédia!\n[wait:5]* Parece que o destino É mesmo cruel!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-6.english: * That flower I plucked earlier,[wait:5] that was the last one I had!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-6.ptbr: * Aquela flor que colhi antes,[wait:5] era a última que eu tinha!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-7.english: * It was one of the few flowers that I can hold without it setting ablaze.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-7.ptbr: * Era uma das poucas flores que consigo segurar sem incendiar.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-8.english: * Is this really the end?[wait:5]\n* Was my love truly doomed from the start?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-8.ptbr: * Este é mesmo o fim?[wait:5]\n* Meu amor estava condenado desde o início?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-9.english: * No![wait:5] I mustn't lose hope!\n[wait:5]* There's still a solution!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-9.ptbr: * Não![wait:5] Não posso perder a esperança!\n[wait:5]* Ainda existe uma solução!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-10.english: * There is a type of flower that is fire-proof.[wait:5]\n* The Sundial flower.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-10.ptbr: * Existe um tipo de flor à prova de fogo.[wait:5]\n* A flor Relógio de Sol.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-11.english: * It's a flower that moves in tandem with the Sun.[wait:5]\n* Romantic,[wait:5] isn't it?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-11.ptbr: * É uma flor que se move junto com o Sol.[wait:5]\n* Romântico,[wait:5] não é?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-12.english: * I believe that Time Ltd. keeps some of these flowers to help keep time.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-12.ptbr: * Acredito que a Time Ltd. guarda algumas dessas flores para ajudar a marcar o tempo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-13.english: * Please,[wait:5] cupid.[wait:5]\n* Try and find this flower for me.[wait:5] For love!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-13.ptbr: * Por favor,[wait:5] cupido.[wait:5]\n* Tente encontrar essa flor para mim.[wait:5] Pelo amor!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-14.english: * Oh,[wait:5] Cass,[wait:5] how you set my \nheart ablaze...
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-14.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] Cass,[wait:5] como você incendeia \nmeu coração...

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-15.english: * If only I had a Sundial flower that would not similarly be set ablaze if I were to touch it.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-15.ptbr: * Se eu tivesse uma flor Relógio de Sol que não pegasse fogo também quando eu tocasse.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-16.english: * Lavas me...[wait:5] Lavas me not...[wait:5]\n* Lavas me...[wait:5] Lavas me not...[wait:5]\n* Lavas me...[wait:5] Lavas me not!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-16.ptbr: * Lava me ama...[wait:5] Lava não me ama...[wait:5]\n* Lava me ama...[wait:5] Lava não me ama...[wait:5]\n* Lava me ama...[wait:5] Lava não me ama!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-17.english: * Oh my poor heart![wait:5]\n* I knew it,[wait:5] I knew it!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-17.ptbr: * Oh, meu pobre coração![wait:5]\n* Eu sabia,[wait:5] eu sabia!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-18.english: * I am hopeless in the battlefield of fiery passion known as love!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-18.ptbr: * Não tenho esperança no campo de batalha da paixão ardente chamado amor!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-19.english: * My heart burns for my dearly beloved Cass,[wait:5] but fate has other plans!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-19.ptbr: * Meu coração queima pela minha querida Cass,[wait:5] mas o destino tem outros planos!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-20.english: * Boohoo!\n[wait:5]* How can I bear this\nsolemn life?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-20.ptbr: * Buááá!\n[wait:5]* Como vou suportar esta\nvida solene?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-21.english: * I must throw myself into the burning lava of Hotland for the sake of true love!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-21.ptbr: * Preciso me jogar na lava ardente de Hotland em nome do amor verdadeiro!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-22.english: * ...It wouldn't really do anything,[wait:5] but it would be very dramatic,[wait:5] don't you agree?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-22.ptbr: * ...Não faria nada de verdade,[wait:5] mas seria muito dramático,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-23.english: * Really?[wait:5] Truly?\n[wait:5]* Oh thank the flames,[wait:5] I'm saved!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-23.ptbr: * Sério?[wait:5] De verdade?\n[wait:5]* Oh, graças às chamas,[wait:5] estou salvo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-24.english: * Here's what you must do.[wait:5]\n* Try and figure out something I could give her!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-24.ptbr: * Eis o que deve fazer.[wait:5]\n* Tente descobrir algo que eu possa dar a ela!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-25.english: * Oh,[wait:5] my heart... [wait:5]\n* I am indebted to you!\n[wait:5]* Oh,[wait:5] dearest cupid!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-25.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] meu coração... [wait:5]\n* Estou em dívida com você!\n[wait:5]* Oh,[wait:5] querido cupido!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-26.english: * Favor Accepted! \n[color:yellow]Lavas me, Lavas me not
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-26.ptbr: * Favor Aceito! \n[color:yellow]Me Lava, Não Me Lava

worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-27.english: * Oh, [wait:5]little cupid,[wait:5] don't delay!\n[wait:5]* The tension's already at a boiling point!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-lavar-27.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] pequeno cupido,[wait:5] não demore!\n[wait:5]* A tensão já está fervendo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-1.english: * Sup,[wait:5] lil squirt?[wait:5]\n* The name's Cassidy,[wait:5] but you can just call me Cass.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-1.ptbr: * E aí,[wait:5] baixinho?[wait:5]\n* O nome é Cassidy,[wait:5] mas pode me chamar de Cass.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-2.english: * What's a water elemental doing in Hotland?[wait:5] That's a great question that you didn't ask.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-2.ptbr: * O que uma elemental da água faz em Hotland?[wait:5] Ótima pergunta que você não fez.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-3.english: * You see,[wait:5] I'm here to test my endurance.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-3.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] estou aqui para testar minha resistência.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-4.english: * When I go back to Waterfall,[wait:5] I'll be the talk of the town.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-4.ptbr: * Quando voltar a Waterfall,[wait:5] todo mundo vai falar de mim.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-5.english: * \"You know Cass?[wait:5] Yeah,[wait:5] she went to Hotland and SURVIVED![wait:5] You know,[wait:5] in Liquid form.\"
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-5.ptbr: * \"Conhece a Cass?[wait:5] É,[wait:5] ela foi a Hotland e SOBREVIVEU![wait:5] Sabe,[wait:5] em forma líquida.\"

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-6.english: * Heh.[wait:5]\n* Everybody will be all over me.[wait:5]\n* I'll be swimming in adoration.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-6.ptbr: * Heh.[wait:5]\n* Todo mundo vai cair em cima de mim.[wait:5]\n* Vou nadar em adoração.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-7.english: * Like that weird red girl that keeps following me around.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-7.ptbr: * Como aquela garota vermelha estranha que vive me seguindo.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-8.english: * She's totally obsessed with me.\n[wait:5]* I'm just WAITING for her to \nask me out!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-8.ptbr: * Ela é totalmente obcecada por mim.\n[wait:5]* Só estou ESPERANDO ela \nme chamar para sair!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-10.english: * Huh?\n[wait:5]* Something I'd like for her to give me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-10.ptbr: * Hã?\n[wait:5]* Algo que eu gostaria que ela me desse?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-11.english: * Uhhh...[wait:5] I don't know.\n[wait:5]* Probably like flowers or something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-11.ptbr: * Hmmm...[wait:5] Não sei.\n[wait:5]* Provavelmente flores ou algo assim.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-12.english: * That's what cool guys like me always get in the movies and stuff,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-12.ptbr: * É isso que caras legais como eu sempre ganham nos filmes e tal,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-13.english: * Huh?\n[wait:5]* Something I'd like that girl to give me?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-13.ptbr: * Hã?\n[wait:5]* Algo que eu gostaria que aquela garota me desse?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-14.english: * Uhhh...[wait:5] I don't know.\n[wait:5]* Probably like flowers or something.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-14.ptbr: * Hmmm...[wait:5] Não sei.\n[wait:5]* Provavelmente flores ou algo assim.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-15.english: * That's what cool guys like me always get in the movies and stuff,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-15.ptbr: * É isso que caras legais como eu sempre ganham nos filmes e tal,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-16.english: * Yup.[wait:5] Any minute now.\n[wait:5]* The ladies will come flooding in.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-cass-16.ptbr: * Isso.[wait:5] A qualquer momento.\n[wait:5]* As garotas virão em massa.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-1.english: * Oh,[wait:5] sweetie,[wait:5] look![wait:5] They're out on a honeymoon like us,[wait:5] isn't that just so romantic?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-1.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] querida,[wait:5] veja![wait:5] Eles estão em lua de mel como nós,[wait:5] não é romântico?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-2.english: * Our sightseeing trip is going so well!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-2.ptbr: * Nosso passeio turístico está indo tão bem!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-3.english: * Don't mind my wife,[wait:5] dear,[wait:5] she's just letting off some steam.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octodad-3.ptbr: * Não ligue para minha esposa,[wait:5] querida,[wait:5] ela só está desabafando.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-1.english: * This is a disgrace![wait:5] Closing this restaurant...[wait:5] Can you imagine the audacity?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-1.ptbr: * Isto é uma desgraça![wait:5] Fechar este restaurante...[wait:5] Dá para imaginar a audácia?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-2.english: * You'll ruin my wonderful husband's sightseeing trip!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-2.ptbr: * Vocês vão estragar o passeio turístico do meu maravilhoso marido!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-3.english: * Their reservations were closed,[wait:5] so I decided to come in and complain to them in person.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-octomom-3.ptbr: * As reservas estavam fechadas,[wait:5] então decidi vir reclamar pessoalmente.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.english: * Hi![wait:5] Me and my friend here are on an adventure across the Underground!
worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.ptbr: * Oi![wait:5] Meu amigo e eu estamos numa aventura pelo Subsolo!

worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.english: * We're looking for my brother,[wait:5] have you seen him?
worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.ptbr: * Estamos procurando meu irmão,[wait:5] você viu ele?

worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.english: * He looks like me except much cooler.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.ptbr: * Ele se parece comigo, só que muito mais legal.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.english: * Well,[wait:5] if you see him,[wait:5] please let me know.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] se vir ele,[wait:5] por favor me avise.

worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.english: * Me and him have been joined at the hip since we were tadpoles.
worldcutscene-core_square-text-frogger3-.ptbr: * Ele e eu somos inseparáveis desde que éramos girinos.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Great![wait:5] \n* We'll see you tomorrow,[wait:5] then.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Woo...[wait:5] \n* That was a lot...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * What a day...[wait:5] Shame we missed the lights going out.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Seems as if The Eclipse has a new member now,[wait:5] huh?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.ptbr: * Parece que o Eclipse tem um novo membro agora,[wait:5] não é?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * I should be happy,[wait:5] but...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * The truth is,[wait:5] I'm worried.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * The Eclipse,[wait:5] it's supposed to be MY thing!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * An expression of my own SOUL,[wait:5] of...[wait:10] \n* Me!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * What if Grillby totally derails everything?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * (Not like I have much of a choice,[wait:5] anyway...)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * I mean,[wait:3] he seemed reasonable,[wait:3] didn't he?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Seems to be a bit quiet,[wait:5] but I mean...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Maybe we'll have two Sunnies!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Maybe we could use him as a backup grill!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Maybe this will all work out after all.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Still,[wait:5] I suppose we'll only find out tomorrow.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.ptbr: * Ainda assim,[wait:5] acho que só descobriremos amanhã.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.english: * Let's head back home,[wait:5] Sunny.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_grillby.ptbr: * Vamos voltar para casa,[wait:5] Sunny.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.english: * ...And you use this one for flipping the burgers!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * ...E você usa esta para virar os hambúrgueres!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.english: * And I think...[wait:5] that's everything...[wait:5] except for...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * E acho...[wait:5] que é tudo...[wait:5] exceto por...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * Venha ao balcão quando estiver tudo pronto.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.english: * I have something important for both of you!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * Tenho algo importante para vocês dois!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * Então,[wait:5] Grillby,[wait:5] você entende bastante de COZINHar,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.english: * Well![wait:5] \n* I've thought of a great job for you!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.ptbr: * Bem![wait:5] \n* Pensei num ótimo trabalho para você!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-day4entrance.english: * Oh,[wait:5] do you already know this?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-3.ptbr: * Mais um dia concluído! \n [wait:5]* Ótimo trabalho,[wait:5] pessoal!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-4.ptbr: * Que tal...[wait:5] Talvez Sunny possa limpar as mesas,[wait:5] e Grillby pode...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-5.english: * Hmm...[wait:5] I don't know![wait:5] Maybe,[wait:5] uh...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-10.english: * Is everything alright?[wait:5] You seemed a little spaced out there.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-10.ptbr: * Está tudo bem?[wait:5] Você pareceu meio no mundo da lua.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-11.english: * I mean,[wait:5] this is the Eclipse,[wait:5] so maybe that's a good thing!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-11.ptbr: * Quer dizer,[wait:5] este é o Eclipse,[wait:5] então talvez seja bom!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-12.english: * To space out?[wait:10] \n* It's[wait:5] a joke...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-14.english: * Alright then![wait:5] You can head home now.[wait:5] See\nyou tomorrow!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-14.ptbr: * Certo então![wait:5] Pode ir para casa.[wait:5] Até\namanhã!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-18.english: * Wouldn't want to miss the lights going out again,[wait:5] would we?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-18.ptbr: * Não queremos perder as luzes apagando de novo,[wait:5] queremos?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-20.english: * I suppose I didn't really have anything to worry about.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-21.english: * He's been doing well so far,[wait:5] hasn't he?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-22.english: * He listened to all the stuff I said pretty intently...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-22.ptbr: * Ele ouviu tudo que eu disse com bastante atenção...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-23.english: * And he's done everything we've asked of him so far down to the letter!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-23.ptbr: * E fez tudo o que pedimos até agora ao pé da letra!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-24.english: * If this keeps up,[wait:5] we'll be able to make my wish come true in no time!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-24.ptbr: * Se continuar assim,[wait:5] vamos realizar meu desejo num instante!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-26.english: * My great-grandfather used to tell me about the REAL stars.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-26.ptbr: * Meu bisavô costumava me contar sobre as estrelas DE VERDADE.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-27.english: * You'd wish on them and if you hoped hard enough...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-30.english: * Once we get to the surface,[wait:5] we should make a wish!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-31.english: * What would you wish for,[wait:5] Sunny?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-33.english: * I think my wish is pretty obvious.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-34.english: * For The Eclipse to be the greatest restaurant ever!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-34.ptbr: * Que o Eclipse se torne o melhor restaurante de todos!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-35.english: * Maybe that sounds a bit silly compared to your wish,[wait:5] though....
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-35.ptbr: * Talvez pareça meio bobo comparado ao seu desejo,[wait:5] mas....

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-36.english: * I hope I get to see the stars someday.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-36.ptbr: * Espero poder ver as estrelas algum dia.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-37.english: * Well,[wait:5] it's getting late.[wait:5] We should head back.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-37.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] está ficando tarde.[wait:5] Devemos voltar.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-38.english: * The Eclipse won't rank up by itself!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday4-38.ptbr: * O Eclipse não vai subir de classificação sozinho!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-5.english: * Another day down![wait:5]\n* Great job everyone!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-7.english: * We've been getting more and more customers lately.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-8.english: * We may still be small,[wait:5] but The Eclipse is only going up!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-8.ptbr: * Ainda podemos ser pequenos,[wait:5] mas o Eclipse só cresce!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-9.english: * Which means my dream is getting ever closer to coming true!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-9.ptbr: * O que significa que meu sonho está cada vez mais perto de se realizar!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-15.english: * .........more COOKing.\n[wait:5]* I want to do more COOKing.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-16.ptbr: * .....mais do que só esperar e ajudar.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-18.english: * You're doing so well right now![wait:5]\n* You're a great waiter!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-19.english: * In,[wait:5] uh...[wait:5] both senses of the word,[wait:5] I suppose.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-20.english: * I understand you,[wait:5] and I love the passion you're showing...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-20.ptbr: * Eu entendo você,[wait:5] e adoro a paixão que está mostrando...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-21.english: * But...[wait:5] You ARE only an intern.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-22.english: * I don't think you're necessarily...[wait:5] qualified to help with COOKing.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-23.english: * Sunny's handling the COOKing and they're doing a good job!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-23.ptbr: * Sunny está cuidando da COZINHa e fazendo um bom trabalho!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-24.english: * I don't want to...[wait:5] risk derailing this whole thing,[wait:5] you know?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-24.ptbr: * Não quero...[wait:5] arriscar descarrilar tudo isso,[wait:5] sabe?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-25.english: * Besides,[wait:5] like I said,[wait:5] you're already helping plenty!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-25.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] como eu disse,[wait:5] você já ajuda bastante!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-29.english: * ...Hmm...[wait:20][face:happy] I admire his enthusiasm for The Eclipse,[wait:5] at least!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-29.ptbr: * ...Hmm...[wait:20][face:happy] Pelo menos admiro o entusiasmo dele pelo Eclipse,[wait:5] isso eu admito!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-30.english: * It's comforting to see someone so excited about working here!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-33.english: * ...Well,[wait:5] in any case,[wait:5] let's lock up for tonight.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-38.english: * I've been keepin' a close eye,[wait:5] and I must say.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-39.english: * I've been impressed wit' your progress!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-44.english: * It almost brings a tear to my eye,[wait:5] truly!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-45.english: * I always knew you were a good investment!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-47.english: * It's been a long journey getting The Eclipse this far,[wait:5] and—
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-47.ptbr: * Foi uma longa jornada trazer o Eclipse até aqui,[wait:5] e—

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-48.english: * Yeah,[wait:5] yeah,[wait:5] enough yappin'.[wait:5] Let's get to the point.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-49.english: * This place is gettin' pretty popular,[wait:5] ain't it?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-59.english: * If you know what I mean.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-endday5-60.english: * So,[wait:5] let's put that to the test,[wait:5] shall we?
