worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-4.ptbr: * E olha só![wait:5] Vocês deram conta do recado!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.english: * I bet you could handle [wait:5][face:pride]ANYTHIN' [wait:5]that comes your way.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.ptbr: * Aposto que vocês aguentam [wait:5][face:pride]QUALQUER COISA [wait:5]que aparecer.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-7.english: * You bet your fluff I do!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-7.ptbr: * Pode apostar suas pelagens que acho!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-8.english: * Y-Yeah![wait:5] I bet we could even handle the king!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-8.ptbr: * S-Sim![wait:5] Aposto que aguentaríamos até o rei!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-9.english: * Why not![wait:5][face:pride] Big furball like him would really,[wait:5] [face:shock]uh,[wait:5] [face:pride]love this place!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-9.ptbr: * Por que não![wait:5][face:pride] Um bolão de pelo como ele realmente,[wait:5] [face:shock]hã,[wait:5] [face:pride]adoraria este lugar!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * So long as you keep up da good work,[wait:5] you've got the potential to go far.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Enquanto continuarem o bom trabalho,[wait:5] vocês têm potencial para ir longe.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * And no one is happier about dat than your buddy Mawzz!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * E ninguém fica mais feliz com isso que seu camarada Mawzz!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * So I think it's more than safe to say we're all set to sail!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Então acho mais do que seguro dizer que estamos prontos para zarpar!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * Sail onto the next step of makin' your restaurant![wait:5]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Zarpar para a próxima etapa de criar seu restaurante![wait:5]

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * It's 'bout time I started getting a bit more...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Já está na hora de eu ficar um pouco mais...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * You want to be the biggest restaurant in the Underground. [wait:5][face:shock]But!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Você quer o maior restaurante do Subsolo. [wait:5][face:shock]Mas!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.english: * There's more to dat than just makin' food!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-1.ptbr: * Isso envolve muito mais que só fazer comida!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * You need to manage money,[wait:5] advertise,[wait:5] all sorts of [speed:0.4]borin[speed:1]' stuff!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * Precisa administrar dinheiro,[wait:5] fazer propaganda,[wait:5] todo tipo de coisa [speed:0.4]chata[speed:1]!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * And I know you want to use your lil' brain to think about COOKing.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * E sei que você quer usar esse miolinho para pensar em COZINHar.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * So that's where I come in!
* I,[wait:5] MAWZZ,[wait:5] will be your fin-ancial manager!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * Eu,[wait:5] MAWZZ,[wait:5] serei seu gerente fin-anceiro!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * And I've got big plans for how you can invest your G.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * E tenho grandes planos para como investir seu G.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * So you just focus on reelin' in all those tasty customers.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * Então só foque em fisgar todos aqueles clientes saborosos.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * And their sweet,[wait:5] sweet G,[wait:5] of course!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * E o doce,[wait:5] doce G deles,[wait:5] claro!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * Meanwhile,[wait:5] I'll help ya through the tedious [wave]paperwork.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * Enquanto isso,[wait:5] vou ajudar vocês com a papelada [wave]tediosa.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.english: * Seems like a pretty sweet deal to me!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-2.ptbr: * Parece um ótimo negócio para mim!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Este é o MEU projeto de paixão...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.english: * And focusing too much on money...
* Don't worry,[wait:5] fuzz.[wait:5] I know how you dreamer types can be.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Não se preocupe,[wait:5] pelúcia.[wait:5] Sei como vocês sonhadores são.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.english: * I used to be one myself when I was your age!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Eu mesmo era um quando tinha sua idade!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.english: * You and the lil' chum'll still be in full control of the restaurant.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Você e o camaradinha ainda terão controle total do restaurante.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.english: * You wanna hoard your G and avoid expanding,[wait:5] then be my guest!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Quer guardar todo seu G e evitar expandir,[wait:5] fique à vontade!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.english: * Take it as proof of my full commitment to your...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-3.ptbr: * Tome isso como prova do meu compromisso total com sua...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-4.english: * This does make our jobs a lot easier!
* We'll have a lot more time to focus on stuff that actually matters!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-4.ptbr: * Teremos muito mais tempo para focar no que realmente importa!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.english: * What?[wait:5] A monster of my pedigree's gotta have an office!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5] Um monstro da minha linhagem precisa de um escritório!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.english: * If I'm to be workin' wit' youse,[wait:5] I better be in the same buildin'!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.ptbr: * Se vou trabalhar com vocês,[wait:5] é melhor estar no mesmo prédio!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.english: * Here,[wait:5] lemme give you a deluxe MAWZZ tour!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-post_mawzz-5.ptbr: * Aqui,[wait:5] deixa eu dar o tour MAWZZ deluxe!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-1.english: * (Seems like Luna is need of a hand...)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-2.english: * (Knowing Luna needs you to take care of them fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-2.ptbr: * (Saber que Luna precisa dos seus cuidados enche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-3.english: * (The Eclipse, now Rank 1,[wait:5] \nglows with newfound life.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-3.ptbr: * (O Eclipse, agora Classificação 1,[wait:5] \nbrilha com uma nova vida.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-4.english: * (The thought of helping Luna \nreach the highest rank\nfills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-4.ptbr: * (Pensar em ajudar Luna \na chegar à classificação máxima\nenche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-5.english: * (The presence of your new coworker fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-5.ptbr: * (A presença do novo colega de trabalho enche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-6.english: * (The thought of helping Luna \nreach their dream fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-save-6.ptbr: * (Pensar em ajudar Luna \na realizar esse sonho enche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-3.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] \n* Are you worried about me?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-3.ptbr: * Hmm?[wait:5] \n* Você está se preocupando comigo?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-4.english: * Don't worry![wait:5] The whole coffee thing,[wait:5] it's nothing.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-4.ptbr: * Não se preocupe![wait:5] Aquilo do café,[wait:5] não foi nada.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-5.english: * I've drank waaaay more back when I was at University.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-5.ptbr: * Eu bebia muuuuito mais quando estava na Universidade.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-6.english: * So don't worry.[wait:5]\n* As you can see,[wait:5] I'm all good.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-6.ptbr: * Então não se preocupe.[wait:5]\n* Como pode ver,[wait:5] estou muito bem.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-7.english: * When I got my first major essay assignment...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-7.ptbr: * Quando recebi meu primeiro trabalho acadêmico grande...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-8.english: * I got so stressed out about getting it in before the deadline,
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-8.ptbr: * Fiquei sob tanto estresse para entregar antes do prazo,

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-9.english: * That I pulled an all-nighter until noon of the next day.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-9.ptbr: * Que virei a noite até o meio-dia do dia seguinte.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-10.english: * I must have drank enough coffee to drown in...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-10.ptbr: * Devo ter bebido café o bastante para me afogar...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-11.english: * The assignment was due the following week,[wait:5] but still.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-11.ptbr: * O trabalho era para a semana seguinte,[wait:5] mas mesmo assim.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-12.english: * You can never be too certain!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-12.ptbr: * Nunca dá para ter certeza demais!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-13.english: * What are you waiting for??[wait:5] Come on!!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-14.english: * I'm getting antsy just standing here!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-14.ptbr: * Estou ficando sem paciência só de ficar aqui!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-17.english: * I'm glad you liked \nmy joke,[wait:5] Sunny.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-17.ptbr: * Fico feliz que tenha gostado \nda minha piada,[wait:5] Sunny.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-19.english: * Think we'd get more customers if I tried telling them my jokes?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-19.ptbr: * Será que conseguiríamos mais clientes se eu contasse minhas piadas?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-22.english: * I guess that would make The Eclipse one of those comedy bars?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-22.ptbr: * Acho que isso transformaria o Eclipse num daqueles bares de comédia?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-23.english: * And I'd have to do stand-up comedy?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-23.ptbr: * E eu teria que fazer stand-up?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-24.english: * ...On second thought,[wait:5] that sounds like a terrible idea.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-25.english: * I don't really want to be remembered as,[wait:5] you know...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-25.ptbr: * Não quero muito ser lembrado como,[wait:5] sabe...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-26.english: * The monster that bombed at stand-up.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-26.ptbr: * O monstro que fracassou no stand-up.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-28.english: * It makes my face scrunch up just thinking about it...!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-28.ptbr: * Só de pensar nisso meu rosto se contorce...!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-29.english: * I'd have to run away,[wait:5] and start everything over in...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-29.ptbr: * Eu teria que fugir,[wait:5] e começar tudo de novo em...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-30.english: * I don't know,[wait:5] Waterfall,[wait:5] I guess?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-31.english: * Maybe I could pivot into a seafood restaurant...?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-31.ptbr: * Talvez eu pudesse mudar para um restaurante de frutos do mar...?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-32.english: * Ack![wait:5] Let's stop worrying about hypotheticals!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-32.ptbr: * Ack![wait:5] Vamos parar de pensar em hipóteses!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-33.english: * Let's just start the day already!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-33.ptbr: * Vamos começar o dia de uma vez!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-34.english: * (Psst.[wait:5] Keep an eye on Grillby today.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-34.ptbr: * (Psiu.[wait:5] Fique de olho no Grillby hoje.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-35.english: * (Keep him occupied,[wait:5] but make sure he doesn't interfere too much.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-35.ptbr: * (Mantenha ele ocupado,[wait:5] mas garanta que não interfira demais.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-36.english: * (We need to make sure nothing goes wrong.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-38.english: * (Forget I said anything.[wait:5]\n* I'll keep everything under control.)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-38.ptbr: * (Esqueça o que eu disse.[wait:5]\n* Vou manter tudo sob controle.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-39.english: * Do you see all the customers?[wait:5] We haven't even opened up yet.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-39.ptbr: * Está vendo todos os clientes?[wait:5] Nem abrimos ainda.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-41.english: * People can't wait for a taste of The Eclipse!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-41.ptbr: * As pessoas mal podem esperar para provar o Eclipse!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-42.english: * I wonder how far word has reached...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-42.ptbr: * Até onde será que a notícia chegou...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-43.english: * What if the King already knows?[wait:5] Or the captain of the Royal Guard?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-43.ptbr: * E se o Rei já souber?[wait:5] Ou a capitã da Guarda Real?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-44.english: * Or even the Royal Taste Tester!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-45.english: * Wait,[wait:5] why do we even have a Royal Taste Tester?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-45.ptbr: * Espere,[wait:5] por que temos um Provador Real?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-46.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] Did you have something for me?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-47.english: * ...Probably best to not give them coffee after what happened before...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-lunatalk-47.ptbr: * ...Talvez seja melhor não dar café depois do que aconteceu antes...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-7.english: * ......Luna has shown me around.[wait:5] My job is to wait.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-7.ptbr: * ......luna me mostrou tudo.[wait:5] meu trabalho é esperar.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-10.english: * .........if I must help you before I may COOK,[wait:5] then I will wait.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-10.ptbr: * .........se preciso ajudar antes de poder COZINHar,[wait:5] então vou esperar.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-22.english: * Wow. Ok. I feel a lot more energized.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-22.ptbr: * uau. certo. estou bem mais disposto.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-23.english: * (Grillby's ability will now be usable an additional time!)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-grillby-23.ptbr: * (A habilidade do Grillby agora poderá ser usada mais uma vez!)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-1.english: * If Time Ltd. won't serve me,[wait:5] I might as well try out what you guys have.
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-1.ptbr: * Se a Time Ltd. não quer me servir,[wait:5] posso muito bem experimentar o que vocês têm.

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-2.english: * If nothing else,[wait:5] YOU'll let me eat up some of your time,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-2.ptbr: * No mínimo,[wait:5] VOCÊS vão me deixar comer um pouco do seu tempo,[wait:5] certo?

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-3.english: * Do you guys have a watch or two?[wait:5] I could really go for some appetizers...
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-clockid-3.ptbr: * Vocês têm um ou dois relógios?[wait:5] Eu adoraria uns aperitivos...

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-wall-6.english: * (I don't know what you were expecting.)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-wall-8.english: * (On further inspection,[wait:5] you notice a very small hole in the wall!)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-wall-8.ptbr: * (Olhando melhor,[wait:5] você nota um buraquinho na parede!)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-wall-12.english: * (Don't you have anything better to do with your time?)
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-wall-12.ptbr: * (Você não tem nada melhor para fazer com seu tempo?)

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-old_diamond-.english: * I was just looking for something new to grumble about!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-old_diamond-.ptbr: * Eu estava procurando algo novo para resmungar!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-old_diamond-.english: * I'd like to order something that was better back in my day!
worldcutscene-eclipse1-text-old_diamond-.ptbr: * Quero pedir alguma coisa que era melhor na minha época!

worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.english: [voice:ut]* Remember,[wait:5] Sunny.\n[wait:5]* We are good people.[wait:60]
[voice:ut]* Good people give what they can.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Boas pessoas dão o que podem.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.english: [voice:ut]* Good people help those in need.[wait:60]
[voice:ut]* Good people would do most\nanything for others.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Boas pessoas fariam quase\nqualquer coisa pelos outros.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.english: [voice:ut]* Seems as if The Eclipse really is growing![wait:60]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Parece que o Eclipse está mesmo crescendo![wait:60]

worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.english: [voice:ut]* I must be doing a good job.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Devo estar fazendo um bom trabalho.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.english: [voice:ut]* I wish I could show them the stars.[wait:60]
[voice:ut]* I hope I can help their\ndreams come true, at least.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-eclipse1-screenDialogueTex.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Espero ao menos poder ajudar\na realizar os sonhos de Luna.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-ice_tube-.english: * Where the white monster rescued you from.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-ice_tube-.ptbr: * Onde o monstro branco resgatou você.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-ice_tube-.english: * What would have happened\nhad you not been rescued?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-ice_tube-.ptbr: * O que teria acontecido\nse ninguém tivesse resgatado você?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-ice_tube-.english: * You've run out of ice puns.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * He should be here by now...[wait:5]\n* Where is he?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Ele já deveria estar aqui...[wait:5]\n* Onde ele está?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * It's ya boy!\n[wait:5]* Ready for business![wait:5]\n* GWAHAHA!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Chegou o seu camarada!\n[wait:5]* Pronto para os negócios![wait:5]\n* GWAHAHA!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Oh![wait:5] Are you-
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Oh![wait:5] Você é-

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Da name's Mawzz,[wait:5] fuzz![wait:5]\n* I'm a businessman![wait:5] An investah!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * O nome é Mawzz,[wait:5] camarada![wait:5]\n* Sou um homem de negócios![wait:5] Um investidô!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * I help wannabe entrepreneurs like youse get off da ground-
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Ajudo aspirantes a empreendedores como você a sair do chão-

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * And right up to da starlit skies,[wait:5] see?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * E subir direto para o céu estrelado,[wait:5] sacou?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * I can help your wildest dreams turn into something so real...
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Posso transformar seus sonhos mais loucos em algo tão real...

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * You can practically take a big bite outta it!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Que dá praticamente para dar uma mordida!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Now,[wait:5] a little fishie told me you were wanting to start a business.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Agora,[wait:5] um peixinho me contou que você queria abrir um negócio.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Yes,[wait:5] Mr...[wait:5]
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Sim,[wait:5] Sr...[wait:5]

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Come on, fuzz![wait:5] \n* I'm your pal,[wait:5] no need for formalities!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Qual é, camarada![wait:5] \n* Somos amigos,[wait:5] nada de formalidade!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Da name's Mawzz![wait:5]\n* Say it and say it loud![wait:5]\n* It's a prized name!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * O nome é Mawzz![wait:5]\n* Diga e diga alto![wait:5]\n* É um nome de valor!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * If that's the case...[wait:5] I think you could end up being a great asset!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Wait...[wait:5] Your name...[wait:5]\n* Is it Sunny?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Wow![wait:5]\n* I don't know how I remembered that!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Uau![wait:5]\n* Não sei como lembrei disso!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * I usually forget names right away.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Normalmente esqueço nomes na hora.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Maybe that's a sign that our meeting was meant to be!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Talvez nosso encontro estivesse destinado a acontecer!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * Oh,[wait:5] I'm Luna by the way.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] eu sou Luna, aliás.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * This restaurant...[wait:5][face:determination]\n* I can feel it![wait:5] Fate is on our side!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Este restaurante...[wait:5][face:determination]\n* Eu sinto![wait:5] O destino está do nosso lado!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * But that's enough of that.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Mas chega disso.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.english: * We've got a restaurant to prepare,[wait:5] after all!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-mawzzmeet.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:5] temos um restaurante para preparar!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * Damn it-!\n[wait:5]* Why now,[wait:5] of all times?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Droga-!\n[wait:5]* Por que agora,[wait:5] de todos os momentos?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * Come on,[wait:5] Luna.\n[wait:5]* Keep it together.
* Don't worry about me.[wait:3] I've got this all under control!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Não se preocupe comigo.[wait:3] Está tudo sob controle!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * I didn't need an extra pair of hands.
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Eu não precisava de outro par de mãos.

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * After all,[wait:3] I've already got that covered!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:3] isso eu já tenho de sobra!

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * Get it?[wait:3] Because[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3] I have one more pair of arms than average?
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Entendeu?[wait:3] Porque[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3].[wait:3] tenho um par de braços a mais que a média?

worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.english: * You got it![wait:5]\n* Pretty good joke,[wait:3] right?
* We've got a whole day of work ahead of us!
worldcutscene-eclipse_ext-text-day3_star.ptbr: * Temos um dia inteiro de trabalho pela frente!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I've been working on The Eclipse for the past...[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Tenho trabalhado no Eclipse durante a última...[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [wait:5]Entire night.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [wait:5]Noite inteira.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Don't worry about me, though![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Mas não se preocupe comigo![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I drank about 8,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 9,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] 10[wait:2] cups of coffee.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Bebi umas 8,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] 9,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] 10[wait:2] xícaras de café.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Don't worry, I'm doing just fine. Great! Better than ever, eve-[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Não se preocupe, estou muito bem. Ótimo! Melhor do que nunca, melh-[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Wait,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] it was 11,[wait:5] sorry.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Espere,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] foram 11,[wait:5] desculpe.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Anyway, I'm a natural night owl.[wait:5] It's in the name.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Enfim, sou naturalmente uma criatura noturna.[wait:5] Está no nome.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Oh, oh! I need to show you what I've been working on![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Oh, oh! Preciso mostrar o que estive fazendo![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]I just know you're gonna love it![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Eu sei que você vai adorar![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * [speed:1.2]Come on, come on![wait:10]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * [speed:1.2]Vamos, vamos![wait:10]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Voilà![wait:5] \n* Isn't it just the best thing ever?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Voilà![wait:5] \n* Não é a melhor coisa de todas?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * As it was,[wait:5] the restaurant looked really uninviting to customers.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Do jeito que estava,[wait:5] o restaurante parecia nada convidativo aos clientes.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So,[wait:5] I decided to fix it up before we opened for the second day!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Então,[wait:5] decidi arrumar tudo antes de abrirmos para o segundo dia!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Isn't it great?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Não ficou ótimo?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Oh,[wait:5] you haven't even seen the inside!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] você nem viu o interior!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * No more holes.[wait:5] \n* No more leaky lava.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Sem mais buracos.[wait:5] \n* Sem mais vazamentos de lava.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * And most of all,[wait:5] no more dull and dark grays!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * E acima de tudo,[wait:5] chega daquele cinza escuro e sem graça!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Look,[wait:5] I even used the lava from the bucket to make that lamp!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Olhe,[wait:5] até usei a lava do balde para fazer aquela lâmpada!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Gives the place a much more inviting vibe.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Deixa o lugar muito mais convidativo.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * And that's not even the best part!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * E essa nem é a melhor parte!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * I've gone ahead and sent out an application...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Eu já enviei uma inscrição...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * To the Royal Underground Association of Eaters!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Para a Associação Real Subterrânea de Comensais!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * They'll get us certified as a restaurant!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Eles vão certificar nosso restaurante!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * The letter should arrive sometime today!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * A carta deve chegar em algum momento de hoje!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Huh?[wait:5] \n * A letter for me?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5] \n * Uma carta para mim?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Oh![wait:5] This has got to be it![wait:5] \n* It's from the RUGAE!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Oh![wait:5] Deve ser isso![wait:5] \n* É da ARSC!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Let's see this...[wait:5] \n * \"We have reviewed your application...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Vamos ver...[wait:5] \n * \"Analisamos sua inscrição...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Yada yada...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Blá blá blá...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * It always takes a bit of waffle for them to get to the point... [react:1]
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Eles sempre enrolam um pouco antes de chegar ao ponto... [react:1]

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Here it is!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Aqui está!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"We would like to congratulate The Eclipse...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * \"Gostaríamos de parabenizar o Eclipse...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"...for being recognized by the RUGAE...\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * \"...por ser reconhecido pela ARSC...\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * \"...and officially grant it the rank of-\"
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * \"...e conceder oficialmente a classificação de-\"

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Incredible![wait:5] \n* We're officially a ranked restaurant!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Incrível![wait:5] \n* Somos oficialmente um restaurante classificado!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * It's the,[wait:5] uh[wait:8][speed:0.5]...[speed:1][wait:5] \n* Lowest rank,[wait:15] but[wait:10] look on the bright side.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * É a,[wait:5] hã[wait:8][speed:0.5]...[speed:1][wait:5] \n* Classificação mais baixa,[wait:15] mas[wait:10] veja pelo lado bom.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * We're only four ranks away from the highest possible one!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Estamos a só quatro classificações da maior possível!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * There's yet to be a 5-star restaurant in the entire Underground.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Ainda não existe um restaurante 5 estrelas em todo o Subsolo.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So if we get to 5 stars,[wait:5] then there's no doubt about it!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Então se chegarmos a 5 estrelas,[wait:5] não haverá dúvida!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * We'll be the greatest restaurant...
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Seremos o maior restaurante...

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * That the Underground has ever seen!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Que o Subsolo já viu!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * All we need to raise our rank is more PRESTIGE.
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Só precisamos de mais PRESTÍGIO para subir de classificação.

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * So we just need to keep making sure everyone-
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Então só precisamos garantir que todos-

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * - and I mean everyone-
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * - e quero dizer todos-

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * - who comes through these doors leaves satisfied!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * - que entrarem por estas portas saiam satisfeitos!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Well,[wait:5] what are we waiting for?
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] o que estamos esperando?

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * The Eclipse won't rank up by itself!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * O Eclipse não vai subir de classificação sozinho!

worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.english: * Let's get COOKing!
worldcutscene-elevator_room-text-eclipse.ptbr: * Vamos COZINHar!

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-4.english: * But you shouldn't.\n[wait:5]* You really shouldn't.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-5.english: * You tried to use your phone,

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-10.english: * This is the first time you've missed feeding it in years.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-14.english: * Does this make it a hotline?

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-15.ptbr: * Você verifica se o telefone já está funcionando.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-17.english: * You hope people don't think you're giving them the cold shoulder.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-18.ptbr: * Finalmente,[wait:5] depois de todo esse tempo,

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-22.ptbr: * Você não sabe o número de ninguém.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-23.english: * Without any number to call,[wait:5] it's useless.

worldcutscene-general-text-cell-24.english: * If you're seeing this, I fucked up bigtime.\n* Send a bug report or something.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-7.english: * Oh gee,[wait:5] oh biscuits,[wait:5] what do we do now?\n[wait:5]* If Mawzz finds out we-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-7.ptbr: * Oh céus,[wait:5] oh droga,[wait:5] o que fazemos agora?\n[wait:5]* Se Mawzz descobrir que nós-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-8.english: * Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] well.[wait:5]\n* If it isn't my two favourite little fish.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-8.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] ora,[wait:5] ora.[wait:5]\n* Se não são meus dois peixinhos favoritos.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-10.english: * Listen...[wait:5] I know we weren't able to pay you today but-
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-10.ptbr: * Escute...[wait:5] Sei que não conseguimos pagar hoje, mas-

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-11.english: * Just give us another chance,[wait:5] another day,[wait:5] we'll pay you back then!
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-11.ptbr: * Só nos dê outra chance,[wait:5] outro dia,[wait:5] e pagaremos então!

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-12.english: * I promise,[wait:5] I promise I-[wait:5] We can do it![wait:5] Just please-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-12.ptbr: * Eu prometo,[wait:5] eu prometo que-[wait:5] Nós conseguimos![wait:5] Só por favor-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-13.english: * No need for empty promises fuzz.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-13.ptbr: * Não precisa de promessas vazias, pelúcia.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-14.english: * After all,[wait:5] your signature is a lot more binding than your word.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-14.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:5] sua assinatura vale muito mais que sua palavra.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-15.english: * You knew what you were signing up for.[wait:5] It was all on the page.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-15.ptbr: * Você sabia no que estava entrando.[wait:5] Estava tudo na página.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-16.english: * We'd both prefer if this venture kept rolling on for a little bit longer,
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-16.ptbr: * Nós dois preferiríamos que este empreendimento continuasse por mais um pouco,

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-17.ptbr: * Mas! Quem pede não pode escolher.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-18.english: * So I reckon it's about time we start talking[wait:5] [speed:0.5]collateral.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-20.english: * I-[wait:5]I'll let you take anything,[wait:5] whatever is necessary to keep the-[wait:5]
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-20.ptbr: * E-[wait:5]Eu deixo levar qualquer coisa,[wait:5] o que for preciso para manter o-[wait:5]

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-21.english: * Zip it,[wait:5] fuzz.[wait:5] This ain't about you anymore.\n[wait:5]* You're worthless to me.
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-21.ptbr: * Cala a boca,[wait:5] pelúcia.[wait:5] Isto não é mais sobre você.\n[wait:5]* Você não vale nada para mim.

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-25.ptbr: * ...Diga,[wait:5] você adora ajudar as pessoas,[wait:5] não adora?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-26.english: * Wanna help your little pal over there?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-27.english: * You wouldn't mind paying that collateral,[wait:5] wouldja?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-28.english: * Sunny?[wait:5]\n* You would do that for me?
worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-28.ptbr: * Sunny?[wait:5]\n* Você faria isso por mim?

worldcutscene-general-text-gameover-29.english: * You'd really do that,[wait:5] huh?[wait:5]\n* Now ain't that sweet.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-2.english: * Whale,[wait:5] whale,[wait:5] whale.[wait:10]\n* Look who it is.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-3.english: * That eager to talk to your old pal Whaley again?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-3.ptbr: * Tanta vontade assim de falar com seu velho amigo Whaley de novo?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-5.english: [noskip]* Whale,[wait:5] friend,[wait:5] you seem to be skipping through what I'm saying.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-5.ptbr: [noskip]* Baleia,[wait:5] amigo,[wait:5] parece que está pulando o que eu digo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-6.english: [noskip]* That's not a very nice thing to do,[wait:5] now is it?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-6.ptbr: [noskip]* Isso não é muito gentil,[wait:5] é?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-7.english: [noskip]* Especially when I'm being so generous,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-7.ptbr: [noskip]* Ainda mais quando estou sendo tão generoso,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-8.english: [noskip]* As to allow you to go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-8.ptbr: [noskip]* A ponto de deixar você voltar para onde deveria estar.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-9.ptbr: [noskip]* Faça um favor para mim,[wait:5] amigo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-10.english: [noskip]* And go back to where you just were.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-11.english: * But I'm afraid it'll be a while until we can have a real conversation.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-11.ptbr: * Mas receio que ainda demore para termos uma conversa de verdade.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-14.english: * Whale,[wait:5] whale,[wait:5] whale.[wait:10]\n* Look who it is.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-14.ptbr: * Baleia,[wait:5] baleia,[wait:5] baleia.[wait:10]\n* Veja quem apareceu.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-15.english: * You're not supposed to be here,[wait:5] friend.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-15.ptbr: * Você não deveria estar aqui,[wait:5] amigo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-16.english: * But who cares about that here,[wait:5] right,[wait:5] friend?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-16.ptbr: * Mas quem liga para isso aqui,[wait:5] não é,[wait:5] amigo?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-17.english: * Isn't it so much more fun to \nnot take this seriously?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-17.ptbr: * Não é muito mais divertido \nnão levar isso a sério?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-18.english: * That whole thing you left behind...
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-18.ptbr: * Aquela coisa toda que deixou para trás...

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-19.english: * Isn't it tacky?\n[wait:5]* Isn't it comical how hard it's trying?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-19.ptbr: * Não é brega?\n[wait:5]* Não é cômico o quanto tenta se esforçar?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-20.english: * Yup,[wait:5] yup,[wait:5] I'd say it's quite \nfun to...[wait:5]\n* Whale on it a bit,[wait:5] no?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-20.ptbr: * Sim,[wait:5] sim,[wait:5] eu diria que é bem \ndivertido...[wait:5]\n* Baleiar um pouco nisso,[wait:5] não?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-21.english: * Still,[wait:5] it's really risky,[wait:5] what you're doin'.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-21.ptbr: * Ainda assim,[wait:5] é bem arriscado,[wait:5] o que está fazendo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-22.english: [noskip]* Whale,[wait:5] friend,[wait:5] you seem to be skipping through what I'm saying.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-22.ptbr: [noskip]* Baleia,[wait:5] amigo,[wait:5] parece que está pulando o que eu digo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-23.english: [noskip]* That's not a very nice thing to do,[wait:5] now is it?
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-23.ptbr: [noskip]* Isso não é muito gentil,[wait:5] é?

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-24.english: [noskip]* Especially when I'm being so generous,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-24.ptbr: [noskip]* Ainda mais quando estou sendo tão generoso,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-25.english: [noskip]* As to allow you to go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-25.ptbr: [noskip]* A ponto de deixar você voltar para onde deveria estar.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-26.ptbr: [noskip]* Faça um favor para mim,[wait:5] amigo.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-27.english: [noskip]* And go back to where you just were.

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-28.english: * You could make everything crash and burn before it's supposed to!
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-28.ptbr: * Você pode fazer tudo travar e queimar antes da hora!

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-29.english: * And we're still having some fun here,[wait:5] aren't we?[wait:10]
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-29.ptbr: * E ainda estamos nos divertindo aqui,[wait:5] não estamos?[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-30.english: * So why don't you do your friend Whaley a favor,
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-30.ptbr: * Então que tal fazer um favor para seu amigo Whaley,

worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-31.english: * And go back to where you're supposed to be.
worldcutscene-general-text-whalecheck-31.ptbr: * E voltar para onde deveria estar.

worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.english: [voice:ut]* Good people would do anything for others.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Boas pessoas fariam qualquer coisa pelos outros.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-screenDialogueText.english: [voice:ut]* Bad people only think of themselves.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-general-str_good-eviltext-.english: Are you a good person, Sunny?
worldcutscene-general-str_good-eviltext-.ptbr: Você é uma boa pessoa, Sunny?

worldcutscene-general-str_bad-eviltext-1.english: Are you a bad person, Sunny?
worldcutscene-general-str_bad-eviltext-1.ptbr: Você é uma pessoa ruim, Sunny?

worldcutscene-home-text-watersausage-2.english: * A water sausage.[wait:5]\n* Good for making hot dogs.
worldcutscene-home-text-watersausage-2.ptbr: * Uma salsicha-d'água.[wait:5]\n* Boa para fazer cachorro-quente.

worldcutscene-home-text-shoes-2.english: * A box of kids' shoes in a disparity of sizes.
worldcutscene-home-text-shoes-2.ptbr: * Uma caixa de sapatos infantis em vários tamanhos diferentes.

worldcutscene-home-text-mirror-1.ptbr: * Você não consegue encarar\nos próprios olhos.

worldcutscene-home-text-drawer1-2.english: * There are flower seeds and\nbroken crayons in the drawer.
worldcutscene-home-text-drawer1-2.ptbr: * Há sementes de flores e\ngiz de cera quebrado na gaveta.

worldcutscene-home-text-flower-2.english: * A flower.[wait:5]\n* Toriel always makes sure to water it.
worldcutscene-home-text-flower-2.ptbr: * Uma flor.[wait:5]\n* Toriel sempre se lembra de regar.

worldcutscene-home-text-bookshelf-2.english: * Many books are resting on the shelf.

worldcutscene-home-text-tools-2.english: * The tools have been filed down.
worldcutscene-home-text-tools-2.ptbr: * As ferramentas tiveram as pontas desgastadas.

worldcutscene-home-text-tools-3.english: * You feel somewhat patronized by this.
worldcutscene-home-text-tools-3.ptbr: * Você sente que estão tratando você como criança.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed-1.english: * It was nice while it lasted.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed-2.english: * You've slept quite enough,[wait:5]\ntime to get on with your\nday.
worldcutscene-home-text-bed-2.ptbr: * Você já dormiu o bastante,[wait:5]\né hora de seguir com seu\ndia.

worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-1.english: * You'll miss eating this well,[wait:5]\nbut it's for the best.
worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-1.ptbr: * Você vai sentir falta de comer tão bem,[wait:5]\nmas é melhor assim.

worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-2.ptbr: * Parece que o café da manhã está pronto!

worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-3.english: * You should talk to Toriel\nfirst,[wait:5] though.
worldcutscene-home-text-breakfast-3.ptbr: * Mas primeiro você deveria falar\ncom Toriel.[wait:5]

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-1.english: * You hold your hands out towards \nthe heat despite yourself.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-1.ptbr: * Sem perceber, você estende as mãos \nem direção ao calor.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-2.english: * You chide yourself for getting \nso comfortable here.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-2.ptbr: * Você se repreende por ter ficado \ntão à vontade aqui.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-3.english: * You should have known this was \ntoo good to be true.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-3.ptbr: * Você deveria saber que isso era \nbom demais para ser verdade.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-4.english: * The fireplace is so pleasant \nand warm.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-4.ptbr: * A lareira é tão agradável \ne quentinha.

worldcutscene-home-text-fire-5.english: * You can't remember the last \ntime you felt so comfortable.
worldcutscene-home-text-fire-5.ptbr: * Você não se lembra da última \nvez em que se sentiu tão à vontade.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-1.ptbr: * A poltrona de leitura de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-2.english: * You enjoyed reading on it,[wait:5] even\nif it was too big for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-2.ptbr: * Você gostava de ler nela,[wait:5] mesmo\nsendo grande demais para você.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-3.ptbr: * A poltrona de leitura de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-4.english: * You enjoyed reading on it,[wait:5] even\nif it was too big for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-4.ptbr: * Você gostava de ler nela,[wait:5] mesmo\nsendo grande demais para você.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-5.english: * Ah,[wait:5] you are awake! \n[wait:5]* I have prepared breakfast, [wait:5]my child.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-5.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] você acordou! \n[wait:5]* Preparei o café da manhã,[wait:5] minha criança.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-6.english: * I think you will really enjoy it.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-6.ptbr: * Acho que você vai gostar muito.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-7.english: * After all,[wait:5] the eggs are \nSunny-side up!
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-7.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:5] os ovos estão \nà moda Sunny!

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-9.ptbr: * Vá em frente,[wait:5] antes que esfriem.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-10.english: * I have a surprise for you when you finish.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-10.ptbr: * Tenho uma surpresa para você quando terminar.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-11.english: * I had a delightful time on our excursion yesterday.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-11.ptbr: * Eu me diverti muito em nosso passeio de ontem.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-12.english: * Even if we were unable to catch any bugs.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-12.ptbr: * Mesmo sem conseguirmos pegar nenhum inseto.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-13.english: * Also,[wait:5] about the net...\n[wait:5]* It is alright.[wait:5]\n* It was quite old.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-13.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] sobre a rede...\n[wait:5]* Está tudo bem.[wait:5]\n* Ela já era bem velha.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-14.english: * There is no need to be upset about breaking it.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-14.ptbr: * Não precisa ficar mal por tê-la quebrado.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-15.english: * What matters is that the two of us had fun,[wait:5] did we not?
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-15.ptbr: * O que importa é que nós nos divertimos,[wait:5] não é mesmo?

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-16.english: * Taking care of a child like you...
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-16.ptbr: * Cuidar de uma criança como você...

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-17.english: * It does much to warm this old woman's heart.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-17.ptbr: * Aquece muito o coração desta velha senhora.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-18.english: * Why,[wait:5] it is like being warmed by the very Sun!
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-18.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] é como ser aquecida pelo próprio Sol!

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-19.english: * Ah,[wait:5] have you finished your eggs?[wait:10] My,[wait:5] you must have been hungry.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-19.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] já terminou seus ovos?[wait:10] Nossa,[wait:5] você devia estar com muita fome.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-20.english: * Either that or you are very excited for the surprise.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair2-20.ptbr: * Ou isso, ou está com muita curiosidade pela surpresa.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-1.english: * I know how much you like my Butterscotch-Cinnamon pies.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-1.ptbr: * Sei o quanto você gosta das minhas tortas de Caramelo e Canela.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-2.english: * So,[wait:5] I have decided to do something I have always wanted to do.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-2.ptbr: * Então,[wait:5] decidi fazer algo que sempre quis fazer.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-3.english: * I shall teach you how to make one yourself,[wait:5] following my own recipe.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-3.ptbr: * Vou ensinar você a fazer uma,[wait:5] seguindo minha própria receita.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-4.english: * But first,[wait:5] I have yet another surprise for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-4.ptbr: * Mas primeiro,[wait:5] tenho mais uma surpresa para você.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-6.ptbr: * Você recebeu o Avental Costurado à Mão!

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-7.english: * Your very own apron,[wait:5] sewn with love.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-7.ptbr: * Seu próprio avental,[wait:5] costurado com amor.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-8.english: * This is why I asked to take your measurements a few days ago.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-8.ptbr: * Foi por isso que pedi suas medidas alguns dias atrás.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-9.english: * Maybe once I teach you how to COOK,[wait:5] I can teach you crochet,[wait:5] as well.
worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-9.ptbr: * Talvez depois que eu ensinar você a COZINHar,[wait:5] também possa ensinar crochê,[wait:5] sabe.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-10.english: * I think you would really enjoy it.

worldcutscene-home-text-kitchen-11.english: * Now,[wait:5] let us begin,[wait:5] shall we?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-1.english: * That was some wonderful COOKing,[wait:5] my child. [wait:5]\n* I am proud of you.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-1.ptbr: * Foi uma COZINHa maravilhosa,[wait:5] minha criança. [wait:5]\n* Tenho orgulho de você.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-2.english: * The pie will still take a few minutes to cool off.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-2.ptbr: * A torta ainda precisa de alguns minutos para esfriar.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-3.english: * How about we sit by the fireplace and read together?
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-3.ptbr: * Que tal nos sentarmos perto da lareira e lermos juntos?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-4.english: * I have a book about snails that I think you might-
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-4.ptbr: * Tenho um livro sobre caracóis que acho que você pode-

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-5.english: * My apologies,[wait:5] Sunny. [wait:5]\n* Give me a moment.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-5.ptbr: * Minhas desculpas,[wait:5] Sunny. [wait:5]\n* Dê-me um instante.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-6.english: * Greetings,[wait:5] this is Toriel,[wait:5] how may I-
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-6.ptbr: * Saudações,[wait:5] aqui é Toriel,[wait:5] em que posso-

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-8.english: * Well,[wait:5] I will be over to resolve the situation in just a moment.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-8.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] irei resolver a situação em um instante.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-9.english: * I am sorry,[wait:5] young one,[wait:5] there is something I must attend to.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-9.ptbr: * Sinto muito,[wait:5] jovem,[wait:5] há algo de que preciso cuidar.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-10.english: * Stay here and be good,[wait:5] won't you?

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-11.english: * I am sure you can handle it.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-11.ptbr: * Tenho certeza de que você consegue.

worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-12.english: * I will return soon,[wait:5] so do not wander.[wait:5] It is dangerous out there.
worldcutscene-home-text-posttoriel-12.ptbr: * Voltarei logo,[wait:5] então não se afaste.[wait:5] É perigoso lá fora.

worldcutscene-home-text-closet-2.english: * Unfortunately,[wait:5] you can't take\nthem with you.[wait:5]\n* You shouldn't.
worldcutscene-home-text-closet-2.ptbr: * Infelizmente,[wait:5] você não pode\nlevá-las com você.[wait:5]\n* Não deveria.

worldcutscene-home-text-closet-3.english: * This is where all the clothes\nToriel gave you are.
worldcutscene-home-text-closet-3.ptbr: * Aqui ficam todas as roupas\nque Toriel deu a você.

worldcutscene-home-text-photo-1.english: * You feel like this photo frame\nwill stay empty for a long time.
worldcutscene-home-text-photo-1.ptbr: * Você sente que esta moldura\nficará vazia por muito tempo.

worldcutscene-home-text-toys-2.english: * Toys.\n[wait:5]* You're way too old for them.
worldcutscene-home-text-toys-2.ptbr: * Brinquedos.\n[wait:5]* Você já passou muito da idade deles.

worldcutscene-home-text-diary-2.english: * It's Toriel's diary.\n[wait:5]* Out of respect,[wait:5] you refuse\nto read it.
worldcutscene-home-text-diary-2.ptbr: * É o diário de Toriel.\n[wait:5]* Por respeito,[wait:5] você se recusa\na lê-lo.

worldcutscene-home-text-bed2-2.english: * You're pretty sure this bed is\nQueen sized.
worldcutscene-home-text-bed2-2.ptbr: * Você tem quase certeza de que esta cama é\ntamanho queen.

worldcutscene-home-text-chair-3.english: * For some reason,[wait:5] you can't\nhelp but feel sad that it\nlacks a name.
worldcutscene-home-text-chair-3.ptbr: * Por algum motivo,[wait:5] você não\nconsegue evitar a tristeza por ela\nnão ter um nome.

worldcutscene-home-text-socks-2.ptbr: * É a gaveta de meias de Toriel.

worldcutscene-home-text-socks-3.english: * Why does she have this?[wait:5]\n* She doesn't even wear socks??
worldcutscene-home-text-socks-3.ptbr: * Por que ela tem isso?[wait:5]\n* Ela nem usa meias??

worldcutscene-home-text-cactus-2.english: * A cactus.[wait:5]\n* Doesn't look like it needles\nany help.
worldcutscene-home-text-cactus-2.ptbr: * Um cacto.[wait:5]\n* Não parece precisar\nde uma mãozinha.

worldcutscene-home-text-shelf2-2.english: * Not even a single speck\nof dust.

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-1.english: * This is not the way out.

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-2.english: * Toriel is waiting for you in the kitchen!
worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-2.ptbr: * Toriel está esperando por você na cozinha!

worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-3.english: * You're too hungry to explore\nthe Ruins,[wait:5] breakfast first!
worldcutscene-home-text-nogo-3.ptbr: * Você está com fome demais para explorar\nas Ruínas,[wait:5] primeiro o café da manhã!

worldcutscene-home-text-basement-1.english: * This is the exit.[wait:5]\n* Toriel says it's unsafe.
worldcutscene-home-text-basement-1.ptbr: * Esta é a saída.[wait:5]\n* Toriel diz que não é seguro.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-1.english: * Don't take any more than\nyou've already taken.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-1.ptbr: * Não pegue mais do que\njá pegou.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-2.english: * For some reason,[wait:5] Toriel keeps\nbuying chocolate for you.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-2.ptbr: * Por algum motivo,[wait:5] Toriel continua\ncomprando chocolate para você.

worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-3.english: * You don't really like chocolate,[wait:5] but you'll eat it if it makes her happy.
worldcutscene-home-text-fridge-3.ptbr: * Você não gosta muito de chocolate,[wait:5] mas vai comer se isso deixá-la feliz.

worldcutscene-home-text-sink-1.english: * You wash your hands.\n[wait:5]* Hygiene is important.
worldcutscene-home-text-sink-1.ptbr: * Você lava as mãos.\n[wait:5]* Higiene é importante.

worldcutscene-home-text-sink-2.english: * There's some white fur stuck in the drain.
worldcutscene-home-text-sink-2.ptbr: * Há alguns pelos brancos presos no ralo.

worldcutscene-home-text-counter-2.english: * The counter is clean.[wait:5]\n* Toriel likes to keep it tidy.
worldcutscene-home-text-counter-2.ptbr: * O balcão está limpo.[wait:5]\n* Toriel gosta de mantê-lo arrumado.

worldcutscene-home-text-stove-1.ptbr: * Você aprendeu o suficiente.[wait:5]\n* Está tudo pronto.

worldcutscene-home-text-stove-2.english: * You don't understand why Toriel \nhas this.[wait:5] She just uses fire \nmagic,[wait:5] anyway.
worldcutscene-home-text-stove-2.ptbr: * Você não entende por que Toriel \ntem isso.[wait:5] Ela só usa magia \nde fogo,[wait:5] mesmo.

worldcutscene-home-text-tree-1.english: * The leaf has fallen from the tree,[wait:5] joining its dead fellows beneath.
worldcutscene-home-text-tree-1.ptbr: * A folha caiu da árvore,[wait:5] juntando-se às outras folhas mortas lá embaixo.

worldcutscene-home-text-tree-2.english: * A single leaf hangs weakly from the old tree's weathered branch.
worldcutscene-home-text-tree-2.ptbr: * Uma única folha pende fracamente do galho envelhecido da velha árvore.

worldcutscene-home-text-save-1.english: * (The assurance that you're doing the right thing fills you with determination.)
worldcutscene-home-text-save-1.ptbr: * (A certeza de que você está fazendo a coisa certa enche você de determinação.)

worldcutscene-home-text-save-2.english: * (The sight of \"Home\" fills you with a constricting,[wait:5] conflicted feeling.)
