worldcutscene-office-text-courier-7.english: * Let's see...[wait:5]\n* It should be around here SOMEWHERE...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-7.ptbr: * Vamos ver...[wait:5]\n* Deve estar por aqui em ALGUM LUGAR...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-11.english: * Gull skull![wait:5] Punctual as always![wait:5] I have a new job for you.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-11.ptbr: * Crânio de gaivota![wait:5] Pontual como sempre![wait:5] Tenho um novo serviço para você.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-13.english: * Chums,[wait:5] meet-[wait:5] or rather,[wait:5] re-meet!-[wait:5] youse's new co-worker!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-13.ptbr: * Camaradas,[wait:5] conheçam-[wait:5] ou melhor,[wait:5] reencontrem!-[wait:5] seu novo colega!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-14.english: * With him,[wait:5] your restaurant is ready to reach every corner of the Underground!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-14.ptbr: * Com ele,[wait:5] o restaurante de vocês está pronto para chegar a todos os cantos do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-15.english: * But first,[wait:5] why don't you introduce yourself to our friends?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-15.ptbr: * Mas primeiro,[wait:5] por que não se apresenta aos nossos amigos?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-16.english: * I am a shadow on the cave ceiling.[wait:5] The incognito corvid.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-16.ptbr: * Sou uma sombra no teto da caverna.[wait:5] O corvídeo incógnito.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-17.english: * The dark wing that flies in silence unbeknownst to all.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-17.ptbr: * A asa sombria que voa em silêncio sem que ninguém saiba.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-18.english: * Beyond the control of the postal service,[wait:5] tasked with only illicit deliveries...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-18.ptbr: * Fora do controle do serviço postal,[wait:5] encarregado apenas de entregas ilícitas...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-19.english: * What he means is he was fired from the UGPS,[wait:5] GWAHAHA!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-19.ptbr: * O que ele quer dizer é que foi demitido da UGPS,[wait:5] GWAHAHA!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-20.english: * Hey![wait:5] All that means is that they couldn't HANDLE me!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-20.ptbr: * Ei![wait:5] Isso só quer dizer que eles não deram CONTA de mim!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-22.english: * None knew him,[wait:5] much less what shady deals he'd delivered...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-22.ptbr: * Ninguém o conhecia,[wait:5] muito menos as transações obscuras que entregava...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-23.english: * Known only by a title that sent chills down the spine of any who heard it...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-23.ptbr: * Conhecido apenas por um título que arrepiava a espinha de quem o ouvia...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-25.english: * Alright!\n* Well,[wait:5] I'm Luna,[wait:5] manager of the Eclipse!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-25.ptbr: * Certo!\n* Bem,[wait:5] eu sou Luna,[wait:5] gerente do Eclipse!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-26.english: * The soon-to-be greatest restaurant in the Underground!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-26.ptbr: * O futuro maior restaurante do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-27.english: * Having the opportunity to share our food with everyone is wonderful!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-27.ptbr: * Ter a oportunidade de compartilhar nossa comida com todo mundo é maravilhoso!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-28.english: * I'm sure it'll be a pleasure to work with you,[wait:5] Mr. Courier.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-28.ptbr: * Tenho certeza de que será um prazer trabalhar com você,[wait:5] Sr. Courier.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-32.english: * Listen.[wait:5] Is this really the best use you have for me?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-32.ptbr: * Escute.[wait:5] Este é mesmo o melhor uso que você tem para mim?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-33.english: * Running delivery boy for some...[wait:5] second-rate Hotland restaurant?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-33.ptbr: * Fazer entregas para algum...[wait:5] restaurante de segunda categoria em Hotland?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-34.english: * I am a man with a very particular set of skills beyond simple mailman.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-34.ptbr: * Tenho habilidades muito específicas além de entregar cartas.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-35.english: * Surely there must be better uses of my time than something so foolish.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-35.ptbr: * Com certeza existem usos melhores para meu tempo do que algo tão tolo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-36.english: * I knew you underestimated me,[wait:5] but this is just utterly demeaning-[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-36.ptbr: * Eu sabia que você me subestimava,[wait:5] mas isto é simplesmente humilhante-[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-38.english: * Guess Gull Skull's gonna miss out on all those sweet,[wait:5] tasty treats!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-38.ptbr: * Parece que Crânio de Gaivota vai perder todas aquelas guloseimas doces,[wait:5] e saborosas!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-39.english: * They're just BEGGIN' for someone to peck into them,[wait:5] too...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-39.ptbr: * Elas estão quase IMPLORANDO para alguém dar umas bicadas nelas,[wait:5] também...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-41.english: * Ooo,[wait:5] and as a worker?[wait:5]\n* They were gonna be [wave]free...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-43.english: * But not because of the treats![wait:5] For completely unrelated reasons.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-43.ptbr: * Mas não por causa das guloseimas![wait:5] Por motivos totalmente diferentes.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-45.english: * I am a professional,[wait:5] far better than to stoop so low as dumb \"treats\".
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-45.ptbr: * Sou um profissional,[wait:5] muito acima de me rebaixar por simples \"guloseimas\".

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-47.english: * ...What kind of treats are we talking here?[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-47.ptbr: * ...De que tipo de guloseimas estamos falando?[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-48.english: * Hey,[wait:5] fuzz.\n[wait:5]* Why don't you show Gull Skull around the place?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-48.ptbr: * Ei,[wait:5] pelúcia.\n[wait:5]* Por que não mostra o lugar ao Crânio de Gaivota?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-49.english: * Get him real acquainted with your dream project.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-49.ptbr: * Faça ele conhecer bem seu projeto dos sonhos.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-50.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5]\n* Isso não é necessário-[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-51.english: * Oh![wait:5] I'd love to![wait:5]\n* Come on,[wait:5] Mr. Courier,[wait:5] you'll love it.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-51.ptbr: * Oh![wait:5] Eu adoraria![wait:5]\n* Venha,[wait:5] Sr. Courier,[wait:5] você vai adorar.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-53.english: * The little chum and I have some things to discuss.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-53.ptbr: * O camaradinha e eu temos algumas coisas para discutir.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-56.english: * Fine.[wait:5]\n* Show me around the place,[wait:5] then.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-56.ptbr: * Está bem.[wait:5]\n* Então me mostre o lugar,[wait:5] vai.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-57.english: * I'm just...[wait:5] thrilled.[wait:5]\n* To see the,[wait:5] uh...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-57.ptbr: * Estou apenas...[wait:5] empolgado.[wait:5]\n* Para ver as,[wait:5] hã...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-59.english: * Really?[wait:5] Well,[wait:5] I'd be more than glad to show them off!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-60.english: * They're not exactly state of the art right now,
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-60.ptbr: * Elas não são exatamente de última geração agora,

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-61.english: * But I just know that before long they'll be world class.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-61.ptbr: * Mas sei que logo serão de nível mundial.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-62.english: * Come on,[wait:5] I'll tell you anything you want to know!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-62.ptbr: * Venha,[wait:5] eu conto tudo o que quiser saber!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-64.english: * Fuzz is quite the character,[wait:5] aren't they?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-64.ptbr: * Essa pelúcia tem personalidade,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-66.english: * Ya know,[wait:5] I wasn't lying when I said I liked their ambition.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-66.ptbr: * Sabe,[wait:5] eu não estava mentindo quando disse que gostei da ambição de Luna.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-67.english: * They got a real hustler's spark,[wait:5] no doubt about that!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-67.ptbr: * Há uma verdadeira faísca de quem sabe correr atrás,[wait:5] sem dúvida!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-69.english: * The things that make a mighty monster,[wait:5] ya feel me?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-69.ptbr: * As coisas que fazem um monstro poderoso,[wait:5] está me entendendo?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-70.english: * Heh,[wait:5] maybe ya don't.\n[wait:5]* I can't blame ya,[wait:5] I suppose.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-70.ptbr: * Heh,[wait:5] talvez não.\n[wait:5]* Não posso culpar você,[wait:5] suponho.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-71.english: * What would you really know about that,[wait:5] anyway?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-71.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:5] o que você saberia sobre isso?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-72.english: * How about this?\n[wait:5]* Let me put it in a way you'll understand.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-72.ptbr: * Que tal isto?\n[wait:5]* Vou colocar de um jeito que você entenda.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-73.english: * There's another word that I feel describes it perfectly.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-73.ptbr: * Há outra palavra que acho que descreve isso perfeitamente.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-74.english: * Hmmmm...[wait:5]\n* It's on the tip of my tongue...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-74.ptbr: * Hmmmm...[wait:5]\n* Está na ponta da língua...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-76.english: * Fuzz's pretty determined to make this whole Eclipse thing work out.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-76.ptbr: * A pelúcia quer muito fazer o Eclipse dar certo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-77.english: * They've put everything they have into this!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-77.ptbr: * Luna colocou tudo o que tem nisto!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-78.english: * Ah,[wait:5] but I'm preaching to the choir.[wait:5] You know that better than anyone.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-78.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] mas estou pregando para convertido.[wait:5] Você sabe disso melhor que ninguém.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-79.english: * Like I said,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] you two are sardines in a can!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-79.ptbr: * Como eu disse,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] vocês dois são sardinhas na mesma lata!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-80.english: * So what about you?[wait:5]\n* What are you getting out of this?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-80.ptbr: * E você?[wait:5]\n* O que está ganhando com isso?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-81.english: * I wanna understand.[wait:5]\n* What are you determined to do?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-81.ptbr: * Quero entender.[wait:5]\n* O que você tem determinação para fazer?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-84.english: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* You're an even bigger fool than I thought!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-84.ptbr: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Você é ainda mais tolo do que eu pensava!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-85.english: * Listen,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\n* I'll be blunt with ya.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-85.ptbr: * Escute,[wait:5] camarada.[wait:5]\n* Vou falar sem rodeios.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-86.english: * The fuzzball's dream is a load of barnacles.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-86.ptbr: * O sonho da bola de pelos é um monte de cracas.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-87.english: * A restaurant that will change the world?\n[wait:5]* Break the barrier?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-87.ptbr: * Um restaurante que vai mudar o mundo?\n[wait:5]* Quebrar a barreira?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-88.english: * Be remembered forever?[wait:5]\n* It's not happening.[wait:5]\n[wait:5]* Can't happen.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-88.ptbr: * Ser lembrado para sempre?[wait:5]\n* Não vai acontecer.[wait:5]\n[wait:5]* Não pode acontecer.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-89.english: * You can't change people with just a smile and some good food.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-89.ptbr: * Você não muda as pessoas só com um sorriso e comida boa.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-91.english: * We both know this story can only end one way.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-91.ptbr: * Nós dois sabemos que esta história só pode acabar de um jeito.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-92.english: * And I'm afraid it ain't good for either of you.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-92.ptbr: * E receio que não seja bom para nenhum de vocês.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-93.english: * Huh?[wait:5] Why am I investing in this,[wait:5] then?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-93.ptbr: * Hã?[wait:5] Então por que estou investindo nisto,[wait:5] é isso?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-95.english: * Oh,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] I said it wasn't good for YOU.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-95.ptbr: * Oh,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] eu disse que não seria bom para VOCÊ.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-96.english: * As for me?[wait:5]\n* Well,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] let's just say...
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-96.ptbr: * Quanto a mim?[wait:5]\n* Bem,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] digamos apenas...

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-97.english: *[font:main_italic] Your soul makes for some pretty prized collateral.[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-97.ptbr: *[font:main_italic] Sua ALMA é uma garantia bem valiosa.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-98.english: * Hm,[wait:5] you don't look very surprised,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-98.ptbr: * Hm,[wait:5] você não parece muito surpreso,[wait:5] camarada.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-99.english: * Maybe you were smart enough to figure that out on your own,[wait:5] then.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-99.ptbr: * Talvez tenha percebido isso por conta própria,[wait:5] então.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-100.english: *[font:main_italic] Or maybe you already figured out the hard way?[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-100.ptbr: *[font:main_italic] Ou talvez já tenha descoberto da maneira difícil?[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-102.english: * Imagine,[wait:5] hypothetically,[wait:5] that you had some sort of special power.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-102.ptbr: * Imagine,[wait:5] hipoteticamente,[wait:5] que você tivesse algum tipo de poder especial.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-103.english: * Why waste it on a measly restaurant?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-103.ptbr: * Por que desperdiçar isso num restaurante qualquer?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-104.english: * With a power like that,[wait:5] the world's your oyster![wait:5] You could do anything!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-104.ptbr: * Com um poder desses,[wait:5] o mundo é sua ostra![wait:5] Você poderia fazer qualquer coisa!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-105.english: * You could become the most powerful being in the Underground!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-105.ptbr: * Você poderia se tornar o ser mais poderoso do Subsolo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-106.english: * You could easily make it past Asgore and return home,[wait:5] if you wanted.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-106.ptbr: * Poderia facilmente passar por Asgore e voltar para casa,[wait:5] se quisesse.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-107.english: * But you won't.[wait:5]\n* Because you want to be \"good\" and \"kind\".
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-107.ptbr: * Mas não vai.[wait:5]\n* Porque quer ser \"bom\" e \"gentil\".

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-108.english: * But how kind can ya really be when you've got nothin' to lose?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-108.ptbr: * Mas quanta bondade existe de verdade quando você não tem nada a perder?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-109.english: * You think you're being \"selfless\",[wait:5] but face it.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-109.ptbr: * Você acha que está sendo \"altruísta\",[wait:5] mas encare os fatos.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-110.english: * You're just as selfish as the rest of us.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-110.ptbr: * Você é tão egoísta quanto o resto de nós.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-111.english: * So go ahead![wait:5]\n* Keep prancin' around,[wait:5] playing the noble hero.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-111.ptbr: * Então vá em frente![wait:5]\n* Continue saltitando por aí,[wait:5] bancando o herói nobre.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-112.english: * If that's what helps you sleep at night.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-112.ptbr: * Se isso ajuda você a dormir à noite.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-113.english: * But you know where that's gonna getcha?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-113.ptbr: * Mas sabe onde isso vai levar você?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-114.english: *[font:main_italic] A coffin with a name that no one remembers.[font:reset]
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-114.ptbr: *[font:main_italic] Um caixão com um nome de que ninguém se lembra.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-115.english: * That's it.[wait:5] Stole the word right out of my mouth.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-115.ptbr: * Isso.[wait:5] Tirou a palavra da minha boca.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-116.english: * Almost like you already knew what I was gonna say.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-116.ptbr: * Quase como se você já soubesse o que eu ia dizer.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-117.english: * Hah![wait:5] If you could see the look on your face!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-117.ptbr: * Hah![wait:5] Se você pudesse ver sua cara!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-118.ptbr: * Agora isso...[wait:5]\n* Isso não tem preço.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-119.english: * So.[wait:5] This ain't your first rodeo,[wait:5] eh?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-119.ptbr: * Então.[wait:5] Não é seu primeiro rodeio,[wait:5] hein?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-121.english: * Did you want to see how much more GOLD and PRESTIGE you could get?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-121.ptbr: * Queria ver quanto mais OURO e PRESTÍGIO conseguiria?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-122.english: * Maybe you thought you could make it to an even higher rank!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-122.ptbr: * Talvez tenha pensado que conseguiria chegar a uma classificação ainda maior!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-123.english: * Now that'd be the kind of moxie I can respect!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-123.ptbr: * Agora isso seria o tipo de ousadia que eu respeito!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-124.english: *[wait:5] ...But something tells me it ain't that simple.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-124.ptbr: *[wait:5] ...Mas algo me diz que não é tão simples.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-125.english: * Were you trying to find a way out of this bind?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-125.ptbr: * Estava tentando achar uma saída desta enrascada?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-126.english: * Trying to find a way this whole shebang could end differently?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-126.ptbr: * Tentando achar um jeito de toda esta história acabar diferente?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-127.english: * I dunno how clear I gotta make it to ya,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-127.ptbr: * Não sei o quanto preciso deixar isso claro,[wait:5] camarada.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-128.english: * You can't change your fate without changing who you are.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-128.ptbr: * Você não pode mudar seu destino sem mudar quem você é.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-129.english: * And you know what you are?[wait:5] What you've always been?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-129.ptbr: * E sabe o que você é?[wait:5] O que sempre foi?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-130.english: *[font:main_italic] Just a SOUL in a jar.[font:reset]

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-131.english: * Alright,[wait:5] I've shown Mr. Courier every corner of The Eclipse!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-131.ptbr: * Certo,[wait:5] mostrei cada canto do Eclipse ao Sr. Courier!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-132.english: * It's getting really late though,[wait:5] so we really should lock up.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-132.ptbr: * Mas está ficando bem tarde,[wait:5] então deveríamos fechar.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-133.english: * Did you two talk about everything you needed?
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-133.ptbr: * Vocês dois conversaram tudo o que precisavam?

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-134.english: * Sure did,[wait:5] fuzz![wait:5] Sorry for keeping the little chum for so long.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-134.ptbr: * Com certeza,[wait:5] pelúcia![wait:5] Foi mal por segurar o camaradinha por tanto tempo.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-135.english: * I should probably head off myself.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-136.english: * Not even nighttime can stop a savvy shark like me from making money!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-136.ptbr: * Nem a noite impede um tubarão esperto como eu de ganhar dinheiro!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-137.ptbr: * Tenho certeza de que entende,[wait:5] pelúcia.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-139.english: * I spent a whole night fixing up the Eclipse,[wait:5] after all.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-139.ptbr: * Afinal,[wait:5] passei uma noite inteira reformando o Eclipse.

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-140.english: * Anything to make it stand the test of time!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-140.ptbr: * Qualquer coisa para fazê-lo resistir ao teste do tempo!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-141.english: * Anyway,[wait:5] let's go,[wait:5] Sunny.\n[wait:5]* Tomorrow is another day!
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-141.ptbr: * Enfim,[wait:5] vamos,[wait:5] Sunny.\n[wait:5]* Amanhã é outro dia!

worldcutscene-office-text-courier-142.english: * Think about what I said,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-courier-142.ptbr: * Pense no que eu disse,[wait:5] camarada.

worldcutscene-office-text-no_leave-1.english: * Come on, chum!\n[wait:5]* No need to be afraid. I won't bite!
worldcutscene-office-text-no_leave-1.ptbr: * Vamos, camarada!\n[wait:5]* Não precisa ter medo. Eu não mordo!

worldcutscene-office-text-luna-1.english: * (Did he just have this office ready...?)

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-1.english: * Taken in by the patented Mawzzmobile(tm),[wait:5] eh?
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-1.ptbr: * Ficou de olho na Mawzzmobile(tm) patenteada,[wait:5] hein?

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-2.english: * She's a real beaut,[wait:5] aint she?[wait:5]\n* Custom made,[wait:5] too!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-2.ptbr: * Ela é uma beleza,[wait:5] não acha?[wait:5]\n* Feita sob medida,[wait:5] também!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-3.english: * I know,[wait:5] I know.[wait:5]\n* \"Why's she in a bottle?\"\n[wait:5]* \"Does she work?\"
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-3.ptbr: * Eu sei,[wait:5] eu sei.[wait:5]\n* \"Por que ela está numa garrafa?\"\n[wait:5]* \"Ela funciona?\"

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-4.english: * Come on,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] who do you take me for![wait:5]\n* She drives like a dream!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-4.ptbr: * Ora,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] quem você pensa que eu sou?![wait:5]\n* Ela dirige como um sonho!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-5.english: * I'm just keeping her safe until I...[wait:5]
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-5.ptbr: * Só estou mantendo ela segura até eu...[wait:5]

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-6.english: * Persuade.[wait:5]\n* Asgore to build a highway.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-6.ptbr: * Convença.[wait:5]\n* Asgore a construir uma rodovia.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-7.english: * Trust me,[wait:5] chum.\n[wait:5]* The highway will be great for the economy!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-7.ptbr: * Confie em mim,[wait:5] camarada.\n[wait:5]* A rodovia será ótima para a economia!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-8.english: * No one else has a car,[wait:5] so traffic will be no problem.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-8.ptbr: * Ninguém mais tem carro,[wait:5] então trânsito não será problema.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-9.english: * You know,[wait:5] back in my youth,[wait:5] I used to be a real seahorsegirl.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-9.ptbr: * Sabe,[wait:5] na minha juventude,[wait:5] eu era uma verdadeira garota-cavalo-marinho.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-10.english: * I really wanted to be best friends with a seahorse!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-10.ptbr: * Eu queria muito ser melhor amiga de um cavalo-marinho!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-11.english: * Taking care of it,[wait:5] feeding it,[wait:5] saving it from mean owners...
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-11.ptbr: * Cuidar dele,[wait:5] alimentá-lo,[wait:5] salvá-lo de donos malvados...

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-12.english: * If I had a strong bond with one,[wait:5] maybe it'd let me ride it.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-12.ptbr: * Se eu tivesse um vínculo forte com um,[wait:5] talvez ele me deixasse montá-lo.

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-14.english: * Who needs seahorses when you've got the power of a THOUSAND of em?!
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-14.ptbr: * Quem precisa de cavalos-marinhos quando se tem a potência de MIL deles?!

worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-15.english: * The patented Mawzzmobile(tm).\n[wait:5]* Seems to have a lot of HP.
worldcutscene-office-text-mawzzmobile-15.ptbr: * A Mawzzmobile(tm) patenteada.\n[wait:5]* Parece ter bastante HP.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-1.english: * I see you're appreciating the art.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-1.ptbr: * Vejo que está apreciando a arte.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-2.english: * I'm quite the patron of them.\n[wait:5]* It's true!
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-2.ptbr: * Sou uma grande patrona dela.\n[wait:5]* É verdade!

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-3.english: * These two are part of my personal collection.[wait:5] Masterpieces!
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-3.ptbr: * Estas duas fazem parte da minha coleção pessoal.[wait:5] Obras-primas!

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-4.english: * They really highlight the two most important things in life.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-4.ptbr: * Elas realmente destacam as duas coisas mais importantes da vida.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-6.english: * Two very valuable paintings of supposedly valuable things.
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-6.ptbr: * Duas pinturas muito valiosas de coisas supostamente valiosas.

worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-7.english: * But are they themselves valuable,[wait:5] or simply representations of value?
worldcutscene-office-text-pictures-7.ptbr: * Mas elas mesmas são valiosas,[wait:5] ou apenas representações de valor?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-1.english: * Hey.[wait:5]\n* Don't get any funny ideas,[wait:5] chum.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-1.ptbr: * Ei.[wait:5]\n* Nada de ideias engraçadinhas,[wait:5] camarada.

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-2.english: * People always assume all my wealth is in my net worth,[wait:5] in assets.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-2.ptbr: * Sempre acham que toda a minha riqueza está no patrimônio,[wait:5] nos ativos.

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-3.english: * GWAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Imbeciles,[wait:5] the lot of them!

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-4.english: * What's the point in being rich if you can't swim in your money?
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-4.ptbr: * Qual é a graça de ser rica se não pode nadar no próprio dinheiro?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-5.english: * Liquid wealth all the way,[wait:5] chum!

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-6.english: * That's why that safe is watertight,[wait:5] see?
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-6.ptbr: * É por isso que aquele cofre é à prova d'água,[wait:5] entendeu?

worldcutscene-office-text-safe-7.english: * Mawzz's money safe.[wait:5]\n* You can hear sloshing inside.
worldcutscene-office-text-safe-7.ptbr: * Cofre do Mawzz.[wait:5]\n* Dá para ouvir líquido lá dentro.

worldcutscene-office-text-unders_tale-1.english: * Your [color:red]under tale[color:white] will not be remembered.

worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.english: [voice:ut]* Good people would do anything for others.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Boas pessoas fariam qualquer coisa pelos outros.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.english: [voice:ut]* Bad people only think of themselves.[wait:10]
worldcutscene-office-screenDialogueText-.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Pessoas ruins só pensam em si mesmas.[wait:10]

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-8.english: * After so long,[wait:5] I'm finally back on track to reaching my dream.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-8.ptbr: * Depois de tanto tempo,[wait:5] finalmente voltei ao caminho para realizar meu sonho.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-10.english: [wait:20]* Well,[wait:5] we didn't really come up with a name,[wait:5] did we?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-10.ptbr: [wait:20]* Bem,[wait:5] nós não pensamos num nome de verdade,[wait:5] pensamos?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-11.english: * Hmmm.[wait:5][speed:0.1]..[speed:1][wait:25] \n* I'm sure it'll come to me eventually.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-11.ptbr: * Hmmm.[wait:5][speed:0.1]..[speed:1][wait:25] \n* Tenho certeza de que uma hora vou pensar em algo.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-12.english: * Thank you so much,[wait:5] Sunny![wait:5] You were a great help!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-12.ptbr: * Muito obrigado,[wait:5] Sunny![wait:5] Você ajudou demais!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-13.english: [wait:5]* Heh.[wait:5] Listen to me![wait:5] Talking as if it's already all done.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-13.ptbr: [wait:5]* Heh.[wait:5] Olhe só para mim![wait:5] Falando como se já estivesse tudo pronto.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-14.english: * No,[wait:5] we've still got a long way to go before that dream is achieved.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-14.ptbr: * Não,[wait:5] ainda temos um longo caminho até esse sonho se realizar.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-15.english: * But still,[wait:5] today was a big step taken towards it!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-15.ptbr: * Mas mesmo assim,[wait:5] hoje demos um grande passo na direção dele!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-16.english: * Day after day,[wait:5] little by little,[wait:5] we'll finally reach the stars!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-16.ptbr: * Dia após dia,[wait:5] pouco a pouco,[wait:5] finalmente chegaremos às estrelas!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-19.english: * I want to show you something!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-19.ptbr: * Quero mostrar uma coisa para você!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-21.english: * Wait...[wait:5] \n* I forgot you can't fly.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-21.ptbr: * Espere...[wait:5] \n* Esqueci que você não consegue voar.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-23.english: * Here,[wait:5] let me try to help you up.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-23.ptbr: * Aqui,[wait:5] deixe eu tentar ajudar você a subir.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-25.english: * Don't worry about me,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* I'm good.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-25.ptbr: * Não se preocupe comigo,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* Estou bem.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-26.english: * Just not used to-[wait:5]\n*[font:main_italic][face:yeesh] Cough Cough-[wait:5][font:main_mono][face:woo]\n* Carrying anyone.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-26.ptbr: * Só não tenho costume de-[wait:5]\n*[font:main_italic][face:yeesh] Cof Cof-[wait:5][font:main_mono][face:woo]\n* Carregar alguém.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-27.ptbr: * Ainda bem,[wait:5] você pesa bem pouco.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-28.english: * Ahem.[wait:5] Anyway.[wait:5] \n* Here's what I wanted to show you...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-28.ptbr: * Ahem.[wait:5] Enfim.[wait:5] \n* Era isto que eu queria mostrar...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-29.english: * It's not often you get to see the CORE where you're from.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-29.ptbr: * Não é sempre que dá para ver o NÚCLEO de onde você vem.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-31.english: * You were freezing when I found you,[wait:5] so I assumed as much.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-31.ptbr: * Você estava congelando quando encontrei você,[wait:5] então foi o que presumi.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-33.english: * My dad actually helped build it a long time ago!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-33.ptbr: * Meu pai ajudou a construí-lo muito tempo atrás!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-34.english: * Ah,[wait:5] but that's not what I wanted to show you.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-34.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] mas não era isso que eu queria mostrar.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-37.english: * We wanted to replicate the surface's day and night cycle down here-
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-37.ptbr: * Nós queríamos reproduzir aqui embaixo o ciclo de dia e noite da superfície-

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-38.english: * So they made the CORE shut off its lights each night!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-38.ptbr: * Então fizeram o NÚCLEO apagar as luzes toda noite!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-39.english: * It's not the real thing,[wait:5] of course,[wait:5] but it's what we have.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-39.ptbr: * Não é de verdade,[wait:5] claro,[wait:5] mas é o que temos.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-40.english: * It makes me wonder what the real sky,[wait:5] the real day and night look like.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-40.ptbr: * Isso me faz pensar em como são o céu de verdade,[wait:5] o dia e a noite de verdade.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-41.english: * All those stars...[wait:5] \n* The Sun...[wait:15][speed:0.8] \n* The Moon...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-41.ptbr: * Todas aquelas estrelas...[wait:5] \n* O Sol...[wait:15][speed:0.8] \n* A Lua...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-42.english: * Few monsters alive ever had the privilege of seeing them.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-42.ptbr: * Poucos monstros vivos tiveram o privilégio de vê-los.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-43.english: * But those that did speak so highly of the experience...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-43.ptbr: * Mas os que viram falam tão bem da experiência...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-44.english: * [wait:10]I've never been able to stop wondering.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-46.english: * [speed:1.4]Did you know that the Moon rotates around the whole earth?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-46.ptbr: * [speed:1.4]Você sabia que a Lua gira ao redor da Terra inteira?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-47.english: * [speed:1.4]And the Earth itself is orbiting the Sun!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-47.ptbr: * [speed:1.4]E a própria Terra orbita o Sol!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-48.english: * [speed:1.4]And sometimes...[wait:15] They all line up just right and make an eclipse!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-48.ptbr: * [speed:1.4]E às vezes...[wait:15] Tudo se alinha direitinho e forma um eclipse!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-51.english: * I know what we're going to call the restaurant!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-51.ptbr: * Sei como vamos chamar o restaurante!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-52.english: * The Sun and Moon coming together,[wait:5] a once-in-a-\nlifetime event...!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-52.ptbr: * O Sol e a Lua se juntando,[wait:5] um evento que acontece uma vez\nna vida...!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-53.english: * That's it![wait:5] \n* The Eclipse![wait:5] \n* It's perfect!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-53.ptbr: * É isso![wait:5] \n* O Eclipse![wait:5] \n* É perfeito!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-54.english: * A restaurant that manages to capture the beauty of the surface...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-54.ptbr: * Um restaurante que consegue capturar a beleza da superfície...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-55.english: * ...All in this tiny corner of Hotland.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-56.ptbr: * Um restaurante de que todo mundo vai gostar.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-57.english: * So good,[wait:5] even the King himself would happily dine at it!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-57.ptbr: * Tão bom,[wait:5] que até o próprio Rei ficaria feliz em comer nele!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-58.english: * Now that'd be quite the photo to hang on the wall,[wait:5] don't you think?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-58.ptbr: * Essa seria uma bela foto para pendurar na parede,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-59.english: * I feel like this is the first step in a new stage of our lives.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-59.ptbr: * Sinto que este é o primeiro passo de uma nova fase das nossas vidas.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-60.ptbr: * Você realmente provou seu valor hoje!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-61.english: * I know it may seem absurd,[wait:5] but somehow,[wait:5] someway...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-61.ptbr: * Sei que pode parecer absurdo,[wait:5] mas de algum jeito,[wait:5] de alguma forma...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-62.english: * I have a feeling that this restaurant-
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-62.ptbr: * Tenho a sensação de que este restaurante-

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-64.english: * Will help us see the real sky someday.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-64.ptbr: * Vai nos ajudar a ver o céu de verdade algum dia.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-65.english: * I know it's probably just wishful thinking,[wait:5] but...
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-65.ptbr: * Sei que provavelmente é só um desejo,[wait:5] mas...

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-66.english: * No matter what,[wait:5] I think we can do great things!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-66.ptbr: * Seja como for,[wait:5] acho que podemos fazer grandes coisas!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-68.english: * Let's promise to keep working on this dream,[wait:5] no matter what happens.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-68.ptbr: * Vamos prometer continuar trabalhando por este sonho,[wait:5] não importa o que aconteça.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-69.english: * Let's shake on it.[wait:5] \n* For The Eclipse!
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-69.ptbr: * Vamos apertar as mãos.[wait:5] \n* Pelo Eclipse!

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-70.english: * Thank you,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5] This means a lot to me.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-70.ptbr: * Obrigado,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5] Isso significa muito para mim.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-71.english: * I hope it means a lot to you as well.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-71.ptbr: * Espero que também signifique muito para você.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-72.english: * Now that's enough of that.[wait:5] \n* It's getting late.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-72.ptbr: * Mas chega disso.[wait:5] \n* Está ficando tarde.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-75.english: * Home's too restricting for our ambitions,[wait:5] isn't it?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-75.ptbr: * A Casa limita demais nossas ambições,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-76.english: * Don't worry,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* I've got you covered.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-76.ptbr: * Não se preocupe,[wait:5] Sunny.[wait:5]\n* Eu cuido de você.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-77.english: * If you have nowhere else to stay,[wait:5] you can stay at my place.
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-77.ptbr: * Se não tiver outro lugar para ficar,[wait:5] pode ficar no meu apartamento.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-78.english: * I mean,[wait:5] it's a little cramped,[wait:5] but you know,[wait:5] what place isn't?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-78.ptbr: * Quer dizer,[wait:5] é um pouco apertada,[wait:5] mas sabe,[wait:5] que lugar não é?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-79.english: * Let's head back to my apartment,[wait:5] shall we?
worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-79.ptbr: * Vamos voltar para meu apartamento,[wait:5] está bem?

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-80.english: * Tomorrow is another day,[wait:5] after all.

worldcutscene-roof-text-day_1_roof-82.english: * It has been added to your FAVORs.

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* The start of a whole new life...[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.ptbr: [voice:ut]* O começo de uma vida totalmente nova...[wait:60]

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* A way to make others happy.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Um jeito de fazer os outros felizes.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.english: [voice:ut]* Maybe Luna is right.[wait:10] \n* This really will \nbe something special.[wait:60]
worldcutscene-roof-screenDialogueText-da.ptbr: [voice:ut]* Talvez Luna tenha razão.[wait:10] \n* Isto realmente vai \nser algo especial.[wait:60]

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-1.ptbr: * Você olha para dentro do apartamento...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-2.english: * You see a room full of books\nand cozy places to read.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-2.ptbr: * Você vê um quarto cheio de livros\ne lugares aconchegantes para ler.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-3.english: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* A monster with spectacles sits on a beanbag in the corner.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-3.ptbr: * ...Oh![wait:5]\n* Um monstro de óculos está sentado num pufe no canto.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-4.english: * They wave at you with a book in their other hand.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-4.ptbr: * O monstro acena para você com um livro na outra mão.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-5.english: * You wave back.\n[wait:5]* They smile at you before turning back to their book.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-apartment1-5.ptbr: * Você acena de volta.\n[wait:5]* O monstro sorri antes de voltar ao livro.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-2.english: * What?[wait:5]\n* I'm just a sicko that likes looking into people's windows.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-2.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5]\n* Sou só um doido que gosta de olhar pela janela dos outros.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-3.english: * There's something magical about getting a glimpse into others' lives,[wait:5] isn't there?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-3.ptbr: * Há algo mágico em dar uma espiada na vida dos outros,[wait:5] não acha?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-4.english: * Piecing things together from what little you see...[wait:5] Ha ha!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-4.ptbr: * Juntar as peças com o pouco que se vê...[wait:5] Ha ha!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-5.english: * Hmm,[wait:5] there's an air about you...\n[wait:5]* You know the feeling,[wait:5] right?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-5.ptbr: * Hmm,[wait:5] há algo em você...\n[wait:5]* Você conhece essa sensação,[wait:5] não conhece?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-6.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* Sicko to sicko!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-6.ptbr: * Ha ha![wait:5] Sim![wait:5]\n* De doido para doido!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-7.english: * If you find out anything juicy about the residents here,[wait:5] let me know!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-7.ptbr: * Se descobrir alguma fofoca suculenta sobre os moradores daqui,[wait:5] me conte!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-8.english: * And if you need advice from a professional sicko,[wait:5] I have sicko's knowledge.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-8.ptbr: * E se precisar do conselho de um doido profissional,[wait:5] eu tenho conhecimento de doido.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-9.english: * My main piece of advice is to keep your sicko's eye on what lights are on or off.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-9.ptbr: * Meu principal conselho é manter seu olho de doido nas luzes acesas ou apagadas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-10.english: * If you want to see people,[wait:5] they'll usually have their lights on.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-10.ptbr: * Se quiser ver gente,[wait:5] normalmente estarão com as luzes acesas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-11.english: * Also,[wait:5] try to keep people's weekly schedules in mind.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-11.ptbr: * Além disso,[wait:5] tente lembrar os horários semanais das pessoas.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-12.english: * As you bring me juicy details,[wait:5] I'll tell you some intel I know!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-12.ptbr: * Conforme trouxer detalhes suculentos,[wait:5] eu conto algumas informações que sei!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-13.english: * Here's some sicko starter advice to start you off!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-13.ptbr: * Aqui vai um conselho inicial de doido para começar!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-14.english: * I heard the people free on Mondays have some sort of rivalry...[wait:5] Ooo la la!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-14.ptbr: * Ouvi dizer que as pessoas livres nas segundas têm uma espécie de rivalidade...[wait:5] Ooo la la!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-15.english: * Oh?[wait:5] You've got some sicko intel?[wait:5] Yes,[wait:5] yes,[wait:5] spill!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-15.ptbr: * Oh?[wait:5] Trouxe informações de doido?[wait:5] Sim,[wait:5] sim,[wait:5] desembucha!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-16.english: * What's that?[wait:5] A fortune teller that waved you away?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-16.ptbr: * O quê?[wait:5] Uma pessoa que lê a sorte e mandou você embora?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-17.english: * Well,[wait:5] fortune telling works by reading your innate MAGIC...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-17.ptbr: * Bem,[wait:5] adivinhação funciona lendo sua MAGIA inata...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-18.english: * It's very rare a monster has a MAGIC stat that low,[wait:5] but...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-18.ptbr: * É muito raro um monstro ter um atributo de MAGIA tão baixo,[wait:5] mas...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-19.english: * Just keep practicing your MAGIC.[wait:10]\nOnce it's high enough,[wait:5] try checking again on a Sunday!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-19.ptbr: * Continue praticando sua MAGIA.[wait:10]\nQuando estiver alta o bastante,[wait:5] tente de novo num domingo!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-20.english: * One monster with a room that's too hot and one that's too cold...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-20.ptbr: * Um monstro com um quarto quente demais e outro frio demais...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-21.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* You can see where the rivalry may come in...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-21.ptbr: * Ha ha![wait:5] Sim![wait:5]\n* Dá para ver de onde pode surgir a rivalidade...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-22.english: * But let's not get hasty now![wait:5]\n* Let's see how it develops...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-22.ptbr: * Mas sem pressa agora![wait:5]\n* Vamos ver como isso se desenvolve...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-23.english: * Check in on them on Mondays and we'll see what happens!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-23.ptbr: * Dê uma olhada neles nas segundas e veremos o que acontece!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-24.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A monster floating between delicious smelling pies?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-24.ptbr: * Hmm? [wait:5]Um monstro flutuando entre tortas cheirosas?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-25.english: * How novel![wait:5]\n* How bizarre![wait:5]\n* A fellow sicko,[wait:5] perhaps?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-25.ptbr: * Que novidade![wait:5]\n* Que bizarro![wait:5]\n* Talvez outro doido,[wait:5] hein?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-26.english: * I have seen that different pie flavours have different effects on this one.
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-26.ptbr: * Vi que diferentes sabores de torta causam efeitos diferentes nesse monstro.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-27.english: * Try checking how it differs between Tuesday and Saturday...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-27.ptbr: * Tente ver como muda entre terça e sábado...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-28.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A monster studying hard for an exam?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-28.ptbr: * Hmm? [wait:5]Um monstro estudando muito para uma prova?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-29.english: * Ha ha![wait:5] Yes![wait:5]\n* That's pretty juicy!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-29.ptbr: * Ha ha![wait:5] Sim![wait:5]\n* Isso é bem suculento!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-30.english: * How about you check again tomorrow to see how the exam went?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-30.ptbr: * Que tal olhar de novo amanhã para ver como foi a prova?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-31.english: * Hmm? [wait:5]A strange smell coming out of a dorm room?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-33.english: * Don't worry,[wait:5] I think the student is doing fine enough!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-34.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] A child playing games in secret in their bed?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-34.ptbr: * Hmm?[wait:5] Uma criança jogando escondida na cama?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-36.english: * What other things might charming children do...
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-36.ptbr: * Que outras coisas crianças encantadoras podem fazer...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-37.english: * Try checking on mornings where they won't have school!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-37.ptbr: * Tente olhar nas manhãs em que não houver aula!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-38.english: * Hmm?[wait:5] A pair of eyes,[wait:5] lurking in the dark?
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-38.ptbr: * Hmm?[wait:5] Um par de olhos,[wait:5] espreitando no escuro?

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-39.english: * And you barked at them![wait:5]\n* How adorable!
worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-39.ptbr: * E você latiu para eles![wait:5]\n* Que adorável!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-40.english: * Now,[wait:5] don't make that face,[wait:5] fellow sicko!

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-41.english: * This is good.[wait:5] You've gained the respect of the pack.

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-42.english: * We will see how this develops in the future...

worldcutscene-sicko-text-sicko-44.english: * Come back with more intel,[wait:5] fellow sicko!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-2.english: * I tried to order something to eat from this store,[wait:5] but they won't sell it to me!
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-2.ptbr: * Tentei pedir algo para comer nesta loja,[wait:5] mas não querem me vender!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-3.english: * And the owner really wants me to leave,[wait:5] he says I'm wasting his precious time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-3.ptbr: * E o dono quer muito que eu vá embora,[wait:5] diz que estou desperdiçando o precioso tempo dele.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-4.english: * Come on...[wait:5] I'm not that time-consuming,[wait:5] am I?
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-4.ptbr: * Qual é...[wait:5] eu não tomo tanto tempo assim,[wait:5] tomo?

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-5.english: * My mother taught me to never waste time!

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-clockid-6.english: * This is why I eat the whole clock and never leave any leftovers.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Hmm?[wait:5]\n* A Sundial flower?
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Hmm?[wait:5]\n* Uma flor Relógio de Sol?

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I'm afraid I just recently sold our last blooming Sundial flower.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Receio ter vendido recentemente nossa última flor Relógio de Sol em flor.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * But do not despair,[wait:5] we always have seeds prepared so that no time is wasted.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Mas não se desespere,[wait:5] sempre temos sementes preparadas para não desperdiçar tempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * If you want your own,[wait:5] we can give you a seed to grow and some tips on tending to it.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Se quiser uma,[wait:5] podemos dar uma semente para cultivar e algumas dicas de cuidado.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * But it seems as if your inventory is full.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Mas parece que seu inventário está cheio.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * That's quite poor planning.\n[wait:5]* If you're to take care of a flower,[wait:5] you ought to be more mindful.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Isso é um planejamento bem ruim.\n[wait:5]* Se vai cuidar de uma flor,[wait:5] precisa ter mais atenção.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I have a pot in the back that I can send up to your apartment.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Tenho um vaso nos fundos que posso mandar para seu apartamento.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Once you plant it,[wait:5] growing this flower will be simple,[wait:5] but will require dedication.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Isso é um planejamento bem ruim.\n[wait:5]* Se vai cuidar de uma flor,[wait:5] precisa ter mais atenção.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I have a pot in the back that I can send up to your apartment.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Tenho um vaso nos fundos que posso mandar para seu apartamento.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Once you plant it,[wait:5] growing this flower will be simple,[wait:5] but will require dedication.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Depois de plantá-la,[wait:5] cultivar esta flor será simples,[wait:5] mas exigirá dedicação.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Veja,[wait:5] a Flor Relógio de Sol é bastante frágil.[wait:5] Se passar um dia sem água,[wait:5] morrerá.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * So you must always water it every morning of every day without fail.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Então você precisa regá-la toda manhã, todos os dias, sem falhar.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * This exercise will test your punctuality and persistence.\n[wait:5]* But you seem responsible enough.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Este exercício testará sua pontualidade e persistência.\n[wait:5]* Mas você parece ter responsabilidade suficiente.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Now,[wait:5] let's not waste any more time.[wait:5]\n* Good luck.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Agora,[wait:5] não vamos perder mais tempo.[wait:5]\n* Boa sorte.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * (You received the Sundial Seed!)
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * (Você recebeu a Semente de Relógio de Sol!)

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Remember to water that seed every day.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Lembre-se de regar essa semente todos os dias.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Punctuality and scheduling,[wait:5] as always,[wait:5] is the key.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Pontualidade e planejamento,[wait:5] como sempre,[wait:5] são a chave.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: Ⓥ\"* Today is \" .. months[((day-1)%7)+1] .. \",[wait:5] the \" .. day .. suffixes[math.min(4, day)] .. \" of the Month.\"
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: Ⓥ\"* Hoje é \" .. months[((day-1)%7)+1] .. \",[wait:5] dia \" .. day .. suffixes[math.min(4, day)] .. \" do Mês.\""

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Welcome to Time Ltd.\n[wait:5]* Where time and punctuality is valued above all else.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Bem-vindo à Time Ltd.\n[wait:5]* Onde tempo e pontualidade são valorizados acima de tudo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * That child there is exhibiting the exact kind of behaviour I condemn.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Aquela criança está exibindo exatamente o tipo de comportamento que condeno.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * I advise you to not be as wasteful with time as them.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Aconselho você a não desperdiçar tempo como aquela criança.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: Ⓥ\"* Today is \" .. months[((day-1)%7)+1] .. \",[wait:5] the \" .. day .. suffixes[math.min(4, day)] .. \" of the Month.\"
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: Ⓥ\"* Hoje é \" .. months[((day-1)%7)+1] .. \",[wait:5] dia \" .. day .. suffixes[math.min(4, day)] .. \" do Mês.\""

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Welcome to Time Ltd.\n[wait:5]* Where time and punctuality is valued above all else.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Bem-vindo à Time Ltd.\n[wait:5]* Onde tempo e pontualidade são valorizados acima de tudo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * You are free to peruse our collection of timepieces,[wait:5] though do not tarry long.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Pode examinar nossa coleção de relógios,[wait:5] mas não demore.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Time is our most precious resource.[wait:5] Do not be fooled into thinking you have it in excess.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * O tempo é nosso recurso mais precioso.[wait:5] Não se engane pensando que tem de sobra.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * It bemoans me to watch one with your youth treat it so carelessly.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Lamento ver alguém tão jovem tratando-o com tanto descuido.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Now,[wait:5] now.\n[wait:5]* Time is a-ticking.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Vamos,[wait:5] vamos.\n[wait:5]* O tempo está passando.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Don't spend your valuable time on idle chatter.[wait:5] I will not accept it.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Não gaste seu tempo valioso com conversa fiada.[wait:5] Não aceitarei isso.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Our business is the keeping of time,[wait:5] not its frivolous spending.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Nosso negócio é controlar o tempo,[wait:5] não gastá-lo frivolamente.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.english: * Tick-Tock.\n[wait:5]* That's more time spent.\n[wait:5]* You may never earn it back.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-time_rabbit-.ptbr: * Tic-Tac.\n[wait:5]* Mais tempo gasto.\n[wait:5]* Talvez nunca o recupere.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-1.english: * I'm a big customer here,[wait:5] the clocks they sell help me always run on time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-1.ptbr: * Sou um grande cliente daqui,[wait:5] os relógios que vendem me ajudam a sempre chegar no horário.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-2.english: * You can't underestimate the power of a good schedule.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-2.ptbr: * Não dá para subestimar o poder de uma boa agenda.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-3.english: * All this place needs is to lay down some tracks.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-train-3.ptbr: * Tudo o que falta aqui é colocarem uns trilhos.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-1.english: * This place also reminds me of rot and death.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-1.ptbr: * Este lugar também me lembra podridão e morte.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-2.english: * Either this square and its amenities was designed to remind us of our inevitable death...
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-2.ptbr: * Ou esta praça e seus estabelecimentos foram feitos para nos lembrar de nossa morte inevitável...

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-3.english: * Or I might have an unhealthy obsession.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-3.ptbr: * Ou talvez eu tenha uma obsessão nada saudável.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-4.english: * With rot and death.\n[wait:5]* My favourite things.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-fly-4.ptbr: * Por podridão e morte.\n[wait:5]* Minhas coisas favoritas.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-1.english: * Now now,[wait:5] there is no need to ring the bell.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-1.ptbr: * Vamos,[wait:5] não há necessidade de tocar o sino.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-2.english: * You can talk to me right here to save us both the time.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-2.ptbr: * Pode falar comigo aqui mesmo e poupar o tempo de nós dois.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-3.english: * We should have never wasted our time on installing that bell.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-3.ptbr: * Nunca deveríamos ter perdido tempo instalando esse sino.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-4.english: * Say what you have to say and stop spending your time needlessly.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-4.ptbr: * Diga o que tem a dizer e pare de gastar seu tempo sem necessidade.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-6.english: * I will not respond to such frivolous time wastage anymore.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-6.ptbr: * Não vou mais responder a esse desperdício frívolo de tempo.

worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-7.english: * Feel free to continue wasting your precious time on useless dings.
worldcutscene-time_ltd-text-bell-7.ptbr: * Continue gastando seu tempo com badaladas inúteis.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-001.english: * Now ain't this nice![wait:5] All up close and personal!\n[wait:5]* You see that UPGRADE option?[wait:5] Go ahead and take a peek.[wait:5]\n* I think you'll like what you see,[wait:5] chum!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-007.english: * [emote:laugh]Well,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] with me as your fin-ance man,[wait:5] you'll get so popular you'll even make it\nthrough da barrier and out onto the soiface!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-007.ptbr: * [emote:laugh]Bem,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] comigo nas fin-anças,[wait:5] você vai ficar tão popular que até atravessa\na barreira e chega à superfíshie!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-008.english: * [emote:talk]With my help,[wait:5] even the humans will be goin crazy for your,[wait:5] ehh...[wait:5] What do ya call it...[wait:5]\n* Fin Cuisine?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-008.ptbr: * [emote:talk]Com minha ajuda,[wait:5] até os humanos vão enlouquecer pela sua,[wait:5] hã...[wait:5] Como chama mesmo...[wait:5]\n* Fin Cuisine?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-009.english: * You heard the fuzzball,[wait:5] didn't ya?\n* \"The greatest restaurant the Underground has ever seen.\"
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-009.ptbr: * Você ouviu a bola de pelos,[wait:5] não ouviu?\n* \"O maior restaurante que o Subsolo já viu.\"

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-010.english: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Come on, chum,[wait:5] you're smart! [wait:5]If you wanna be the best,[wait:5] you gotta upgrade your facilities!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-010.ptbr: * GWAHAHAHA![wait:5]\n* Vamos, camarada,[wait:5] você é esperto! [wait:5]Se quer ser o melhor,[wait:5] precisa melhorar suas instalações!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-011.english: * Sure,[wait:5] what you've got going on... [wait:5]It's got charm,[wait:5] or whatever.[wait:5]\n* But you've gotta start hustling if you really wanna be the BEST!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-011.ptbr: * Claro,[wait:5] o que você tem aí... [wait:5]Tem seu charme,[wait:5] ou sei lá.[wait:5]\n* Mas precisa correr atrás se quiser mesmo ser O MELHOR!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-012.english: * That's where I come in.[wait:5] You give \nme the G and the word,[wait:5] and I'll \nget it aaaall set up for yas.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-013.english: * More space,[wait:5] more customers,[wait:5] more money![wait:5] All from reinvesting in \nyour plucky lil' restaurant.[wait:5]\n* It's basic fin-ance,[wait:5] chum!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-013.ptbr: * Mais espaço,[wait:5] mais clientes,[wait:5] mais dinheiro![wait:5] Tudo por reinvestir no \nseu corajoso restaurantinho.[wait:5]\n* É fin-ança básica,[wait:5] camarada!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-014.english: * Oh,[wait:5] and more stuff will be available as you move up in the ranks.[wait:5]\n* So make sure to check up on your buddy Mawzz whenever you've got the G to spare!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-014.ptbr: * Ah,[wait:5] e mais coisas ficarão disponíveis conforme você subir de classificação.[wait:5]\n* Então venha ver sua amiga Mawzz sempre que tiver G sobrando!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-017.english: * You know,[wait:5] chum,[wait:5] I respect what you've done with the place,[wait:5] really I do!
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-017.ptbr: * Sabe,[wait:5] camarada,[wait:5] eu respeito o que você fez com o lugar,[wait:5] de verdade!

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-018.english: * I mean,[wait:5] you had a pretty good foundation, [wait:5]but still![wait:5]\n* You've done a wondahful job.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-019.english: * [wait:5]...Buuuuuut...[wait:5]\n* It could still be even better![wait:5]\n* Doesn't it feel a little empty right now?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-019.ptbr: * [wait:5]...Maaaaas...[wait:5]\n* Ainda pode ficar melhor![wait:5]\n* Não parece meio vazio agora?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-020.english: * No,[wait:5] this place is utterly worthless for you.[wait:5]\n* Not that I know how you're here,[wait:5] too.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-020.ptbr: * Não,[wait:5] este lugar não serve para nada para você.[wait:5]\n* Não que eu saiba como você está aqui,[wait:5] também.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-025.english: * I may not know what it is,[wait:5] but I know that it's important.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-025.ptbr: * Talvez eu não saiba qual é,[wait:5] mas sei que é importante.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-026.english: * Now that I think about it,[wait:5] I really know just about nothing about what I'm doing.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-026.ptbr: * Pensando bem,[wait:5] eu realmente não sei quase nada sobre o que estou fazendo.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-027.english: * So again I ask,[wait:5] why am I here?
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-027.ptbr: * Então pergunto de novo,[wait:5] por que estou aqui?

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-028.english: * I guess we'll just have to find out.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-032.english: * If I knew,[wait:5] I'd be a lot more confident.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-032.ptbr: * Se eu soubesse,[wait:5] estaria muito mais confiante.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-033.english: * I don't know why I'm not,[wait:5] though.[wait:5]\n* It must be a weird mental thing.
shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-033.ptbr: * Mas não sei por que não estou.[wait:5]\n* Deve ser alguma coisa mental estranha.[wait:5]

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-034.english: * Because I know I'm supposed to be here.

shop-mawzz_new-startDialogue-035.english: * And everything will go how it should.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: That's the perfect use for his skills!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: É o uso perfeito para as habilidades dele!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: You don't want to overheat (heh) Grillby's memory.
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: Você não quer superaquecer (heh) a memória de Grillby.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: So he'll only be able to help once a day.
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: Então ele só poderá ajudar uma vez por dia.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Make sure to use it sparingly and wisely!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: Use isso com moderação e sabedoria!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Th-That one didn't count,[wait:5] for the record!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: E-Essa não contou,[wait:5] só para constar!

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Ahem.[wait:5] I'll go ahead and open the restaurant now.
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: Ahem.[wait:5] Vou abrir o restaurante agora.

battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.english: Get ready for another day of COOKing!
battlecutscene-democustomers-battlerText.ptbr: Prepare-se para mais um dia de COZINHa!

battlecutscene-dummy-text-susie_punch-1.english: * Susie threw a punch at\nthe dummy.

battlecutscene-dummy-text-susie_punch-2.english: * You look uhh...[wait:5] soft.[wait:5]\n* I don't like beating up\npeople like that.
battlecutscene-dummy-text-susie_punch-2.ptbr: * Você parece, ahn...[wait:5] macio.[wait:5]\n* Não gosto de bater em\ngente assim.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-1.english: * Alright chum,[wait:5] listen up!\n* Unlike regular orders,
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-1.ptbr: * Certo, camarada,[wait:5] atenção!\n* Diferente dos pedidos comuns,

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-2.english: * [color:yellow][face:wideeye]SPECIAL CUSTOMERS'\n[color:white][face:smile_r]orders are going to be longer,[wait:3] with more steps.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-2.ptbr: * Os pedidos de [color:yellow][face:wideeye]CLIENTES ESPECIAIS\n[color:white][face:smile_r]serão mais longos,[wait:3] com mais etapas.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-3.english: * Don't sweat about that though,[wait:3] chum.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-3.ptbr: * Mas não esquente com isso,[wait:3] camarada.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-4.english: * You get plenty of extra time to compensate.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-4.ptbr: * Você ganha bastante tempo extra para compensar.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-6.english: * Is that they've got very particular taste,[wait:3] see?
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-6.ptbr: * É que eles têm gostos muito específicos,[wait:3] entende?

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-7.english: * You can't just turn your brain off and [color:green]COOK!
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-7.ptbr: * Você não pode simplesmente desligar o cérebro e [color:green]COZINHar!

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-8.english: * You need to figure out what they want and how they want it,
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-8.ptbr: * Você precisa descobrir o que querem e como querem,

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-10.english: * If you don't,[wait:3] you'll\nhave to start the\n[color:green]COOKing step over again,
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-10.ptbr: * Se não fizer isso,[wait:3] terá\nque começar a etapa de\n[color:green]COZINHa de novo,

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-11.english: * And that's just a waste of time!
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-11.ptbr: * E isso é puro desperdício de tempo!

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-13.english: * It's simple,[wait:3] just[color:yellow] ACT\n[color:white]and figure out what the kid wants.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-start-13.ptbr: * É simples,[wait:3] basta[color:yellow] AGIR\n[color:white]e descobrir o que o garoto quer.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotcook-.english: * Come on,[wait:3] chum![wait:3] Didn't you hear what I said?
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotcook-.ptbr: * Vamos,[wait:3] camarada![wait:3] Não ouviu o que eu disse?

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotcook-.english: * You gotta [color:yellow]ACT[color:white] with special customers,[wait:3] first!
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotcook-.ptbr: * Você precisa [color:yellow]AGIR[color:white] com clientes especiais,[wait:3] primeiro!

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-ask_1-1.ptbr: * Você pergunta o que Grillby quer.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-ask_2-1.english: * You ask how Grillby wants his burger.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-ask_2-1.ptbr: * Você pergunta como Grillby quer o hambúrguer.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.english: * You give Grillby a thumbs up\nand an encouraging smile.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.ptbr: * Você faz um joinha para Grillby\ne sorri para incentivá-lo.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.english: * Seems as if he's gained a little more confidence.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.ptbr: * Parece que ele ganhou um pouco mais de confiança.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.english: * You assure Grillby you won't judge him for his order.
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.ptbr: * Você garante a Grillby que não vai julgá-lo pelo pedido.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-encourage_.english: * He seems to mull it over.

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.english: * Couldn't handle the pressure after all,\n[wait:5]could you?
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.ptbr: * Não aguentou a pressão no fim das contas,\n[wait:5]não foi?

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.english: * Welp![wait:5] This was an exciting business venture,[wait:5] truly,[wait:5] but...
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.ptbr: * Bem![wait:5] Foi um empreendimento empolgante,[wait:5] de verdade,[wait:5] mas...

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.english: * As much as it[wait:5][speed:0.3] saddens [speed:1.0][wait:5]my heart to do this,
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.ptbr: * Por mais que[wait:5][speed:0.3] doa [speed:1.0][wait:5]no meu coração fazer isso,

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.english: * I think it's about time\nthat I collect some,[wait:5] er...
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-outoftime-.ptbr: * Acho que chegou a hora\nde cobrar alguma,[wait:5] hã...

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-serve-2.english: * You serve Grillby his food and wait for his response...
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-serve-2.ptbr: * Você serve a comida de Grillby e espera a reação dele...

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotitem-.english: * Smallfry's trying to test you on your [color:green]COOKing skills[color:reset].
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotitem-.ptbr: * O peixinho está tentando testar suas [color:green]habilidades de COZINHa[color:reset].

battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotitem-.english: * Spicing up the worm ain't gonna make this fish bite any harder,[wait:5] Chum!
battlecutscene-grillboss-text-donotitem-.ptbr: * Temperar a isca não vai fazer este peixe morder mais forte,[wait:5] camarada!
