battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-text-ask-.english: * You ask how Luna wants\ntheir pancakes.
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-text-ask-.ptbr: * Você pergunta como Luna quer\nas panquecas.

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-text-comp.english: * You tell Luna how nice their smile is.
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-text-comp.ptbr: * Você diz a Luna que seu sorriso é muito bonito.

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Hey![wait:5] Worker![wait:5]\nIt's my kid's birthday and he wants pancakes!
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Ei![wait:5] Funcionário![wait:5]\nÉ aniversário do meu filho e ele quer panquecas!

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Now,[wait:5] quick,[wait:5] ask Grillby for help![wait:5]\nYou can do it from the SERVE menu!
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Agora,[wait:5] rápido,[wait:5] peça ajuda ao Grillby![wait:5]\nVocê pode fazer isso no menu SERVIR!

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Why would I tell you,[wait:5] burger flipper?
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Por que eu contaria para você,[wait:5] virador de hambúrguer?

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: (Try asking Grillby from the SERVE menu!)
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: (Tente pedir ajuda ao Grillby no menu SERVIR!)

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english:
But if you try to
COOK now,[wait:5] how will
you leave the
customer satisfied?
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr:
Mas se tentar
COZINHar agora,[wait:5] como
vai deixar o
cliente satisfeito?

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: Try asking Grillby for his help from the SERVE menu.
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Tente pedir ajuda ao Grillby pelo menu SERVIR.

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: A smile is the most important part of serving food.
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Um sorriso é a parte mais importante de servir comida.

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: The customer should always feel welcome at the Eclipse.
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: O cliente sempre deve se sentir bem-vindo no Eclipse.

battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.english: I don't understand how ANYBODY handled a frown when-
battlecutscene-grillbytutorial-battlerTe.ptbr: Não entendo como ALGUÉM aguentava uma cara fechada quando-

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.english: * Luna gave you a handful of INGREDIENTs.
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.ptbr: * Luna deu a você um punhado de INGREDIENTES.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.english: * They were added to your INGREDIENTs hole.
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-text-s.ptbr: * Eles foram adicionados ao seu buraco de INGREDIENTES.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: I forgot to mention this yesterday!

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr: Às vezes,[wait:5] a preferência que\nvocê revela ao\nAGIR...

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Won't be for how\nthey want the food COOKed,
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr: Não será sobre como\nquerem a comida COZINHa,

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: But rather what\nsort of INGREDIENTs\nthey want!
Adding in an INGREDIENT the customer likes...
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr: Adicionar um INGREDIENTE de que o cliente gosta...

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english:
Will give a big
bonus to the GOLD
and PRESTIGE they
give us!
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr:
Dará um grande
bônus ao OURO
e PRESTÍGIO que
nos derem!

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Here,[wait:5] I have a few that have been\nlying around for a while.
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr: Aqui,[wait:5] tenho alguns que estavam\nguardados há um tempo.

battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.english: Why don't you try using them and see what happens?
battlecutscene-ingredienttutorial-battle.ptbr: Que tal tentar usá-los e ver o que acontece?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask_ear.english: * You ask how Luna wants\ntheir pancakes.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask_ear.ptbr: * Você pergunta como Luna quer\nas panquecas.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask-1.english: * You ask how Luna wants\ntheir pancakes.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-ask-1.ptbr: * Você pergunta como Luna quer\nas panquecas.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-complim.english: * You tell Luna their acting was pretty good.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-text-complim.ptbr: * Você diz a Luna que a atuação foi muito boa.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wave:2]Woah,[wait:10] [wave:0]your SOUL\nlooks real neat!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: [wave:2]Uau,[wait:10] [wave:0]sua ALMA\né muito legal!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Green's my favorite color!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Verde é minha cor favorita!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oops,[wait:5] sorry,[wait:5] I got distracted.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Opa,[wait:5] desculpe,[wait:5] me distraí.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Anyway,[wait:5] I presume\nyou know how to COOK,[wait:3] so I'll skip over those basics.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Enfim,[wait:5] presumo\nque você saiba COZINHAR,[wait:3] então vou pular o básico.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The most important thing is this:[wait:10] the TIME LIMIT.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O mais importante é isto:[wait:10] o LIMITE DE TEMPO.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You need to serve\ncustomers before they get impatient and leave.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Você precisa servir\nos clientes antes que percam a paciência e vão embora.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If they don't get their food in a\ntimely manner,[wait:5]\nthey'll ditch.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Se não receberem a comida a\ntempo,[wait:5]\nvão embora.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No food,[wait:5] no money,[wait:5]\nno nothing.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Sem comida,[wait:5] sem dinheiro,[wait:5]\nsem nada.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But,[wait:3] the faster we\nget them their food...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas,[wait:3] quanto mais rápido\nservirmos a comida...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The more GOLD and PRESTIGE we'll get!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mais OURO e PRESTÍGIO vamos ganhar!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Of course, that doesn't mean you should rush out mediocre food!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Claro, isso não quer dizer que você deva servir comida medíocre às pressas!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Our customers should leave our restaurant as happy as possible.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Nossos clientes devem sair do restaurante o mais felizes possível.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I want our food to touch everybody's soul!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Quero que nossa comida toque a alma de todo mundo!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Metaphorically,[wait:5] anyway.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Metaforicamente,[wait:5] claro.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Let's practice,[wait:3]\nshall we?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Vamos praticar,[wait:3]\ntudo bem?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I'll act as the customer.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Eu vou fazer o papel do cliente.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Ahem.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Ahem.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Hello,[wait:3] I would like some pancakes,[wait:3]\nplease.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Olá,[wait:3] eu gostaria de panquecas,[wait:3]\npor favor.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: And make it snappy!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: E seja rápido!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wave:1](Sorry for the harshness,[wait:5] I'm just trying to be authentic.)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: [wave:1](Desculpe a grosseria,[wait:5] só estou tentando ser convincente.)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Alright,[wait:5] now you can start COOKing.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Certo,[wait:5] agora você pode começar a COZINHAR.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Good job,[wait:5] Sunny!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Bom trabalho,[wait:5] Sunny!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You did pretty well.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Você foi muito bem.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: However,[wait:5] if you\nreally want to go above and beyond...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Porém,[wait:5] se você\nquiser ir além...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english:
You'll need to
cater to the
customer's taste
more directly.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr:
Você vai precisar
atender ao
gosto do cliente
mais diretamente.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: While customers\nwill give you\ntheir order...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Embora os clientes\ndigam a você\no pedido...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The way you prepare it affects how much they enjoy it!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O jeito que você prepara afeta o quanto eles gostam!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Some customers\nprefer their food\ndone a certain way,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Alguns clientes\npreferem a comida\nfeita de certo jeito,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: And won't mention it in their order.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: E não mencionam isso no pedido.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If you really want\nto impress them...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Se você realmente quiser\nimpressioná-los...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You'll need to ACT\nto have them reveal their preferences.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Você terá que AGIR\npara fazê-los revelar suas preferências.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Of course,[wait:5] this\ncomes with a minor time loss.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Claro,[wait:5] isso\ncusta um pouco de tempo.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But,[wait:5] with the new information,[wait:2] you can make up for it...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas,[wait:5] com a nova informação,[wait:2] dá para compensar...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: With the higher GOLD and PRESTIGE we get by making them happy!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Com mais OURO e PRESTÍGIO por deixá-los felizes!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Isn't it nice to\nmake people happy?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Não é bom\nfazer as pessoas felizes?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Anyway,[wait:2] go ahead,[wait:5]\ntry some ACTs to get me to reveal my preferences!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Enfim,[wait:2] vá em frente,[wait:5]\ntente algumas AÇÕES para eu revelar minhas preferências!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] and don't worry about time counting down during ACTs.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Ah,[wait:5] e não se preocupe com o tempo passando durante as AÇÕES.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Time is deducted automatically after using an ACT.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O tempo é descontado automaticamente depois de usar uma AÇÃO.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: O-Oh!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O-Oh!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Burnt on one side...,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Queimada de um lado...,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: And completely raw on the other!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: E completamente crua do outro!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Why did you do that?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Por que você fez isso?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (Did they know my secret preference...?)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: (Será que Sunny sabia da minha preferência secreta...?)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: U-umm,[wait:5] well...,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: H-hmm,[wait:5] bem...,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: How about you give it another shot?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Que tal tentar de novo?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: O-Oh!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O-Oh!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Sunny,[wait:5] these look delicious,[wait:5] but
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Sunny,[wait:5] parecem deliciosas,[wait:5] mas

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: you need to ASK how I want my pancakes prepared.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: você precisa PERGUNTAR como quero minhas panquecas.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (I didn't tell them my preference yet,[wait:5] did I?)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: (Eu ainda não disse minha preferência,[wait:5] disse?)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Alright,[wait:5] looks like you got it!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Certo,[wait:5] parece que entendeu!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You seem ready to start this job for real!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Parece que já dá para começar o trabalho de verdade!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Well done,[wait:2] Sunny!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Muito bem,[wait:2] Sunny!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Sorry for talking\nyour ear off like that...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Desculpe por falar\ntanto assim...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But I appreciate the attentiveness!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas agradeço pela atenção!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: The last thing you have to do is SERVE me my pancakes!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: A última coisa que precisa fazer é me SERVIR as panquecas!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I have a good\nfeeling about this!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Tenho um bom\npressentimento!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] yes.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Ah,[wait:5] sim.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: That was something\nI was going to bring up later.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Isso era algo\nque eu ia explicar depois.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: For now,[wait:5] just make\nthem like normal.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Por enquanto,[wait:5] faça\ndo jeito normal.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I like it when my pancakes are burnt on one side...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Gosto quando minhas panquecas ficam queimadas de um lado...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wait:5]and raw on the other.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: [wait:5]e cruas do outro.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: It's my signature style!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: É meu estilo característico!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: People think it's weird,[wait:5] but they don't know what they're missing.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: As pessoas acham estranho,[wait:5] mas não sabem o que estão perdendo.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (Now,[wait:5] since you know how to do it better,)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: (Agora,[wait:5] já que você sabe como fazer melhor,)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: (Why don't you RETRY the COOKing step?)
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: (Por que não REPETIR a etapa de COZINHAR?)

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Huh? [wait:5]Really?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Hã? [wait:5]Sério?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] thank you,[wait:5]\nSunny!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Ah,[wait:5] obrigado,[wait:5]\nSunny!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I've had to interact with countless angry customers when I-
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Já tive que lidar com inúmeros clientes furiosos quando eu-

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: .[wait:8].[wait:8].[wait:8]Wait.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: .[wait:8].[wait:8].[wait:8]Espera.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Come on,[wait:5] Sunny,[wait:5]\nlet's stay focused\non COOKing!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Vamos,[wait:5] Sunny,[wait:5]\nvamos focar\nem COZINHAR!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No distractions!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Sem distrações!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Hmm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5] not quite.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Hmm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5] não exatamente.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: These are great pancakes,[wait:5] don't get me wrong!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Estas panquecas estão ótimas,[wait:5] não me entenda mal!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But they don't match my preference.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas não combinam com minha preferência.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If this was real,[wait:5] you would have lost out on GOLD and PRESTIGE.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Se isso fosse de verdade,[wait:5] você teria perdido OURO e PRESTÍGIO.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: It's okay.[wait:10] You can always ASK me for my preference again!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Tudo bem.[wait:10] Você sempre pode PERGUNTAR minha preferência de novo!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Umm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:10] These are normal pancakes\nagain.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Hmm[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:10] Estas são panquecas normais\nde novo.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Wait,[wait:10] you don't\nthink my pancake\nstyle is weird,[wait:3] too,[wait:5] do you?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Espera,[wait:10] você não\nacha meu estilo de\npanqueca estranho,[wait:3] também,[wait:5] acha?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Well-[wait:10] some customers may have weirder preferences,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Bem-[wait:10] alguns clientes podem ter preferências ainda mais estranhas,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But how can we say we're the Greatest Restaurant in the Underground.[wait:2].[wait:2].
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas como podemos dizer que somos o Melhor Restaurante do Subsolo.[wait:2].[wait:2].

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: If we ignore\nsomeone's tastes\njust because they're different?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Se ignorarmos\no gosto de alguém\nsó porque é diferente?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Go on.[wait:10]\nTry again.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Vamos.[wait:10]\nTente de novo.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [wait:10].[wait:10].[wait:10].
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: [wait:10].[wait:10].[wait:10].

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: .[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]Well,[wait:10] it's alright,[wait:5] we don't have to get it perfect.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: .[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]Bem,[wait:10] tudo bem,[wait:5] não precisa ficar perfeito.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: You get the idea!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Você entendeu a ideia!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:3] uh[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Oh,[wait:3] ahn[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: These are completely undercooked!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Estas estão completamente cruas!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Make sure you let\none side cook long enough before you\nflip the pancake.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Deixe\num lado cozinhar o bastante antes de\nvirar a panqueca.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Wow[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Uau[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5].

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Yeah this is super burnt.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: É, isto está muito queimado.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Some black smoke is okay...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Um pouco de fumaça preta não tem problema...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: But it usually means you're overcooking that side.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Mas geralmente significa que você passou do ponto desse lado.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Oh,[wait:5] have we already\ntaken that much time??
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Oh,[wait:5] já levamos\ntanto tempo assim??

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: That's not good!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Isso não é bom!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: We can't be wasting\ntime like this,
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Não podemos perder\ntempo assim,

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Not if we want to be the greatest restaurant in the underground!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Não se quisermos ser o melhor restaurante do Subsolo!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Let's just start\nit for real.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Vamos começar\npara valer.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] you should click the button that says Grillby!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Não,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] clique no botão que diz Grillby!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: It's under the one you just pressed.
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Fica embaixo do que você acabou de apertar.

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: No,[wait:5] no,[wait:5] you should only SERVE after you've finished the order!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Não,[wait:5] não,[wait:5] você só deve SERVIR depois de terminar o pedido!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I mean...[wait:5] Unless you're just trying to end this...
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Quer dizer...[wait:5] A menos que só queira encerrar isto...

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Wait,[wait:5] is that it?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Espera,[wait:5] é isso?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Do you just want to skip this?
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Você só quer pular isto?

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Honestly,[wait:5] that's probably for the best!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Sinceramente,[wait:5] provavelmente é melhor assim!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: More time to bring my dream to fruition,[wait:5] after all!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Afinal,[wait:5] sobra mais tempo para realizar meu sonho!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: Okay, try and SERVE!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Certo, tente SERVIR!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: I feel so sigma!
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: Estou tão sigma!

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: WHAT???
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: O QUÊ???

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: [shake:1][style:dark]WHAT???
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: [shake:1][style:dark]O QUÊ???

battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.english: WHO SAID THAT??
battlecutscene-lunatutorial-battlerText-.ptbr: QUEM DISSE ISSO??

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-donotcook-.english: * You try to think of what Mawzz would want to eat...[wait:5]\n* But you draw a blank.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-donotcook-.ptbr: * Você tenta pensar no que Mawzz gostaria de comer...[wait:5]\n* Mas não vem nada à cabeça.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-2.ptbr: * Mawzz sorteou seus minijogos de novo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-3.ptbr: * Mawzz sorteou seus minijogos de novo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-4.english: * You try to bribe Mawzz,[wait:5] but you don't seem to have enough money for his hunger.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-text-bribe-4.ptbr: * Você tenta subornar Mawzz,[wait:5] mas parece não ter dinheiro suficiente para a fome dele.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Alright Chum,[wait:5] I'll cut the chit chat.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Certo, Chum,[wait:5] vou parar de conversa fiada.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: I ain't here for just a bite.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Não vim só dar uma mordida.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: As surprising as it may be,[wait:5] I'm not exactly a gourmet.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Por mais surpreendente que seja,[wait:5] não sou exatamente um gourmet.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: To me,[wait:5] food is just another fact of life...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Para mim,[wait:5] comida é só mais um fato da vida...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: And like most others,[wait:5] it's one that you can make bank off of!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: E, como quase tudo,[wait:5] dá para ganhar uma grana com isso!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: So how about we cut the middleman here?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Então que tal cortarmos o intermediário?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: That's right!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Isso mesmo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: My order for\ntoday is[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Meu pedido de\nhoje é[wait:5].[wait:5].[wait:5]!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: If you can COOK me up 1000 G,[wait:5] I'll be satisfied!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Se você COZINHAR 1000 G para mim,[wait:5] ficarei satisfeito!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Otherwise...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Caso contrário...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Well,[wait:5] on the topic of G...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Bem,[wait:5] já que falamos de G...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Let's talk business.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Vamos falar de negócios.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: This whole timer thing you've had going on?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Essa coisa toda de cronômetro que vocês vinham usando?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: I think it's missing a little bit of nuance...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Acho que falta um pouco de nuance...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Yeowch,[wait:5] chum![wait:10] You seem \nto be in some financial straits!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Ai,[wait:5] chum![wait:10] Parece \nque as finanças apertaram!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Here,[wait:5] let me be generous so\nwe can have some more fun...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Tome,[wait:5] vou ser generoso para\npodermos nos divertir mais...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Don't cha' know chum?[wait:20]\nTime is money!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Não sabe, chum?[wait:20]\nTempo é dinheiro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: And if you don't act fast,[wait:5] you'll run out of both!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: E se não agir rápido,[wait:5] vai ficar sem os dois!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: So chop chop,[wait:5] chum!!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Então vamos,[wait:5] chum!!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.english: Time to make me some money!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ent.ptbr: Hora de me fazer dinheiro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: You're looking to\nsell these to get\nsome extra time!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.ptbr: Você quer\nvender isso para\nganhar mais tempo!
Claro,[wait:5] eu mordo.\n[wait:10]O que você tem?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: Looks like you're in some fin-[wait:5]ancial straits,[wait:5] hehehe.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.ptbr: Parece que você está num aperto finan-[wait:5]ceiro,[wait:5] hehehe.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: Say,[wait:5] if you've got any assets,[wait:5] items,[wait:5] you could part with...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.ptbr: Olha,[wait:5] se tiver algum ativo,[wait:5] item,[wait:5] do qual possa abrir mão...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: I might be willing to throw you a life preserver.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.ptbr: Talvez eu esteja disposto a jogar um salva-vidas.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.ptbr: Hã,[wait:5] Chum?[wait:10] O que é isto?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.english: This is a generous [wait:10]gift[wait:10] for your pal Mawzz!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.ptbr: Isto é um [wait:10]presente[wait:10] generoso para seu amigo Mawzz!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.english: Well allow me to give you a little[wait:10] gift[wait:10] back.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-bri.ptbr: Então permita que eu devolva um pequeno[wait:10] presente[wait:10].

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know,[wait:10]\nI've always wanted to play the big bad in one of those videos games,[wait:5] chum.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Sabe,[wait:10]\nsempre quis fazer o chefão malvado num daqueles videogames,[wait:5] chum.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: They always get the cooler sprites!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Eles sempre ficam com os sprites mais legais!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: And kickass boss music to boot!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: E ainda ganham música de chefe incrível!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know,[wait:5] if I HAD to choose a different job,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Sabe,[wait:5] se eu TIVESSE que escolher outro trabalho,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I think I'd be a treasure hunter.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Acho que seria caçador de tesouros.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: That,[wait:5] or a Broadway actor.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Isso,[wait:5] ou ator da Broadway.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Taxes are the biggest scam in all of history.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Impostos são o maior golpe de toda a história.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: One time,[wait:5] it took two weeks for them to fix the pothole near my house.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Uma vez,[wait:5] levaram duas semanas para consertar o buraco perto da minha casa.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [shake:1]TWO WEEKS,[wait:5] CHUM!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: [shake:1]DUAS SEMANAS,[wait:5] CHUM!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: So,[wait:5] when the tax collector came by,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Então,[wait:5] quando o cobrador de impostos apareceu,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I used him to fill the pothole myself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Usei ele mesmo para tapar o buraco!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You gotta be resourceful,[wait:5] chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Tem que saber se virar,[wait:5] chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Ugh.[wait:5] Fishing.\n[wait:5]What a loser activity!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Ugh.[wait:5] Pescar.\n[wait:5]Que atividade de perdedor!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: When I was a pup I mud wrestled the fish myself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Quando eu era filhote, lutava na lama com os peixes!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You know how hard it is to learn how to surf down here,[wait:5] chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Sabe como é difícil aprender a surfar aqui embaixo,[wait:5] chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: We don't get good waves in the underground,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Não temos ondas boas no Subsolo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You have to make them yourself!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Você tem que fazer as próprias ondas!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chum,[wait:5] an objective\nfact of life is that\nexplosions are cool.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Chum,[wait:5] um fato\nobjetivo da vida é que\nexplosões são legais.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
So what if it "causes
property damage" 
and "risks social
structural integrity"?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
E daí se isso "causa
danos à propriedade" 
e "ameaça a integridade
estrutural da sociedade"?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
If a building
can't handle an
explosion every so
often,[wait:5] 
it doesn't deserve
to exist.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Se um prédio
não aguenta uma
explosão de vez
em quando,[wait:5] 
nem merece
existir.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [noskip]GWAHAHA![wait:25]
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: [noskip]GUAHAHA![wait:25]

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like you've got a soft spot for money making schemes,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Parece que você tem uma queda por esquemas para ganhar dinheiro,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Don'tcha,[wait:5] chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Não é,[wait:5] chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Can't say I blame you for having favorites,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Não posso culpar você por ter favoritos,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But here's a generous word of advice for ya.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Mas aqui vai um conselho generoso.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Diversify ya' investments...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Diversifique seus investimentos...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Or you'll be looking at diminishing returns!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Ou vai acabar vendo retornos cada vez menores!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: What![wait:10]\nI said generous,[wait:5] not free!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: O quê![wait:10]\nEu disse generoso,[wait:5] não grátis!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] so it seems like the Chum's got a strategy for dis order.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Oh,[wait:5] parece que o Chum tem uma estratégia para este pedido.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Adaptable![wait:10]\nI like it!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Adaptável![wait:10]\nGostei!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But how far will that take you,[wait:5] I wonder?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas até onde isso vai levar você,[wait:5] eu me pergunto?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But enough about you,[wait:5]\nI'm the customer,[wait:5] aren't I?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas chega de falar de você,[wait:5]\neu sou o cliente,[wait:5] certo?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: And in the service industry,[wait:5] the customer is always right!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: E no setor de serviços,[wait:5] o cliente sempre tem razão!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: So that means you gotta listen to me,[wait:5] chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Então isso significa que você tem que me escutar,[wait:5] chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You might not believe it,[wait:3] but I'm a self made man!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Talvez não acredite,[wait:3] mas eu venci por conta própria!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: A real rags to riches kinda guy!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Um verdadeiro caso de pobre a rico!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Course,[wait:5]\nthat's part of why I'm helping in the first place.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Claro,[wait:5]\nisso é parte do motivo de eu estar ajudando.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Gotta pay it forward,[wait:5] you know?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Tem que retribuir,[wait:5] sabe?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Granted,[wait:5] I didn't need help to get where I am now.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: É verdade,[wait:5] eu não precisei de ajuda para chegar até aqui.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But that doesn't mean Mawzz can't be philanthropic when he needs to!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas isso não quer dizer que Mawzz não possa ser filantropo quando precisa!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: (Not to mention the tax breaks)
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: (Sem falar nas deduções fiscais)

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But I'm getting ahead of myself,[wait:5] the point is,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas estou me adiantando,[wait:5] a questão é,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english:
I got here by being
a savvy shark with
my investments and
assets!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr:
Cheguei aqui sendo
um tubarão esperto com
meus investimentos e
ativos!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Take my company for example!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Veja minha empresa, por exemplo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Anyone can see that the underground is making a one way stop to overpopulation station.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Qualquer um vê que o Subsolo está numa viagem sem volta rumo à estação da superpopulação.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: But you know what\nI see?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas sabe o que\neu vejo?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Opportunity!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Oportunidade!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: With Reel Estate-
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Com a Reel Estate-

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I help solve that problem and make a tidy profit while I'm at it!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Eu ajudo a resolver esse problema e ainda tiro um belo lucro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I mean,[wait:5]\nit's a real win-win situation,[wait:3] I say!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Quero dizer,[wait:5]\né uma situação em que todo mundo ganha,[wait:3] eu digo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: A real winapalooza!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Uma ganhapalooza!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english:
And then I can
use that cash to
invest into projects
like this one.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr:
E então posso
usar esse dinheiro para
investir em projetos
como este.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You might have even seen some of my investments before-
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Talvez você até já tenha visto alguns dos meus investimentos-

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Depending on how traveled in the underground youse are.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Dependendo do quanto já viajou pelo Subsolo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Though,[wait:5] that's not to say I don't have some particular interest in this investment here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Mas,[wait:5] não quer dizer que eu não tenha um interesse especial neste investimento aqui!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Trust me,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Confie em mim,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I really do think there's something here worth the while!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Eu realmente acho que há algo aqui que vale a pena!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Either way,[wait:5] I'm still waiting for the full course meal here.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: De qualquer jeito,[wait:5] ainda estou esperando a refeição completa.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: if you want this restaurant to have a future,[wait:5] you're going to have to pick up the pace!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: se quiser que este restaurante tenha futuro,[wait:5] vai ter que acelerar!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: So whataya waiting for,[wait:5] Chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Então o que está esperando,[wait:5] Chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Your customer is hungry!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Seu cliente está com fome!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You gotta get me the amount of coin that'll make this shark grin gill to gill!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Você tem que me dar moedas suficientes para fazer este tubarão sorrir de guelra a guelra!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: The kind of coin that'll get this shark a second gold tooth!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Moeda suficiente para este tubarão ganhar um segundo dente de ouro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] and before you ask,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Ah,[wait:5] e antes que pergunte,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: YES,[wait:10] that is real gold.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: SIM,[wait:10] é ouro de verdade.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You didn't think Mawzz would cheap out on that,[wait:5] would you?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Não achou que Mawzz economizaria nisso,[wait:5] achou?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Oh,[wait:5] and the best part was,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Ah,[wait:5] e a melhor parte foi,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Since the old tooth was lost on the [wait:10]'injury',
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Como o dente antigo foi perdido no [wait:10]'acidente',

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Healthcare paid for the surgery in full!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: O plano de saúde pagou a cirurgia inteira!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Good times...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Bons tempos...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: That's your other Mawzz tip!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Aí vai outra dica do Mawzz!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: If someone else can pay for it for you,[wait:10] let them!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Se outra pessoa pode pagar por você,[wait:10] deixe!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Consider that one a freebie,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Considere esta de graça,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Since I'm in a REAL good mood.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Porque estou de MUITO bom humor.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: More so when the big meal is so close...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Ainda mais com a grande refeição tão perto...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: ...[wait:10] Huh?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: ...[wait:10] Hã?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You've uh,[wait:5] still got G,[wait:5] huh chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Você, ahn,[wait:5] ainda tem G,[wait:5] não é, chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: You're a real savvy saver,[wait:5] didn't realize you were the type.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Você é mesmo bom em poupar,[wait:5] não achei que fosse desse tipo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: Alright,[wait:5] I've done enough yapping,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Certo,[wait:5] já falei demais,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.english: I'm going to stare at you menacingly until this is done.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dia.ptbr: Vou encarar você ameaçadoramente até isto acabar.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well,[wait:5] well,[wait:5] well,[wait:10] you hit the goal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Ora,[wait:5] ora,[wait:5] ora,[wait:10] você atingiu a meta!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: By cutting what I asked for by more than half.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Cortando o que eu pedi em mais da metade.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Look,[wait:5] I get it,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Olha,[wait:5] eu entendo,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chance time screws everyone over from time to time...
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: A hora da sorte ferra todo mundo de vez em quando...

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But your job is to make me a satisfied customer,[wait:5] no?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Mas seu trabalho é me deixar satisfeito como cliente,[wait:5] não é?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
If someone orders
a whole pizza,[wait:5]
and you only give
half of one,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Se alguém pede
uma pizza inteira,[wait:5]
e você entrega
só metade,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I don't think they'd enjoy that sorta fishy business.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Não acho que gostariam desse tipo de negócio suspeito.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But tell you what,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Mas vou dizer uma coisa,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Since your pal Mawzz is so nice,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Como seu amigo Mawzz é tão legal,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: I'll get you another chance to make me satisfied here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Vou dar outra chance para me deixar satisfeito!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
I'm sure you can
figure out how
to get me
that G,[wait:5] right chum?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Tenho certeza que
você descobre como
me conseguir
esse G,[wait:5] certo, chum?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Chop chop,[wait:5] we don't have all day!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Vamos,[wait:5] não temos o dia todo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well color me impressed, Chum!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Ora, me pinte de impressionado, Chum!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
After you lost
the slots,[wait:5] I
really thought you
were done for!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Depois que perdeu
nos caça-níqueis,[wait:5] eu
realmente achei que
já era!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Double more than I asked for?[wait:5]\nNo easy feat I tell ya.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Mais que o dobro do que eu pedi?[wait:5]\nNada fácil, eu digo.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Not just double,[wait:5] but triple more than I asked?
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Não só o dobro,[wait:5] mas o triplo do que pedi?

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Youse a money making fiend!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Você é uma máquina de fazer dinheiro!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Seriously,[wait:5] it's like you're trying to impress me or something,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Sério,[wait:5] parece até que está tentando me impressionar,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Quadrupling what I asked!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Quadruplicando o que eu pedi!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: You're really a chum after my own heart,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Você é mesmo um chum do meu coração,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: It...[wait:10] almost makes me feel bad for what happens next.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Isso...[wait:10] quase me faz sentir mal pelo que vem agora.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: But you're clearly one for surpassing expectations,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Mas está claro que você gosta de superar expectativas,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: so I'm sure you have this in the bag!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: então tenho certeza de que tira isto de letra!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Well lookie here!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Ora, veja só!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like the chum's the genuine article!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Parece que o chum é legítimo!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Ya got to the goal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Você alcançou a meta!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Looks like you've impressed me enough that-[wait:15]
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Parece que me impressionou o bastante para-[wait:15]

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: [shake:1]WAIT!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: [shake:1]ESPERA!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
I just got some
pertinent information
from my ear bud
that's definitely in
my ear!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Acabei de receber
informações pertinentes
pelo meu fone
que com certeza está
na minha orelha!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Sounds like the
economy is hitting
an inflationary
period,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Parece que a
economia entrou
num período de
inflação,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Alongside some
statewide
investments hitting
some snags,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
E alguns
investimentos
estaduais encontraram
problemas,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Causing the value of G to plummet!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Fazendo o valor de G despencar!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
We gotta adjust
that goal to be
worth exactly what
it should be!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Temos que ajustar
a meta para que
valha exatamente
o que deveria!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english:
Oh WOW,[wait:10]
the economy is
NOT doing good
chum.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr:
Uau,[wait:10]
a economia
NÃO está nada bem,
chum.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Hope you've got a rainy day fund,
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Espero que tenha uma reserva para emergências,

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.english: Because you're [wait:5]REALLY going to need it now!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fir.ptbr: Porque agora vai [wait:5]PRECISAR MESMO dela!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.ptbr: VOCÊ É UMA MÁQUINA DE MILAGRES!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.english: I mean look at these beauties!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.ptbr: Quero dizer, olhe para estas belezinhas!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.english: It's some of the most G I've seen in my life!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.ptbr: É uma das maiores quantidades de G que já vi na vida!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.english: You've made me a satisfied customer!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-fin.ptbr: Você me deixou satisfeito como cliente!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.english:
The restaurant must
not have been
doing as well as I
thought it was.
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.ptbr:
O restaurante
não devia estar
indo tão bem quanto
eu pensava.

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.english: Welp![wait:5] I suppose I HAD my faith,[wait:5] but...
Real sorry 'bout this one,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\nNothin' personal!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-dea.ptbr: Sinto muito por esta,[wait:5] chum.[wait:5]\nNada pessoal!

battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.english: You're looking to\nsell these to get\nsome extra time!
battlecutscene-mawzzboss-battlerText-ing.ptbr: Você quer\nvender isso para\nganhar mais tempo!
Claro,[wait:5] eu mordo.[wait:10]\nO que você tem?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Monster food is \nquite different \nfrom human food.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Comida de monstro é \nbem diferente \nde comida humana.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You might be used to cooking with physical\ningredients,
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Você pode estar acostumado a cozinhar com\ningredientes físicos,

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But in the underground,[wait:5] \nyou must learn to \nCOOK with MAGIC.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Mas no Subsolo,[wait:5] \nvocê precisa aprender a \nCOZINHAR com MAGIA.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: To COOK with MAGIC ingredients,[wait:5] you need a conduit for your soul.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Para COZINHAR com ingredientes MÁGICOS,[wait:5] você precisa de um condutor para sua alma.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Something to channel your desires for what you are COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Algo para canalizar seus desejos pelo que está COZINHANDO.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Here.[wait:5] \nTake this.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Aqui.[wait:5] \nPegue isto.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Culinary tools are the best conduits for magical COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Utensílios culinários são os melhores condutores para COZINHAR com magia.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Do not worry about the specifics of what you are making.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Não se preocupe com os detalhes do que está fazendo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: That conduit will serve you well,[wait:5] regardless.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Esse condutor vai servir muito bem,[wait:5] seja o que for.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Convenient,[wait:5]\nis it not?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Conveniente,[wait:5]\nnão acha?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now,[wait:5] let us start COOKing.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Agora,[wait:5] vamos começar a COZINHAR.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Wonderful start,\n[wait:5]my child.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Ótimo começo,\n[wait:5]minha criança.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now it is time \nto mix the ingredients.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Agora é hora \nde misturar os ingredientes.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You must mix with conviction,[wait:5] but remember:
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Você precisa misturar com convicção,[wait:5] mas lembre-se:

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Be careful not to push too strongly or it may spill.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Cuidado para não empurrar com força demais ou pode derramar.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Well done.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Muito bem.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Now,[wait:5] the final \nstep is simple.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Agora,[wait:5] o último \npasso é simples.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You need only place it in \nthe oven.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Só precisa colocar no \nforno.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Perfect!\n[wait:5]The pie is complete.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Perfeito!\n[wait:5]A torta está pronta.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I'm glad I was able to teach you,[wait:5] my child.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Fico feliz por ter conseguido ensinar você,[wait:5] minha criança.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: If you ever wish to COOK again,[wait:5] let me know.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Se algum dia quiser COZINHAR de novo,[wait:5] me avise.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I will help you in any way I can.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Vou ajudar de todas as formas que puder.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Talk?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Conversar?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Err...[wait:5] I suppose if you would like to,[wait:5] we can talk about something.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Err...[wait:5] Acho que, se quiser,[wait:5] podemos conversar sobre alguma coisa.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: What would you like to talk about?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Sobre o que gostaria de conversar?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: What is it,[wait:5] \nmy child?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: O que foi,[wait:5] \nminha criança?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: ...The weather?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: ...O clima?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Ha ha!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Oh,[wait:5] you are so funny,[wait:5] my child!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Oh,[wait:5] você é tão engraçado,[wait:5] minha criança!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You see,[wait:5] here in the Underground,[wait:5] we do not have\nweather,[wait:5] per se.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Veja,[wait:5] aqui no Subsolo,[wait:5] não temos\nclima,[wait:5] propriamente dito.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Some areas experience something like rain or snow...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Algumas áreas têm algo parecido com chuva ou neve...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But this is simply the result of water seeping in from the surface.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Mas isso é apenas resultado da água que se infiltra da superfície.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Quite interesting,[wait:5] is it not?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Bem interessante,[wait:5] não acha?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: You want to know my favourite food?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Quer saber qual é minha comida favorita?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmmm...[wait:5]\nIt is hard to say...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Hmmm...[wait:5]\nÉ difícil dizer...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I suppose I quite enjoy a nice carrot cake.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Acho que gosto bastante de um bom bolo de cenoura.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Though,[wait:5] I've always loved baking Butterscotch Pie.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Embora,[wait:5] eu sempre tenha amado assar Torta de Caramelo.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: It feels...\n[wait:5]Fitting.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Parece...\n[wait:5]Adequado.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: H-Huh?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: H-Hã?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Heh...[wait:5] heh...[wait:5] \nHa ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Heh...[wait:5] heh...[wait:5] \nHa ha ha!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: How bold.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Que ousadia.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I appreciate the compliment,
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Agradeço o elogio,

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: But perhaps you\nshould find someone closer to your age.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Mas talvez devesse\nprocurar alguém mais próximo da sua idade.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: With your kindness and charisma...
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Com sua bondade e carisma...

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I know you can find someone better than an old woman like me.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Sei que pode encontrar alguém melhor que uma velha como eu.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Would you like to \nhear a joke?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Gostaria de \nouvir uma piada?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmm...[wait:5] What does the moon tell the sun to wake it up in the morning?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Hmm...[wait:5] O que a lua diz ao sol para acordá-lo pela manhã?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: ...[wait:5]Rise and shine!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: ...[wait:5]Levanta e brilha!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Ha ha ha!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Ha ha ha!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I am glad you enjoy my jokes as much as I do.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Fico feliz que goste das minhas piadas tanto quanto eu.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: It has been very long since I had anyone to share them with.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Faz muito tempo desde que tive alguém com quem compartilhá-las.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Hmm...[wait:5] I'm afraid I can't think of another joke at the moment.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Hmm...[wait:5] Receio que não consigo pensar em outra piada agora.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: My child,[wait:5] do\nnot be so hasty!
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Minha criança,[wait:5] não\ntenha tanta pressa!

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: We have not even started.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Nós nem começamos.

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Oh...[wait:5] Do you not\nwant to learn to COOK?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Oh...[wait:5] Você não\nquer aprender a COZINHAR?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: Or...[wait:5] perhaps you \nalready know.[wait:5]\nIs that it?
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Ou...[wait:5] talvez você \njá saiba.[wait:5]\nÉ isso?

battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.english: I see...[wait:5]\nThen I suppose we can skip this.
battlecutscene-torieltutorial-battlerTex.ptbr: Entendo...[wait:5]\nEntão acho que podemos pular isto.

lightenemies-dino-dialogue-002.english: I need to eat vegetables to grow big and strong!
lightenemies-dino-dialogue-002.ptbr: Preciso comer vegetais para crescer grande e forte!

lightenemies-dino-dialogue-003.english: I can't wait to breathe fire!
lightenemies-dino-dialogue-003.ptbr: Mal posso esperar para cuspir fogo!

lightenemies-dino-check-001.english: Salad.\n* This mild-mannered monster wishes he was a big dragon.
lightenemies-dino-check-001.ptbr: Salada.\n* Este monstro de modos suaves queria ser um grande dragão.

lightenemies-froggit-check-001.english: French Flies[wait:5]\n* Not to be confused with\nthe potato things.
lightenemies-froggit-check-001.ptbr: Moscas Francesas[wait:5]\n* Não confundir com\nas batatas.

lightenemies-froggit-check-002.english: Famously a glutton,[wait:5] wants as many as possible!
lightenemies-froggit-check-002.ptbr: Famoso por ser guloso,[wait:5] quer o máximo que conseguir!

lightenemies-froggit-text-001.ptbr: * Froggit entrou sem querer\nno seu restaurante!

lightenemies-froggit-text-003.english: * The restaurant is filled\nwith the smell of mustard\nseed.
lightenemies-froggit-text-003.ptbr: * O restaurante está cheio\ndo cheiro de sementes de\nmostarda.

lightenemies-froggit-text-004.english: * Froggit has a very refined \ntaste.[wait:40]\n* Only kidding.
lightenemies-froggit-text-004.ptbr: * Froggit tem um paladar muito\nrefinado.[wait:40]\n* Brincadeira.

lightenemies-grillby-check-001.english: But what does he want?[wait:10]\nTry to ask!
lightenemies-grillby-check-001.ptbr: Mas o que ele quer?[wait:10]\nTente PERGUNTAR!

lightenemies-grillby-check-002.english: Burger\nIf you ever need a refresher,[wait:5] ASK again!
lightenemies-grillby-check-002.ptbr: Hambúrguer\nSe precisar relembrar,[wait:5] PERGUNTE de novo!

lightenemies-grillby-text-001.english: * Is it getting hot in here or is it just him?
lightenemies-grillby-text-001.ptbr: * Está ficando quente aqui ou é só ele?

lightenemies-grillby-text-003.english: * Grillby's fire makes his glasses flash like an anime boy's.
lightenemies-grillby-text-003.ptbr: * O fogo de Grillby faz seus óculos brilharem como os de um garoto de anime.

lightenemies-grillby-text-005.ptbr: * Grillby observa sua CULINÁRIA com atenção.

lightenemies-grillby-text-006.english: * This order is really heating up!!
lightenemies-grillby-text-006.ptbr: * Este pedido está esquentando de verdade!!

lightenemies-grillby-text-007.english: * You feel a little lightheaded from remembering the order.
lightenemies-grillby-text-007.ptbr: * Você fica um pouco tonto ao tentar lembrar o pedido.

lightenemies-grillby-text-008.english: * Grillby straightens his back and tries not to sway on his heels.
lightenemies-grillby-text-008.ptbr: * Grillby endireita as costas e tenta não cambalear.

lightenemies-grillby-text-009.english: * Mawzz looks on with a large smile.
lightenemies-grillby-text-009.ptbr: * Mawzz observa com um grande sorriso.

lightenemies-grillby-text-010.english: * Luna pumps their fists in the air and cheers you on.
lightenemies-grillby-text-010.ptbr: * Luna ergue os punhos e torce por você.

lightenemies-grillby-text-011.english: * Luna tries to backseat your COOKing,[wait:5] but Mawzz blocks them.
lightenemies-grillby-text-011.ptbr: * Luna tenta dar pitacos na sua CULINÁRIA,[wait:5] mas Mawzz impede.

lightenemies-grillby-text-012.english: * You feel a bead of sweat form on your forehead.
lightenemies-grillby-text-012.ptbr: * Uma gota de suor se forma na sua testa.

lightenemies-grillby-text-014.english: * Grillby is slightly less anxious.[wait:10]\nHe's still sweating,[wait:5] though.
lightenemies-grillby-text-014.ptbr: * Grillby está um pouco menos ansioso.[wait:10]\nMas ainda está suando.[wait:5]

lightenemies-licket-dialogue-002.english: Ready to lick it all clean!
lightenemies-licket-dialogue-002.ptbr: Pronto para lamber tudo até ficar limpo!

lightenemies-licket-check-001.english: Ice Cream[wait:5] \n* Let's hope it doesn't melt...

lightenemies-licket-text-001.ptbr: * Licket está babando por\ntodo o chão!

lightenemies-licket-text-002.ptbr: * A língua de Licket fareja sua comida.

lightenemies-licket-text-003.english: * Licket's tongue is waving majestically in the non-existent wind.
lightenemies-licket-text-003.ptbr: * A língua de Licket ondula majestosamente ao vento inexistente.

lightenemies-licket-text-004.english: * What dat tongue do?[wait:5]\n* Ice Cream.\nIt eats ice cream.
lightenemies-licket-text-004.ptbr: * O que essa língua faz?[wait:5]\n* Sorvete.\nEla come sorvete.

lightenemies-mawzz-check-001.english: Your most esteemed customer yet... But what does he want?
lightenemies-mawzz-check-001.ptbr: Seu cliente mais ilustre até agora... Mas o que ele quer?

lightenemies-mawzz-check-002.english: 1000 G or BUST!\nCOOK whatever you can to make him some money!
lightenemies-mawzz-check-002.ptbr: 1000 G ou NADA!\nCOZINHE o que puder para fazer dinheiro para ele!

lightenemies-mawzz-text-003.english: * Mawzz smiles wider.[wait:5]\n* His golden tooth glimmers like a star.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-003.ptbr: * Mawzz abre ainda mais o sorriso.[wait:5]\n* Seu dente de ouro brilha como uma estrela.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-004.english: * Luna watches from the sidelines and shoots you 4 thumbs up.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-004.ptbr: * Luna observa de longe e faz 4 sinais de positivo para você.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-005.english: * Mawzz checks his golden watch,[wait:5] taps his foot and smirks.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-005.ptbr: * Mawzz confere o relógio de ouro,[wait:5] bate o pé e sorri de canto.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-006.english: * Mawzz snaps his fingers to catch your attention.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-006.ptbr: * Mawzz estala os dedos para chamar sua atenção.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-007.english: * Mawzz looms over you.[wait:5]\n* Some drool drips from his mouth.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-007.ptbr: * Mawzz paira sobre você.[wait:5]\n* Um pouco de baba escorre de sua boca.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-008.english: * Mawzz fixes his tie and puffs out his chest proudly.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-008.ptbr: * Mawzz ajeita a gravata e estufa o peito com orgulho.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-009.english: * Mawzz's suit strains against his heaving chest.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-009.ptbr: * O terno de Mawzz aperta contra seu peito arfante.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-010.english: * Mawzz is curious to see what you'll do next.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-010.ptbr: * Mawzz está curioso para ver o que você fará em seguida.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-011.english: * Mawzz flexes for no reason.[wait:5]\n* The non-existent ladies and gents swoon.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-011.ptbr: * Mawzz flexiona sem motivo.[wait:5]\n* O público imaginário desmaia.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-012.english: * Mawzz laughs boisterously.\n[wait:5]* The building rumbles.
lightenemies-mawzz-text-012.ptbr: * Mawzz ri estrondosamente.\n[wait:5]* O prédio estremece.

lightenemies-mawzz-text-013.english: * You're not swimming with the fishies,[wait:5] you're swimming with the shark!
lightenemies-mawzz-text-013.ptbr: * Você não está nadando com os peixinhos,[wait:5] está nadando com o tubarão!

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-b.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Maybe I can make these into some \n'Organic percussion!'","Those hipster musicians are all about that stuff."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-b.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Talvez eu transforme isso em uma \n'percussão orgânica!'","Aqueles músicos hipsters adoram esse tipo de coisa."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Are the tax collectors on your lawn,[wait:5] Chum?", "Trust me,[wait:5] these fruits will make them think twice."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Os fiscais estão no seu pé,[wait:5] Chum?", "Confie em mim,[wait:5] essas frutas vão fazê-los pensar duas vezes."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Bleh, mushrooms?[wait:5] Whatta I look like chum,[wait:5] a second rate plumber?", "You'd have been better off giving me kelp!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-c.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Bleh, cogumelos?[wait:5] O que eu pareço, chum,[wait:5] um encanador de segunda?", "Teria sido melhor me dar algas!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-e.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Ever heard of the Potato Battery?", "You won't after the Mawzz Patented Carrot Batteries!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-e.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Já ouviu falar da Bateria de Batata?", "Não vai mais, depois das Baterias de Cenoura Patenteadas do Mawzz!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-a.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Now this is a battery fit for the Mawzzmobile!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-a.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Agora esta é uma bateria digna do Mawzzmóvel!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"You know,[wait:5] I heard humans \nuse this stuff as a weapon.","Not sure how,[wait:5] but the \npower within must be valuable!"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Sabe,[wait:5] ouvi dizer que humanos \\nusam isto como arma.","Não sei como,[wait:5] mas o \\npoder dentro disso deve valer muito!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Why do people...[wait:5] like this stuff?", "Whatever,[wait:5] it sells good on the market,[wait:5] that's all that matters."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-m.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Por que as pessoas...[wait:5] gostam disso?", "Tanto faz,[wait:5] vende bem no mercado,[wait:5] é só isso que importa."}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-k.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Eu adoro gatos![wait:5]\\nSão muito fáceis de vender!"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-r.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Wait,[wait:5] CHUM![wait:5]", "There's something I gotta tell you about me before-"}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-r.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Espera,[wait:5] CHUM![wait:5]", "Tem uma coisa sobre mim que preciso contar antes de-"}}

lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-s.english: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Consider the following.[wait:5]\nFire breathing shark.[wait:5] Enough said."}}
lightenemies-mawzz-ingredient_dialogue-s.ptbr: Ⓥ{["idgoeshere"] = {"Considere o seguinte.[wait:5]\\nTubarão cuspindo fogo.[wait:5] Já disse tudo."}}

lightenemies-mimi-dialogue-004.english: What a breath of fresh air!

lightenemies-mimi-dialogue-005.english: Huh?[wait:5] Teeth?[wait:5] What do you mean?

lightenemies-mimi-check-001.english: Pie\n* She didn't specify anything further...
lightenemies-mimi-check-001.ptbr: Torta\n* Ela não especificou mais nada...

lightenemies-mimi-check-002.english: Key Lime Pie[wait:5]\n* It really was that simple.
lightenemies-mimi-check-002.ptbr: Torta de Limão[wait:5]\n* Era mesmo simples assim.

lightenemies-mimi-text-001.english: * You consider complimenting Mimi's chest,[wait:5] but it might come off wrong...
lightenemies-mimi-text-001.ptbr: * Você pensa em elogiar o baú de Mimi,[wait:5] mas isso pode soar estranho...

lightenemies-mimi-text-002.english: * Mimi shifts uncomfortably in her chest.
lightenemies-mimi-text-002.ptbr: * Mimi se remexe desconfortavelmente dentro do baú.

lightenemies-mimi-text-003.english: * An eye peers bashfully from the keyhole.
lightenemies-mimi-text-003.ptbr: * Um olho espreita timidamente pelo buraco da fechadura.

lightenemies-mimi-text-004.english: * Mimi has emerged from her box!

lightenemies-pumpkid-check-001.english: Sweet Treats! \n[wait:5]* This kid has come trick or treating![wait:5]
lightenemies-pumpkid-check-001.ptbr: Doces Gostosos! \n[wait:5]* Esta criança veio pedir doces ou travessuras![wait:5]

lightenemies-pumpkid-check-002.english: But where might you find the sweets...?
lightenemies-pumpkid-check-002.ptbr: Mas onde você vai encontrar os doces...?

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-002.english: * The smell of pumpkin spice fills the air...
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-002.ptbr: * O cheiro de tempero de abóbora toma conta do ar...

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-003.english: * Crunchy organ music plays from somewhere.
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-003.ptbr: * Uma música de órgão crocante toca em algum lugar.

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-004.english: * Don't mention the date,[wait:5] it's \nnot a good idea.
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-004.ptbr: * Não mencione a data,[wait:5] não é \numa boa ideia.

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-005.english: * Pumpkid is ranting about how apples aren't treats.
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-005.ptbr: * Pumpkid reclama que maçãs não são doces de verdade.

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-006.english: * Pumpkid tells a story about a child who fell down a well.
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-006.ptbr: * Pumpkid conta uma história sobre uma criança que caiu em um poço.

lightenemies-pumpkid-text-007.english: * Pumpkid recommends several bad horror movies to watch.
lightenemies-pumpkid-text-007.ptbr: * Pumpkid recomenda vários filmes de terror ruins para assistir.

lightenemies-shoebert-text-001.english: * For some reason,[wait:5] you feel like tapdancing.
lightenemies-shoebert-text-001.ptbr: * Por algum motivo,[wait:5] você sente vontade de sapatear.

lightenemies-shoebert-text-003.ptbr: * Cheira a pão de fermentação natural.

lightenemies-shoebert-text-004.english: * For a moment,[wait:5] you thought you heard a piano.
lightenemies-shoebert-text-004.ptbr: * Por um instante,[wait:5] você achou ter ouvido um piano.

lightenemies-shoebert-text-005.english: * For a moment,[wait:5] you thought you heard a German art song.
lightenemies-shoebert-text-005.ptbr: * Por um instante,[wait:5] você achou ter ouvido um lied alemão.

lightenemies-toriel-check-001.english: Butterscotch Pie\n* Wants to teach you how to COOK.\n* Better follow her lead!
lightenemies-toriel-check-001.ptbr: Torta de Caramelo\n* Quer ensinar você a COZINHAR.\n* Melhor seguir as instruções!

lightenemies-toriel-text-001.english: * Toriel looks at you with a patient smile.
lightenemies-toriel-text-001.ptbr: * Toriel olha para você com um sorriso paciente.

lightenemies-toriel-text-002.english: * Toriel hovers close,[wait:5] ready to help.
lightenemies-toriel-text-002.ptbr: * Toriel fica por perto,[wait:5] pronta para ajudar.

lightenemies-toriel-text-003.english: * Toriel prepares some fire magic to help bake.
lightenemies-toriel-text-003.ptbr: * Toriel prepara magia de fogo para ajudar a assar.

lightenemies-toriel-text-004.english: * Toriel knows how to COOK,[wait:5] better listen to her!
lightenemies-toriel-text-004.ptbr: * Toriel sabe COZINHAR,[wait:5] melhor escutar o que ela diz!

lightenemies-toriel-text-005.english: * It's time to mix the ingredients!
lightenemies-toriel-text-005.ptbr: * É hora de misturar os ingredientes!

lightenemies-toriel-text-006.english: * Now to put the pie in the oven...
lightenemies-toriel-text-006.ptbr: * Agora vamos colocar a torta no forno...

lightenemies-vulkin-dialogue-002.english: Healing magma sauce![wait:5]\nWill you add it?

lightenemies-vulkin-check-001.english: Toasty Bun![wait:5]\n* Mistakenly believes lava has significant health benefits.
lightenemies-vulkin-check-001.ptbr: Pão Tostadinho![wait:5]\n* Acredita por engano que lava traz grandes benefícios à saúde.

lightencounters-dayFive-text.english: * It's the fifth day![wait:5]\n* Got lots of mouths to feed,[wait:5] so don't dawdle!!
lightencounters-dayFive-text.ptbr: * É o quinto dia![wait:5]\n* Tem muita boca para alimentar,[wait:5] então sem enrolar!!

lightencounters-dayFour-text.english: * It's the fourth day of customers![wait:5]\n* Keep it up!
lightencounters-dayFour-text.ptbr: * É o quarto dia de clientes![wait:5]\n* Continue assim!

lightencounters-dayOne-text.english: * It's your first day of customers![wait:5]\n* Go get 'em,[wait:5] champ!
lightencounters-dayOne-text.ptbr: * É seu primeiro dia com clientes![wait:5]\n* Vá com tudo,[wait:5] campeão!

lightencounters-dayThree-text.english: * It's the third day of customers![wait:5]\n* You're on fire!
lightencounters-dayThree-text.ptbr: * É o terceiro dia de clientes![wait:5]\n* Você está pegando fogo!

lightencounters-dayTwo-text.english: * The second day of customers begins!
lightencounters-dayTwo-text.ptbr: * O segundo dia de clientes começa!

lightencounters-toriel-text.english: * Time to show your COOKing to Toriel!
lightencounters-toriel-text.ptbr: * Hora de mostrar sua CULINÁRIA para Toriel!
